<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#f4f1e9">

<meta name="description" content="Discover Minecraft capes at CHEAPEST Cape Codes. Browse our collection, check availability, and contact us on Discord.">
<meta name="robots" content="index,follow">

<!-- Social sharing preview: show the CHEAPEST Cape Codes logo when the site link is shared. -->
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="CHEAPEST Cape Codes">

<meta property="og:description" content="Discover Minecraft capes at CHEAPEST Cape Codes. Browse our collection, check availability, and contact us on Discord.">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://mc-store.github.io/MC_STORE/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="CHEAPEST Cape Codes | Minecraft Cape Shop">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Discover Minecraft capes at CHEAPEST Cape Codes. Browse our collection, check availability, and contact us on Discord.">
<style>
:root{
  --cyan:#54ddff;
  --cyan-light:#b9f5ff;
  --blue:#2879ff;
  --orange:#ff743d;
  --orange-light:#ffb078;
  --bg:#071522;
  --panel:#0d2031;
  --panel2:#102b40;
  --text:#f3fbff;
  --muted:#9db7c9;
  --line:rgba(151,224,255,.15);
  --green:#6dffb0;
  --red:#ff8585;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:100px}
body{
  min-height:100vh;
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 0% 0%,#27cfff28,transparent 36%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 20%,#ff743d20,transparent 34%),
    linear-gradient(145deg,#06121f,#0a1d2c 48%,#07121f);
  background-attachment:fixed;
}
body,button,input{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif}
button,a{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
button{cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{max-width:100%}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--cyan);
  outline-offset:4px
}
.container{width:min(1160px,90%);margin:auto}
.gradient{
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--cyan-light),var(--cyan),var(--orange-light),var(--orange));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent
}
.kicker{
  font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase
}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  padding:13px 19px;border:1px solid #ffffff20;border-radius:11px;
  background:linear-gradient(110deg,#38cfff,#2879ff);
  color:#03131e;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,filter .2s
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 28px #27cfff35;filter:brightness(1.08)}
.btn-orange{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#ffb078,#ff743d);color:#271108}
.btn-outline{background:#ffffff08;color:var(--text);border-color:#70dfff40}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--cyan)}
.small-btn{padding:10px 13px;font-size:10px}
.sale{
  min-height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding:9px 14px;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b273a,#172439,#3b211a);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.4px
}
.sale span:first-child{color:var(--orange-light)}
.sale .sale-cyan{color:var(--cyan)}
.sale .sale-star{color:#fff}
nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
  background:#071522eF;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)
}
.nav-inner{
  min-height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;gap:20px
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex-shrink:0}
.brand img{width:130px;height:49px;object-fit:contain}
.brand-fallback{
  display:none;font-size:19px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-1px
}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nav-link{
  padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;font-weight:800;transition:.2s
}
.nav-link:hover,.nav-link.active{
  color:white;background:#38cfff13
}
.nav-links .btn{padding:11px 15px}
.user-label{
  max-width:130px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  color:var(--cyan);font-size:10px
}
.mobile-menu{display:none}
.hero{padding:57px 0 65px}
.hero-layout{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.03fr;
  gap:42px;align-items:center
}
.hero-copy{padding:12px 0}
.pill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid #54ddff35;
  background:#54ddff0d;border-radius:30px;
  font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:var(--cyan-light)
}
.pulse{
  width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px #6dffb0aa
}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(42px,6vw,74px);line-height:1.02;
  letter-spacing:-3.6px;margin:25px 0 18px
}
.hero-copy>p{
  max-width:475px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.95;color:var(--muted)
}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:25px}
.hero-stats{
  display:flex;gap:29px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-top:34px;padding-top:23px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)
}
.hero-stats strong{display:block;font-size:17px}
.hero-stats span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:5px}
.featured{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;
  padding:20px;border-radius:25px;
  border:1px solid #68dfff36;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#2ecfff24,transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(145deg,#122e43,#0a1928 72%);
  box-shadow:0 25px 80px #0003
}
.featured:before{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:210px;height:210px;
  border-radius:50%;background:#ff743d17;filter:blur(35px);
  right:-90px;top:-90px;pointer-events:none
}
.featured-top{
  position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;gap:10px
}
.featured-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:var(--cyan)}
.featured-number{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.featured-image{
  position:relative;height:320px;margin:12px 0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-radius:17px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#45d9ff1d,transparent 65%)
}
.featured-image:after{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:175px;height:30px;bottom:22px;
  border-radius:50%;background:#020a12;filter:blur(17px)
}
.featured-image img{
  position:relative;z-index:1;width:85%;height:285px;
  object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 15px 22px #0009);
  animation:floatCape 3.3s ease-in-out infinite
}
@keyframes floatCape{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
.featured-info{
  position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:space-between;gap:15px
}
.featured-info h2{font-size:25px;letter-spacing:-.8px;margin-top:9px}
.featured-price{font-size:25px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--cyan-light);text-align:right}
.featured-price small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.stock{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;
  color:var(--green);background:#6dffb00d;
  border:1px solid #6dffb033;font-size:9px;font-weight:900
}
.stock.sold{color:var(--red);background:#ff85850d;border-color:#ff858533}
.featured-bottom{
  position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:19px;
  padding-top:17px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)
}
.featured-dots{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.dot{
  width:8px;height:8px;border:0;border-radius:50%;
  background:#56758a;padding:0
}
.dot.active{width:24px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--cyan)}
.section{padding:65px 0}
.section-head{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:28px
}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,40px);letter-spacing:-1.6px;margin-top:10px}
.section-head p{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;margin-top:9px}
.shop-tools{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:13px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:25px
}
.search-wrap{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:200px;max-width:340px}
.search-wrap input{
  width:100%;padding:13px 15px 13px 39px;border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0b1c2a;color:white;
  font-size:12px;outline:none
}
.search-wrap input:focus{border-color:var(--cyan)}
.search-icon{position:absolute;left:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--muted)}
.filters{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.filter{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;
  padding:11px 13px;background:#ffffff06;color:var(--muted);
  font-size:10px;font-weight:900;transition:.2s
}
.filter:hover,.filter.active{color:var(--cyan-light);border-color:#54ddff66;background:#54ddff0d}
.sort-select{
  padding:11px 12px;background:#0b1c2a;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:9px;color:var(--text);font-size:11px;max-width:100%
}
.results-line{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-bottom:16px}
.products{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:19px}
.card{
  min-width:0;overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,#10283a,#0a1927);
  transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s
}
.card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:#54ddff66;
  box-shadow:0 17px 38px #0004
}
.card.featured-card{border-color:#54ddff70}
.card-art{
  position:relative;height:245px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#43d8ff22,transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(145deg,#142e42,#0b1c2b)
}
.card-art:after{
  content:"";position:absolute;bottom:21px;width:105px;height:17px;
  border-radius:50%;background:#0008;filter:blur(12px)
}
.card-img{
  position:relative;z-index:1;width:70%;height:190px;
  object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 14px #0008);
  transition:transform .3s
}
.card:hover .card-img{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(-2deg)}
.card-tag{
  position:absolute;z-index:2;top:13px;left:13px;
  padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;
  color:var(--green);background:#061a19d9;
  border:1px solid #6dffb033;font-size:9px;font-weight:900
}
.card-tag.sold{color:var(--red);border-color:#ff858533;background:#211516e8}
.card-tag.popular{left:auto;right:13px;color:var(--cyan-light);border-color:#54ddff40;background:#082132e8}
.card-body{padding:17px}
.card-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.card h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.4}
.card-desc{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;margin-top:8px;min-height:40px}
.card-bottom{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;margin-top:18px;padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)
}
.card-price{font-size:18px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--cyan-light)}
.card-price small{display:block;font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;margin-top:4px}
.card-price.unavailable{font-size:11px;color:var(--red)}
.view-arrow{
  width:35px;height:35px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border:1px solid #54ddff35;border-radius:10px;color:var(--cyan);
  background:#54ddff0b;transition:.2s;flex-shrink:0
}
.card:hover .view-arrow{background:var(--cyan);color:#041521}
.empty-state{
  text-align:center;padding:45px 15px;border:1px dashed var(--line);
  border-radius:15px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8
}
.empty-state strong{display:block;color:white;margin-bottom:8px}
.trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.trust-item{
  padding:23px;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#ffffff04
}
.trust-icon{
  width:42px;height:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-radius:12px;background:#54ddff12;color:var(--cyan);font-size:20px
}
.trust-item h3{font-size:14px;margin-top:17px}
.trust-item p{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.9;margin-top:8px}
.discord-banner{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:36px;border:1px solid #7584ff45;border-radius:20px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 0% 100%,#5865f228,transparent 55%),#0e2034
}
.discord-banner h2{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,35px);margin-top:10px;letter-spacing:-1px}
.discord-banner p{max-width:530px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;margin-top:10px}
footer{margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:27px 0 35px}
.footer-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.footer-brand{font-weight:1000;font-size:17px}
.footer-brand span{color:var(--cyan)}
.footer-note{max-width:430px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.9;margin-top:9px}
.footer-links{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.footer-links a{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.footer-links a:hover{color:var(--cyan)}
.copyright{margin-top:22px;padding-top:17px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
/* Product details */
#details{display:none;padding:35px 0 70px}
.back-row{margin-bottom:22px}
.back-btn{
  padding:11px 14px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--text);background:#ffffff06;font-size:11px;font-weight:900
}
.detail-card{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:35px;
  align-items:center;padding:25px;border-radius:22px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#10283a,#091827)
}
.detail-art{
  min-height:400px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-radius:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#3bd7ff24,transparent 62%),#0a1b2a
}
.detail-art img{width:85%;height:350px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 20px #0009)}
.detail-info h1{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,50px);letter-spacing:-1.8px;margin:15px 0}
.detail-info>p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;margin-top:17px}
.detail-price{font-size:30px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--cyan-light);margin-top:21px}
.detail-price small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;margin-top:6px}
.detail-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:23px}
.detail-note{
  margin-top:18px;padding:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#ffffff04;border-radius:10px;color:var(--muted);
  font-size:10px;line-height:1.8
}
.recommendations{margin-top:50px}
.recommendations .products{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.recommendations .card-art{height:170px}
.recommendations .card-img{height:130px}
.recommendations .card-body{padding:13px}
.recommendations .card h3{font-size:13px}
.recommendations .card-desc{min-height:0}
#not-found{display:none;text-align:center;padding:70px 15px}
#not-found h2{margin-bottom:12px}
/* Discord side button */
.discord-float{
  position:fixed;left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  z-index:90;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0
}
.discord-float-button{
  width:52px;height:52px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:16px;
  color:white;background:#5865f2;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0005;
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s
}
.discord-float-button:hover,.discord-float.open .discord-float-button{
  transform:scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 8px 28px #5865f277
}
.discord-float-button svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.discord-popover{
  position:absolute;left:63px;top:50%;width:270px;
  padding:16px;border-radius:15px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#18263e,#0c1728);
  border:1px solid #7584ff70;box-shadow:0 15px 45px #0008;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transform:translate(-8px,-50%);
  transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s,visibility .2s
}
.discord-float:hover .discord-popover,
.discord-float:focus-within .discord-popover,
.discord-float.open .discord-popover{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate(0,-50%)
}
.discord-popover-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
.discord-server-img{
  width:51px;height:51px;flex-shrink:0;object-fit:cover;
  border-radius:13px;background:#11263a;border:1px solid #ffffff20
}
.discord-server-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:900}
.discord-server-caption{font-size:9px;color:#b4c7ff;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.6}
.discord-connection{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.discord-live{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);margin-right:4px}
.discord-counts{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}
.discord-count{
  padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;background:#ffffff08;
  border:1px solid #ffffff10;color:#d9e8ff;font-size:10px
}
.discord-description{font-size:10px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:13px}
.discord-join{
  display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;
  padding:11px;border-radius:9px;background:#5865f2;color:white;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:900
}
.discord-join:hover{background:#4752c4}
/* Sign in modal */
.auth-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:none;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;
  background:#020912d9;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)
}
.auth-overlay.open{display:flex}
.auth-box{
  width:100%;max-width:420px;position:relative;padding:29px;
  border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #54ddff40;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#112b3e,#081624);
  box-shadow:0 20px 70px #0009
}
.auth-close{
  position:absolute;right:14px;top:12px;border:0;background:none;
  color:white;font-size:27px
}
.auth-box h2{font-size:27px;margin:12px 0}
.auth-box>p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:17px}
.auth-box input{
  display:block;width:100%;margin:12px 0;padding:13px;
  color:white;background:#061421;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:9px;font-size:12px
}
.auth-box input:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);outline:none}
.auth-box form .btn{width:100%;margin-top:7px}
.auth-box .btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}
.auth-switch,.auth-forgot{
  display:block;margin:16px auto 0;border:0;background:none;
  color:var(--cyan-light);font-size:11px
}
.auth-message{font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;margin-top:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.auth-message.error{color:#ff9999}
.auth-message.success{color:var(--green)}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}
  .hero-copy{text-align:center}
  .hero-copy>p{margin:auto}
  .hero-actions,.hero-stats{justify-content:center}
  .featured{width:min(580px,100%);margin:auto}
  .products{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .recommendations .products{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .detail-card{gap:20px;padding:18px}
  .detail-art{min-height:310px}
  .detail-art img{height:280px}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .container{width:92%}
  .nav-inner{min-height:65px;gap:8px}
  .brand img{width:90px;height:42px}
  .nav-links{gap:3px}
  .nav-link{font-size:10px;padding:8px 7px}
  .nav-links .btn{padding:9px;font-size:10px}
  .user-label{display:none}
  .hero{padding:38px 0 40px}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,12vw,61px);letter-spacing:-2.5px}
  .hero-stats{gap:19px}
  .featured{padding:14px}
  .featured-image{height:245px}
  .featured-image img{height:225px}
  .featured-info h2{font-size:21px}
  .featured-price{font-size:22px}
  .section{padding:45px 0}
  .section-head{align-items:flex-start}
  .section-head>.btn{padding:10px;font-size:10px}
  .shop-tools{align-items:stretch}
  .search-wrap{max-width:none;flex-basis:100%}
  .filters{width:100%}
  .filter{padding:10px;font-size:9px}
  .sort-select{flex:1}
  .products{gap:11px}
  .card-art{height:185px}
  .card-img{height:145px}
  .card-body{padding:12px}
  .card h3{font-size:13px}
  .card-desc{font-size:10px;min-height:54px}
  .card-bottom{gap:6px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px}
  .card-price{font-size:16px}
  .card-price small{font-size:8px}
  .view-arrow{width:31px;height:31px}
  .card-tag{top:8px;left:8px;padding:6px;font-size:8px}
  .card-tag.popular{right:8px;left:auto}
  .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .discord-banner{padding:23px}
  .detail-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .detail-art{min-height:270px}
  .detail-art img{height:245px}
  .detail-info h1{font-size:35px}
  .recommendations .products{gap:10px}
  .recommendations .card-art{height:135px}
  .recommendations .card-img{height:100px}
  .discord-float{left:8px}
  .discord-float-button{width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:13px}
  .discord-float-button svg{width:23px;height:23px}
  .discord-popover{left:51px;width:min(270px,calc(100vw - 70px));padding:12px}
  footer{padding-bottom:28px}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
  .nav-link{padding:7px 5px;font-size:9px}
  .nav-links .btn{padding:8px;font-size:9px}
  .brand img{width:75px}
  .products{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .card-art{height:220px}
  .card-img{height:180px}
  .card h3{font-size:15px}
  .card-desc{min-height:0}
  .card-body{padding:15px}
  .recommendations .products{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
}

/* =========================================================
   CHEAPEST Cape Codes — BLUE GLOW REDESIGN
   Consistent controls, cleaner layouts, responsive fixes,
   and layered cyan/blue lighting effects.
   ========================================================= */
:root {
  --cyan: #53e5ff;
  --cyan-light: #c9f8ff;
  --blue: #287cff;
  --orange: #ff874f;
  --orange-light: #ffc08e;
  --bg: #040c1b;
  --panel: #09182e;
  --panel2: #0d2342;
  --text: #f2fbff;
  --muted: #a4bdd6;
  --line: rgba(88, 202, 255, .22);
  --green: #72ffc0;
  --red: #ff8c9b;
}

html {
  scroll-padding-top: 92px;
  scrollbar-color: #258dff #061224;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
::selection { color: #031224; background: #66eaff; }
body {
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow-x: clip;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 7% 7%, rgba(18, 124, 255, .24), transparent 34%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 92% 23%, rgba(0, 220, 255, .14), transparent 31%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 45% 78%, rgba(39, 102, 255, .12), transparent 42%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #030916 0%, #07172b 48%, #040b19 100%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
}
body::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: -24%;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: .58;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 23% 28%, rgba(0, 174, 255, .22), transparent 25%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 76% 46%, rgba(53, 91, 255, .18), transparent 29%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 85%, rgba(0, 229, 255, .12), transparent 27%);
  filter: blur(34px);
  animation: blueAtmosphere 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes blueAtmosphere {
  from { transform: translate3d(-1.5%, -1%, 0) scale(1); }
  to   { transform: translate3d(1.5%, 1%, 0) scale(1.06); }
}
@keyframes bluePulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(69, 218, 255, .15), 0 0 20px rgba(29, 132, 255, .12); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(69, 218, 255, .32), 0 0 34px rgba(29, 132, 255, .25); }
}
@keyframes gradientFlow {
  0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
}
@keyframes riseIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes modalIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px) scale(.975); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

/* Bright blue typography and headings */
.gradient {
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, #d8fbff 0%, #59e7ff 32%, #398cff 68%, #a3f6ff 100%);
  background-size: 220% 220%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  animation: gradientFlow 8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.kicker, .featured-label { color: #69eaff; text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(47, 184, 255, .25); }
a { text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #61e8ff;
  outline-offset: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(45, 147, 255, .18);
}

/* Navigation, with a clearer active state */
nav {
  background: rgba(3, 11, 26, .86);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(82, 209, 255, .24);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, .2), 0 1px 0 rgba(72, 180, 255, .04);
}
.brand img { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(36, 159, 255, .18)); }
.brand-fallback { letter-spacing: -.8px; }
.nav-links { gap: 7px; }
.nav-link {
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: color .22s ease, background .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease;
}
.nav-link:hover, .nav-link.active {
  color: #f5fdff;
  border-color: rgba(75, 211, 255, .2);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(27, 145, 255, .16), rgba(57, 223, 255, .07));
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px rgba(35, 149, 255, .06), 0 0 18px rgba(18, 127, 255, .08);
}

/* Consistent primary, outline, and small buttons */
.btn {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  gap: 9px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 241, 255, .34);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(115deg, #6beeff 0%, #32b9ff 38%, #3475ff 100%);
  background-size: 160% 160%;
  color: #031326;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: .1px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(21, 121, 255, .2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  transition: transform .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease, filter .22s ease, border-color .22s ease;
}
.btn::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  top: -60%;
  left: -80%;
  width: 45%;
  height: 220%;
  transform: rotate(25deg);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.45), transparent);
  transition: left .55s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.btn:hover::before { left: 140%; }
.btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 29px rgba(30, 135, 255, .35), 0 0 19px rgba(44, 210, 255, .16);
  border-color: rgba(194, 249, 255, .72);
}
.btn:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(.985); }
.btn:disabled { opacity: .62; cursor: wait; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }
.btn-orange {
  background: linear-gradient(115deg, #ffd0a7, #ff884f);
  color: #271108;
  border-color: rgba(255, 204, 158, .55);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(255, 119, 61, .15);
}
.btn-outline {
  color: #dff9ff;
  background: linear-gradient(130deg, rgba(13, 41, 75, .85), rgba(9, 24, 47, .88));
  border-color: rgba(78, 196, 255, .4);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.045), 0 4px 17px rgba(0, 100, 255, .08);
}
.btn-outline:hover {
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #59e5ff;
  background: linear-gradient(130deg, rgba(19, 81, 137, .8), rgba(11, 35, 67, .95));
}
.small-btn { min-height: 36px; padding: 9px 13px; font-size: 10px; border-radius: 10px; }
.nav-links .btn { min-height: 39px; padding: 10px 14px; }
.back-btn {
  min-height: 42px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(77, 203, 255, .35);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(18, 52, 88, .8), rgba(7, 23, 45, .9));
  color: #e8faff;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.back-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: #5ce5ff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(25, 132, 255, .2);
}
.filter {
  min-height: 40px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(86, 190, 255, .24);
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: rgba(8, 26, 49, .78);
  color: #abc8e0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  transition: color .2s ease, background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.filter:hover, .filter.active {
  color: #ddfbff;
  border-color: rgba(75, 218, 255, .65);
  background: linear-gradient(125deg, rgba(22, 109, 191, .35), rgba(32, 189, 236, .13));
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(16, 139, 255, .14), inset 0 0 12px rgba(42, 186, 255, .06);
}
.filter:active { transform: scale(.97); }

/* A brighter hero and spotlight card */
.hero { position: relative; }
.hero-copy > * { animation: riseIn .65s both; }
.hero-copy > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .06s; }
.hero-copy > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .12s; }
.hero-copy > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .18s; }
.hero-copy > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: .24s; }
.pill {
  border-color: rgba(74, 220, 255, .38);
  background: linear-gradient(110deg, rgba(33, 144, 255, .12), rgba(46, 218, 255, .08));
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px rgba(45, 159, 255, .07), 0 0 28px rgba(33, 148, 255, .08);
}
.pulse { box-shadow: 0 0 9px #72ffc0, 0 0 18px rgba(89, 255, 185, .55); }
.hero-stats { border-color: rgba(86, 201, 255, .22); }
.hero-stats strong { text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(61, 177, 255, .14); }
.featured {
  border-color: rgba(81, 211, 255, .42);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 52% 34%, rgba(28, 165, 255, .22), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 90%, rgba(54, 93, 255, .13), transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(12, 38, 68, .97), rgba(5, 16, 34, .98) 72%);
  box-shadow: 0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.32), 0 0 30px rgba(29, 127, 255, .12), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(187, 243, 255, .06);
  animation: bluePulse 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.featured:before {
  background: rgba(21, 156, 255, .2);
  filter: blur(48px);
}
.featured-image {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(35, 194, 255, .17), transparent 67%);
}
.featured-image img {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.65)) drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(29, 164, 255, .16));
}
.featured-price { text-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(59, 187, 255, .15); }
.dot { transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; }
.dot:hover { transform: scale(1.2); background: #9aefff; }
.dot.active { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6aefff, #3687ff); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(56, 174, 255, .45); }

/* Product cards: equal structure, cleaner spacing, blue neon interactions */
.products { align-items: stretch; }
.card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  border-color: rgba(78, 176, 238, .23);
  border-radius: 19px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(28, 123, 255, .09), transparent 54%),
    linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(11, 34, 61, .98), rgba(5, 17, 34, .98));
  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.13), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(190, 236, 255, .035);
}
.card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 15%;
  right: 15%;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: .5;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #53e5ff, #398cff, transparent);
  transition: opacity .25s ease, left .25s ease, right .25s ease;
}
.card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-7px);
  border-color: rgba(73, 218, 255, .72);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.28), 0 0 28px rgba(23, 133, 255, .17), inset 0 0 20px rgba(34, 153, 255, .045);
}
.card:hover::before { left: 0; right: 0; opacity: 1; }
.card.featured-card {
  border-color: rgba(73, 218, 255, .6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 23px rgba(20, 153, 255, .1), inset 0 0 22px rgba(39, 169, 255, .035);
}
.card > a:first-child { display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.card-art {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 37%, rgba(29, 155, 255, .18), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #102b4a, #061427);
}
.card-art::after { background: rgba(0, 4, 15, .75); }
.card-img {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(28, 162, 255, .1));
}
.card:hover .card-img {
  transform: scale(1.075) rotate(-1deg);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 19px rgba(0,0,0,.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(35, 183, 255, .18));
}
.card-tag {
  border-radius: 9px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}
.card-tag.popular {
  color: #d5faff;
  border-color: rgba(75, 214, 255, .48);
  background: rgba(4, 35, 65, .88);
}
.card-body {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 18px;
}
.card h3 { line-height: 1.45; transition: color .2s ease; }
.card-body > a:hover h3 { color: #8eedff; }
.card-desc { min-height: 60px; }
.card-bottom {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 15px;
  border-color: rgba(83, 183, 255, .16);
}
.card-price { text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(45, 168, 255, .14); }
.card-price.unavailable { text-shadow: none; }
.view-arrow {
  width: 41px;
  height: 41px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border-color: rgba(77, 209, 255, .4);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(17, 100, 171, .24), rgba(24, 152, 255, .1));
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  transition: transform .2s ease, color .2s ease, background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.view-arrow:hover, .card:hover .view-arrow {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  background: linear-gradient(130deg, #6beeff, #438cff);
  color: #041226;
  box-shadow: 0 0 21px rgba(44, 175, 255, .28);
}
.results-line { color: #aac7e0; }
.search-wrap input, .sort-select {
  border-color: rgba(82, 187, 255, .24);
  background: rgba(4, 18, 38, .88);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, background .2s ease;
}
.search-wrap input:focus, .sort-select:focus {
  border-color: #53dfff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(41, 145, 255, .13), 0 0 22px rgba(37, 147, 255, .09);
  background: #071a34;
}
.sort-select option { background: #07172d; color: #f2fbff; }
.empty-state {
  border-color: rgba(87, 196, 255, .38);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(13, 42, 76, .42), rgba(6, 19, 38, .45));
}

/* Trust cards, Discord banner, product detail page */
.trust-item {
  border-color: rgba(78, 181, 255, .22);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(13, 39, 69, .65), rgba(6, 19, 38, .6));
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035);
  transition: transform .23s ease, border-color .23s ease, box-shadow .23s ease;
}
.trust-item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  border-color: rgba(79, 219, 255, .55);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 33px rgba(0,0,0,.18), 0 0 25px rgba(25, 132, 255, .12);
}
.trust-icon {
  border: 1px solid rgba(77, 201, 255, .22);
  background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(29, 146, 255, .2), rgba(31, 219, 255, .08));
  box-shadow: 0 0 21px rgba(25, 147, 255, .1);
}
.discord-banner {
  border-color: rgba(71, 154, 255, .48);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 0% 100%, rgba(38, 112, 255, .27), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 0%, rgba(28, 205, 255, .13), transparent 45%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #0b2241, #071428);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(194, 241, 255, .04);
}
.discord-banner .kicker { color: #70eaff; }
.detail-card {
  border-color: rgba(78, 200, 255, .33);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 16%, rgba(20, 117, 255, .12), transparent 43%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #0c2442, #061326);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.22), 0 0 30px rgba(22, 128, 255, .1);
}
.detail-art {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(35, 192, 255, .22), transparent 63%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #0c2746, #061326);
}
.detail-art img {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 16px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(28, 156, 255, .14));
  transition: transform .35s ease, filter .35s ease;
}
.detail-art:hover img {
  transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.025);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 25px rgba(28, 183, 255, .25));
}
.detail-note {
  border-color: rgba(81, 188, 255, .2);
  background: rgba(19, 70, 115, .15);
}
.stock {
  border-radius: 9px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035);
}
.stock.sold, .card-tag.sold { color: #ff9ba8; }

/* Discord floating control */
.discord-float-button {
  border: 1px solid rgba(186, 229, 255, .45);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #6477ff, #3f58d8);
  box-shadow: 0 9px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 0 0 4px rgba(52, 123, 255, .08), 0 0 25px rgba(60, 119, 255, .22);
  transition: transform .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease, filter .22s ease;
}
.discord-float-button:hover, .discord-float.open .discord-float-button {
  transform: scale(1.055);
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.38), 0 0 0 5px rgba(52, 123, 255, .12), 0 0 34px rgba(60, 142, 255, .45);
}
.discord-popover {
  border-color: rgba(86, 160, 255, .62);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(13, 36, 69, .98), rgba(5, 16, 35, .98));
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 30px rgba(34, 120, 255, .15);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}
.discord-join {
  border: 1px solid rgba(187, 209, 255, .32);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(71, 90, 255, .22);
  transition: filter .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.discord-join:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  filter: brightness(1.12);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(71, 90, 255, .32);
}

/* Sign-in dialog and form fields */
.auth-overlay {
  background: rgba(1, 7, 19, .82);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(130%);
}
.auth-box {
  max-width: 445px;
  padding: 34px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  border-color: rgba(80, 218, 255, .43);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 0%, rgba(37, 119, 255, .18), transparent 47%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #0d2748, #061326 78%);
  box-shadow: 0 28px 85px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 42px rgba(23, 135, 255, .16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(192, 244, 255, .065);
  animation: modalIn .28s ease-out both;
}
.auth-close {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  right: 13px;
  top: 13px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: rgba(53, 130, 215, .1);
  transition: color .2s ease, background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
}
.auth-close:hover {
  color: #8ff1ff;
  border-color: rgba(83, 221, 255, .36);
  background: rgba(34, 140, 255, .18);
  transform: rotate(4deg);
}
.auth-box h2 { letter-spacing: -.8px; }
.auth-box input {
  min-height: 47px;
  margin: 13px 0;
  padding: 13px 15px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(90, 182, 255, .27);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(3, 15, 32, .82);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, background .2s ease;
}
.auth-box input:focus {
  border-color: #54e3ff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 142, 255, .13), 0 0 23px rgba(45, 179, 255, .08);
  background: rgba(4, 21, 44, .98);
}
.auth-box input::placeholder { color: #789ab9; }
.auth-box form .btn { width: 100%; min-height: 47px; margin-top: 10px; }
.auth-switch, .auth-forgot {
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: color .2s ease, background .2s ease;
}
.auth-switch:hover, .auth-forgot:hover {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(48, 143, 255, .1);
}
.auth-message { padding: 0 2px; }

/* Footer + links */
footer { border-color: rgba(73, 174, 255, .18); }
.footer-brand span { color: #5de4ff; text-shadow: 0 0 17px rgba(60, 201, 255, .19); }
.footer-links a { transition: color .2s ease, text-shadow .2s ease; }
.footer-links a:hover { color: #82efff; text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(55, 195, 255, .3); }
.copyright { border-color: rgba(73, 174, 255, .15); }

/* Responsive refinements to keep every control inside its layout */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-layout { gap: 30px; }
  .detail-card { align-items: stretch; }
  .detail-info { min-width: 0; }

}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  html { scroll-padding-top: 120px; }

    min-height: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

    gap: 9px;
    padding: 12px 0;
  }
  .brand { justify-content: center; width: 100%; }
  .brand img { width: 108px; height: 42px; }
  .nav-links { width: 100%; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; }

  .hero { padding-top: 34px; }
  .hero h1 { letter-spacing: -2px; }
  .featured { border-radius: 21px; }
  .section-head { gap: 14px; }
  .section-head > .btn { min-height: 40px; }
  .shop-tools { gap: 10px; }

  .filter { flex: 1 1 auto; padding: 10px 9px; }
  .sort-select { min-height: 40px; }
  .card-body { padding: 14px; }
  .card-desc { min-height: 58px; }
  .card-bottom { align-items: center; }
  .view-arrow { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
  .detail-card { padding: 13px; gap: 22px; }
  .detail-art { min-height: 250px; }
  .detail-art img { height: 235px; }
  .auth-box { max-height: calc(100dvh - 28px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 28px 22px; }
}
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .container { width: 91%; }
  .sale { gap: 6px; letter-spacing: .65px; font-size: 9px; }
  .nav-link { padding: 8px 7px; font-size: 10px; }
  .nav-links .btn { padding: 8px 9px; font-size: 10px; }
  .products { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
  .card-art { height: 165px; }
  .card-img { width: 77%; height: 135px; }
  .card-body { padding: 11px; }
  .card h3 { font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

  .card-bottom { gap: 5px; padding-top: 10px; }
  .view-arrow { width: 31px; height: 31px; border-radius: 10px; }
  .card-tag { max-width: calc(100% - 15px); white-space: nowrap; }
  .card-tag.popular { top: 42px; right: 8px; }
  .featured-image { height: 220px; }
  .featured-image img { height: 205px; }
  .featured-info { align-items: center; }
  .featured-info h2 { font-size: 18px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .featured-price { font-size: 19px; }
  .discord-float { left: 7px; }
  .discord-float-button { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 13px; }
  .discord-popover { left: 48px; width: min(265px, calc(100vw - 64px)); }
  .trust-item { padding: 19px; }
  .discord-banner { padding: 22px; }
}
@media (max-width: 350px) {
  .nav-links { gap: 3px; }
  .nav-link { padding: 7px 5px; font-size: 9px; }
  .nav-links .btn { padding: 7px; font-size: 9px; }
  .products { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .card-art { height: 215px; }
  .card-img { height: 177px; }
  .card h3 { font-size: 15px; }
  .card-desc { min-height: 0; font-size: 10px; }
  .card-tag.popular { top: 10px; right: 8px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: .01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    transition-duration: .01ms !important;
  }
}


/* Final responsive safety pass */
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .nav-inner { gap: 8px; }
  .nav-links { gap: 4px; }
  .nav-link { padding: 8px 7px; font-size: 10px; }

}
@media (max-width: 430px) {

  .hero h1 { letter-spacing: -2px; }

  .card-body { padding: 12px; }
  .card-desc { min-height: 54px; }
  .auth-box { padding: 27px 20px; }
  .detail-card { padding: 13px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
}

/* Discord invite preview card — inspired by the supplied reference */
.discord-float{left:8px!important;right:auto!important;top:50%;z-index:150}

.discord-popover{left:63px!important;right:auto!important;top:50%;width:min(340px,calc(100vw - 90px));padding:0!important;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d7d7d7!important;border-radius:16px!important;background:#292a2e!important;color:#f4f4f5!important;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #0003!important;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-8px,-50%);transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s,visibility .2s}
.discord-float:hover .discord-popover,.discord-float:focus-within .discord-popover,.discord-float.open .discord-popover{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate(0,-50%)}
.discord-preview-banner{height:108px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:5px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#7048bd 0%,#a86ce2 35%,#f1a16e 70%,#273f67 100%);color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #0008;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.discord-preview-banner span{font-size:32px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-1.5px;position:relative}

.discord-preview-banner small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:900;position:relative}
.discord-preview-content{position:relative;padding:54px 17px 17px}
.discord-server-img{position:absolute;top:-35px;left:16px;width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:18px;border:5px solid #292a2e;background:#292a2e;object-fit:cover}
.discord-server-name{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.discord-status-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#c9cbd0;font-size:12px}

.discord-live{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;background:#23a55a;margin-right:2px}
.discord-description{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#c9cbd0!important;margin:14px 0 17px}
.discord-join{min-height:41px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:7px;background:#248e52!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;transition:background .2s}
.discord-join:hover{background:#1f9d59!important;transform:none}
.discord-close{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:9px;top:8px;width:25px;height:25px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#202126aa;color:#e5e7eb;font-size:21px;line-height:1;display:grid;place-items:center}
.discord-close:hover{background:#15161a;color:#fff}
@media(max-width:620px){.discord-float{left:7px!important;right:auto!important}.discord-popover{width:min(320px,calc(100vw - 76px));left:51px!important}.discord-preview-banner{height:96px}.discord-preview-content{padding:50px 13px 13px}.discord-server-img{left:13px;width:64px;height:64px}.discord-server-name{font-size:15px}}


/* Screenshot-inspired storefront layout: light cards + continuous promo ticker */
.sale{height:36px!important;min-height:36px!important;overflow:hidden!important;display:block!important;padding:0!important;white-space:nowrap!important;background:#171717!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid #d9a15a!important;letter-spacing:1px!important}

/* Final polish: make the Discord server card touch its launcher and keep X reliable. */
#discordFloat {
  width: 54px !important;
  gap: 0 !important;
}
#discordFloat .discord-float-button {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 152 !important;
  width: 54px !important;
  height: 54px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  flex: 0 0 54px !important;
  border-radius: 15px !important;
}
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):hover .discord-float-button,
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):focus-within .discord-float-button,
#discordFloat.open:not(.dismissed) .discord-float-button {
  border-top-right-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 0 !important;
  transform: none !important;
}
#discordFloat .discord-popover {
  left: 54px !important;
  right: auto !important;
  top: 50% !important;
  width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 74px)) !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border-left: 0 !important;
  border-top-left-radius: 0 !important;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0 !important;
  transform: translate(-8px, -50%) !important;
}
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):hover .discord-popover,
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):focus-within .discord-popover,
#discordFloat.open:not(.dismissed) .discord-popover {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  transform: translate(0, -50%) !important;
}
#discordFloat.dismissed .discord-popover,
#discordFloat.dismissed:hover .discord-popover,
#discordFloat.dismissed:focus-within .discord-popover,
#discordFloat.dismissed.open .discord-popover {
  opacity: 0 !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  transform: translate(-8px, -50%) !important;
}
#discordFloat .discord-close {
  z-index: 5 !important;
  display: grid !important;
  place-items: center !important;
  width: 27px !important;
  height: 27px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

.card-img{filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 9px #0004)!important}

.auth-overlay{background:#29292388!important}.auth-box{background:#fffdf7!important}.auth-box h2{color:#292923!important}.auth-box>p{color:#69685f!important}.auth-switch,.auth-forgot{color:#168bb7!important}

<style>
/* Bright shop look inspired by the reference screenshot */
:root {
  --bg: #f4f0e8; --panel: #ffffff; --panel2: #f7f4ee;
  --text: #201f20; --muted: #66636a; --line: rgba(37, 44, 54, .15);
}
body {
  color: #201f20 !important;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 5% 0%, rgba(83,229,255,.18), transparent 34%),
              radial-gradient(ellipse at 95% 12%, rgba(255,135,79,.13), transparent 30%),
              linear-gradient(145deg, #f7f4ee, #ece8df 60%, #f8f6f1) !important;
  background-attachment: fixed;
}
body::before { opacity: .12 !important; }
nav { background: rgba(255,253,248,.94) !important; border-bottom-color: rgba(30,50,65,.12) !important; box-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(30,40,50,.08) !important; }
.nav-link { color: #45444a !important; }
.nav-link:hover, .nav-link.active, .nav-link[href="#home"] { color: #078dbd !important; background: rgba(83,229,255,.16) !important; border-color: rgba(30,170,220,.16) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
.sale { color: #fff !important; background: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,#17232c 0 85px,#ff743d 85px 150px,#20252b 150px 235px) !important; border-bottom-color: #ff743d !important; }
.card, .detail-card, .about-panel, .trust-item { color: #201f20 !important; background: #fffdf9 !important; border-color: rgba(36,44,54,.17) !important; box-shadow: 0 7px 22px rgba(40,35,25,.09) !important; }
.card-art { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#d7e8ef,#f4d9c9 52%,#e3e9e5) !important; }
.featured { background: linear-gradient(145deg,#fffdf9,#e8f6fa) !important; border-color: rgba(35,170,210,.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 16px 45px rgba(35,50,60,.12) !important; }
.featured-image, .detail-art { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(83,229,255,.2),transparent 66%),linear-gradient(145deg,#e8f2f5,#f5e8dc) !important; }
.featured-info h2, .card h3, .detail-info h1, .about-panel h1, .section-head h2 { color: #25232a; }
.card-desc, .detail-info>p, .about-copy p, .about-lead, .trust-item p, .footer-note { color: #66636a !important; }
.search-wrap input, .sort-select { color: #24242a !important; background: #fff !important; border-color: rgba(40,55,65,.2) !important; }
.filter { color: #46454b !important; background: #fff !important; border-color: rgba(40,55,65,.17) !important; }
.filter:hover, .filter.active { color: #086f98 !important; background: #e6faff !important; border-color: #55d8f5 !important; }
.footer-brand, .copyright { color: #333139 !important; }
.discord-banner { color: #fff !important; }
.card-tag.popular { color: #fff !important; border-color: #ff743d !important; background: #f36b2f !important; }
.card-tag:not(.popular), .featured-label { color: #fff !important; background: #f36b2f !important; border-color: #ff9a67 !important; }
.stock { color: #16734a !important; background: #e8fff2 !important; border-color: #b4e9cb !important; }
.stock.sold { color: #b62d38 !important; background: #fff0f0 !important; border-color: #f1c3c7 !important; }
/* Product-name colors requested for each cape */
.cape-name { transition: color .2s ease; }
.cape-name--builder { color: #c58a4b !important; }
.cape-name--copper { color: #248b58 !important; }
.cape-name--experience { color: #53e5ff !important; }
.cape-name--aurora { color: #53e5ff !important; }
.cape-name--menace { color: #ff454f !important; }
.cape-name--moonlight { color: #75bfff !important; }
.cape-name--crafter { color: #d7a8ff !important; }
.cape-name--purple-heart { color: #b995ff !important; }
/* The promo strip remains the first element at the top of every page. */
.sale { position: relative; z-index: 60; }
.products-heading { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.about-page { padding-top: 34px; padding-bottom: 75px; }
.about-panel {
  max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(25px, 5vw, 54px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(78, 200, 255, .33); border-radius: 24px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 0%, rgba(20,117,255,.17), transparent 42%),
              linear-gradient(145deg, #0c2442, #061326);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.22), 0 0 30px rgba(22,128,255,.1);
}
.about-panel h1 { font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 60px); letter-spacing: -2px; margin: 16px 0 12px; }
.about-lead { color: #d8f7ff; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.about-copy { display: grid; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 28px; }
.about-copy p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2; }
@media(max-width:620px) { .about-panel { padding: 25px 20px; } .about-copy p { font-size: 13px; } }
</style>


<style id="mc-store-final-polish">
/* Final polish: dark readable text, cape-specific name colours, and stable image colours. */
body, body p, .hero-copy>p, .section-head p, .card-desc, .detail-info>p, .about-copy p, .about-lead, .trust-item p, .discord-banner p, .footer-note, .footer-links a, .copyright, .results-line, .muted { color:#242424 !important; }
.hero h1, .section-head h2, .featured-info h2, .card h3, .detail-info h1, .about-panel h1, .trust-item h3, .footer-brand, .discord-server-name, .discord-description { color:#171717 !important; }
.gradient { background:none !important; color:#171717 !important; animation:none !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#171717 !important; }
.cape-name { color:#171717 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor !important; background:none !important; animation:none !important; }
.cape-name--builder { color:#9a5b22 !important; }
.cape-name--copper { color:#176b3b !important; }
.cape-name--menace { color:#d92532 !important; }
.cape-name--aurora { color:#10a9c8 !important; }

.cape-name--moonlight { color:#2d6b9d !important; }
.cape-name--purple-heart { color:#7145a5 !important; }
/* Keep the cape artwork itself unchanged; only the display name receives its accent colour. */
.card-img, .featured-image img, .detail-art img { filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 9px #0003) !important; }
.nav-link[href="#home"], .nav-link[href="#home"].active { color:#16afd2 !important; }

.featured-price, .card-price, .detail-price, .showcase-price { color:#171717 !important; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; } }
</style>

<style id="mc-capes-reference-finish">
/* Final reference-matched light storefront theme. This block intentionally comes last. */
:root {
  --cyan: #39c8f2;
  --cyan-light: #d9f7ff;
  --blue: #168fc8;
  --orange: #f16c20;
  --orange-light: #ff9b36;
  --bg: #f5f2eb;
  --panel: #fffefa;
  --panel2: #f6f2e9;
  --text: #24211e;
  --muted: #625e57;
  --line: rgba(65, 55, 40, .18);
  --green: #237a43;
  --red: #b72e2b;
}
html { scroll-padding-top: 95px; scrollbar-color: #c9c2b4 #f5f2eb; }
body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: #24211e !important;
  background: #f4f1e9 !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif;
}
body::before { display: none !important; }
.container { width: min(1185px, 88%); margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }

/* Orange and charcoal diagonal offer ticker */
.sale {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 70 !important;
  display: block !important;
  height: 34px !important;
  min-height: 34px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  background: #202020 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dc782c !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px !important;
}
.sale-track { display: flex !important; width: max-content; height: 34px; animation: mcPromoScroll 29s linear infinite; }
.sale-group { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: stretch; height: 34px; }
.sale-group span, .sale-group b {
  height: 34px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 25px;
  clip-path: polygon(13% 0,100% 0,87% 100%,0 100%);
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 1000;
  font-style: italic;
  letter-spacing: .6px;
}
.sale-group span { color: #fff !important; background: #262626 !important; }
.sale-group b { color: #23160c !important; background: linear-gradient(110deg,#ffae24,#f46b1e) !important; }
.sale span:first-child, .sale .sale-cyan, .sale .sale-star { color: #fff !important; }
@keyframes mcPromoScroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
.sale:hover .sale-track { animation-play-state: paused; }

/* White floating navigation capsule */
nav {
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  z-index: 60 !important;
  padding: 8px 0 0 !important;
  background: rgba(244,241,233,.96) !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
}
.nav-inner {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 19px !important;
  width: min(990px, 93%) !important;
  min-height: 64px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 0 17px !important;
  border: 1px solid #ded7ca !important;
  border-radius: 15px !important;
  background: #fffefa !important;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(48,39,23,.08) !important;
}
.brand { display: flex !important; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.brand img { width: 142px !important; height: 48px !important; object-fit: contain; filter: none !important; }
.brand-fallback { color: #168fc8 !important; font-size: 23px !important; font-weight: 1000; }
.nav-links {
  display: flex !important;
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 7px !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  min-width: 0;
}
.nav-link {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 9px 13px !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  border-radius: 22px !important;
  color: #3e3b36 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
}
.nav-link:hover { color: #087da6 !important; background: #e7f8fd !important; border-color: #bde9f3 !important; }
.nav-link.active, .nav-link[href="#home"].active {
  color: #10242a !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#7be2ff,#35c5f0) !important;
  border-color: #178cb8 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #13799e !important;
}
.nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.currency-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  min-height: 31px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  color: #fff;
  background: #282725;
  border: 1px solid #504c45;
  border-radius: 18px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 900;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.currency-flag { font-size: 12px; }
.currency-chevron { color: #e7e0d5; font-size: 10px; margin-left: 1px; }
.account-icon {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 35px;
  height: 35px;
  flex: 0 0 35px;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: 1px solid #1b89b4 !important;
  border-radius: 11px !important;
  color: #05202b !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#70dfff,#2abdea) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #13779d !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform .18s ease, filter .18s ease;
}
.account-icon:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.05); }
.account-icon svg, .view-arrow svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.account-icon svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }
.user-label { max-width: 110px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: #333 !important; font-size: 9px !important; }

/* Product-first landing page like the reference screenshot */
.hero { display: none !important; }
#shop.section { width: min(1195px, 88%) !important; padding: 18px 0 55px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; }
#shop .section-head, #shop .shop-tools, #shop .results-line { display: none !important; }
.products { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) !important; gap: 22px !important; align-items: stretch; }
.card {
  min-width: 0 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  border: 1px solid #d3cbbc !important;
  border-radius: 13px !important;
  background: #fffefa !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(50,42,29,.12) !important;
  animation: none !important;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease !important;
}
.card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) !important; border-color: #b7dfe8 !important; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(50,42,29,.14) !important; }
.card::before { display: none !important; }
.card > a:first-child { display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.card-art {
  position: relative !important;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  height: 190px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #dcd6c8 !important;
}
.card-art::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  inset: -9px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%,#f7d17a 0,transparent 43%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 68%,#72906d 0,transparent 55%), linear-gradient(135deg,#777e76,#d5a06c 48%,#eddfb8);
  filter: blur(3px) saturate(1.13);
  transform: scale(1.04);
}
.card:nth-child(6n+1) .card-art::before { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 42%,#fff0b2 0,transparent 30%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 68%,#678564 0,transparent 48%),linear-gradient(135deg,#737a67,#c58b55 51%,#e5d5ad); }
.card:nth-child(6n+2) .card-art::before { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 25% 35%,#ffb31e 0,transparent 38%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 68%,#7c0e20 0,transparent 48%),linear-gradient(135deg,#63181b,#ef4925 55%,#ffbd47); }
.card:nth-child(6n+3) .card-art::before { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 40%,#183d78 0,transparent 40%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 72% 55%,#527e9a 0,transparent 45%),linear-gradient(135deg,#133050,#28748c 55%,#b0d2d6); }
.card:nth-child(6n+4) .card-art::before { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%,#1a3470 0,transparent 42%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 67%,#e7a7ff 0,transparent 38%),linear-gradient(135deg,#253a6b,#617ac6 55%,#d7c8ef); }
.card:nth-child(6n+5) .card-art::before { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%,#ffe87c 0,transparent 42%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 70%,#43965c 0,transparent 42%),linear-gradient(135deg,#a34d1e,#f0a23c 55%,#e9d08a); }
.card:nth-child(6n) .card-art::before { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 35%,#c96025 0,transparent 38%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 70%,#3e9b78 0,transparent 44%),linear-gradient(135deg,#31584e,#5c9b83 55%,#e0c39b); }
.card-art::after { content:""; position:absolute; z-index:0; bottom:17px; width:100px; height:15px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(0,0,0,.32) !important; filter:blur(10px); }
.card-img {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 1 !important;
  display: block;
  width: 79% !important;
  height: 175px !important;
  max-width: 92%;

}

<style id="mc-store-final-requested-polish">
/* Final requested interactions and the light reference-matched shop layout. */
:root { --orange:#f16c20; --blue:#1698c7; --text:#24211e; }

/* Account and currency controls stay hidden in the compact navbar. */

/* Home is a clickable blue sticker; Shop/About/Endorsements share the same hover motion. */

/* Show the cape spotlight only on Home, and keep the entire shop controls visible on Shop. */

.shop-tools .filter.active, .shop-tools .filter:hover { color:#092431 !important; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#84eaff,#31c0ea) !important; border-color:#178db7 !important; box-shadow:0 2px 0 #157799 !important; transform:translateY(-1px) !important; }
.shop-tools .sort-select { min-height:42px !important; padding:10px 12px !important; background:#fffefa !important; color:#282520 !important; border:1px solid #d7d0c3 !important; border-radius:10px !important; font-size:11px !important; }
.sort-select option { background:#fffefa !important; color:#24211e !important; }

/* Home showcase: large cape on the right, title and purchase details on the left. */

.showcase-price { color:#211f1b !important; font-size:clamp(28px,3.3vw,40px) !important; font-weight:1000 !important; margin-top:22px !important; }

#featured .featured-image img { width:91% !important; height:94% !important; max-height:440px !important; filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 12px #0003) !important; animation:floatCape 3.6s ease-in-out infinite !important; }
#featured .featured-image:after { bottom:15px !important; background:#0002 !important; }

/* Product tags: orange sale label plus a stock status in the top-right corner. */
.card-tag { display:block !important; }
.card-tag.sale-tag { color:#fff !important; background:#f16c20 !important; border:1px solid #ff9d68 !important; }
.card-tag.popular.stock-tag { display:block !important; left:auto !important; right:10px !important; color:#282620 !important; background:#fffefa !important; border:1px solid #d9d1c4 !important; }
.card-tag.sold:not(.sale-tag) { color:#fff !important; background:#746d63 !important; border-color:#746d63 !important; }

.card-img { transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),filter .32s ease !important; }
.card:hover .card-img { transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.065) rotate(-1deg) !important; }

/* Discord card: blue banner and a clean Discord-like charcoal panel. */
.discord-float { left:8px !important; right:auto !important; z-index:150 !important; }
.discord-float-button { background:linear-gradient(145deg,#697cff,#4c58e8) !important; border:1px solid #bfcaff !important; box-shadow:0 8px 24px #4d5ce544 !important; }
.discord-popover { background:#2b2d31 !important; color:#f2f3f5 !important; border:1px solid #3c3f45 !important; border-radius:16px !important; box-shadow:0 20px 55px #0004 !important; }
.discord-preview-banner { height:118px !important; background:linear-gradient(125deg,#152c76 0%,#2864d9 44%,#42a8ef 100%) !important; color:#fff !important; }
.discord-preview-banner:before { background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%,#ffffff22,transparent 28%),linear-gradient(135deg,#102a6a33,transparent 55%),repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#ffffff08 0 13px,transparent 13px 27px) !important; }
.discord-preview-banner span { font-size:31px !important; letter-spacing:-1.4px !important; text-shadow:0 2px 7px #07143199 !important; }
.discord-preview-banner b { color:#91e9ff !important; }
.discord-preview-banner small { font-size:8px !important; letter-spacing:1.8px !important; }

.discord-count { color:#e3e6eb !important; background:#373a40 !important; border-color:#464950 !important; }
.discord-join { min-height:40px !important; background:#249f59 !important; color:#fff !important; border:0 !important; border-radius:6px !important; font-size:13px !important; font-weight:800 !important; box-shadow:none !important; }
.discord-join:hover { background:#1f8d4f !important; transform:translateY(-1px) !important; }
.discord-close { background:#474a50cc !important; color:#f2f3f5 !important; }

/* About Us: complete black text on the light panel. */
.about-panel { background:#fffefa !important; color:#151515 !important; border-color:#d6cfc1 !important; box-shadow:0 8px 28px #50442a13 !important; }

.endorsements-page { padding-top:28px; padding-bottom:72px; }

/* Scroll reveal animation: items appear as they enter the viewport. */
@keyframes mcRevealIn { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(18px) scale(.99); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1); } }
body.mc-reveal-ready .reveal-on-scroll:not(.is-visible) { opacity:0 !important; transform:translateY(18px) !important; }

<style id="mc-store-reference-final">

#discordFloat {

  transition:background .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, border-radius .25s ease !important;

#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):hover .discord-float-button,

}
#discordFloat .discord-popover {

  width:min(340px,calc(100vw - 74px)) !important;

  border-bottom-left-radius:0 !important;
  background:#292a2e !important;

<style id="mc-store-cape-tilt-spin-final">

  <section class="redeem-guide" id="howToRedeem" aria-labelledby="redeemGuideTitle">
    <header class="redeem-section-heading">
      <h2 id="redeemGuideTitle">How to Redeem</h2>
      <p>Join Discord for help or follow the steps below.</p>
    </header>
    <div class="redeem-guide-card">
      <div class="redeem-discord-help">
        <div class="redeem-discord-mark" aria-hidden="true">◎</div>
        <h3>Need help with a cape code?</h3>
        <p>Join the Discord community for ordering questions, cape details, and redemption help.</p>
        <a class="btn" href="https://discord.gg/PSCBpZbNWb" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Join Discord ↗</a>
      </div>
      <div class="redeem-steps">
        <h3>How do I redeem the cape?</h3>
        <ol>
          <li><span>1</span><p>Open the official <a href="https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/redeem" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Minecraft redeem page</a>.</p></li>
          <li><span>2</span><p>Sign in to the Microsoft account linked to your Minecraft profile and enter your cape code.</p></li>
          <li><span>3</span><p>Confirm the code and wait for the redemption to finish.</p></li>
          <li><span>4</span><p>Launch Minecraft Bedrock Edition and equip the cape from the Dressing Room, if it is available there.</p></li>
          <li><span>5</span><p>If it does not appear straight away, sign out and back in, then allow some time for your account to sync.</p></li>
          <li><span>6</span><p>For Java Edition, open the Minecraft Launcher, go to <strong>Skins</strong>, choose <strong>Edit</strong> and select your cape.</p></li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    </div>

    <section class="redeem-faq" aria-labelledby="redeemFaqTitle">
      <header class="redeem-section-heading redeem-faq-heading">
        <h2 id="redeemFaqTitle">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
        <p>Find answers to common questions about cape redemption and ordering.</p>
      </header>
      <div class="redeem-faq-list">
        <details class="redeem-faq-item">
          <summary>How do I redeem capes for Java &amp; Bedrock Edition? <span class="redeem-most-common">MOST COMMON</span><span class="redeem-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary>
          <p>Redeem the code on the official Minecraft website while signed into the correct Microsoft account. Then check Bedrock's Dressing Room and Java Edition's Skin settings to equip the cape where it is available.</p>
        </details>
        <details class="redeem-faq-item">
          <summary>Are capes for both Bedrock and Java Edition? <span class="redeem-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary>
          <p>Check the individual cape listing for its edition details. Once a cape is redeemed, you may need to equip it separately in Bedrock and Java.</p>
        </details>
        <details class="redeem-faq-item">
          <summary>What payment methods do you accept? <span class="redeem-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary>
          <p>Online checkout is not connected on this page. Contact CHEAPEST Cape Codes through Discord to confirm the current order process, final price, and available payment options before paying.</p>
        </details>
        <details class="redeem-faq-item">
          <summary>I'm a parent. What exactly am I purchasing? <span class="redeem-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary>
          <p>A cape code is a digital code intended to unlock a cosmetic item on the Minecraft account used during redemption. Check the product listing and confirm the delivery details with CHEAPEST Cape Codes before placing an order.</p>
        </details>
        <details class="redeem-faq-item">
          <summary>What do I do if my order hasn't processed/cancelled? <span class="redeem-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary>
          <p>Contact CHEAPEST Cape Codes through Discord and explain what happened. Share only the order information needed to identify the issue; never send your Microsoft password or account security codes.</p>
        </details>
        <details class="redeem-faq-item">
          <summary>Some capes are much more expensive than others, why is this? <span class="redeem-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary>
          <p>Prices can differ by cape, availability, and market demand. Review the displayed price and confirm the final cost before completing an order.</p>
        </details>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="redeem-customer-note" aria-labelledby="redeemCustomersTitle">

        <h2 id="redeemCustomersTitle">Our Customers</h2>

</footer>

    <p class="auth-message" id="authMessage" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
