</div>

<script>
"use strict";

const DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/PSCBpZbNWb";
const DISCORD_INVITE_CODE = "PSCBpZbNWb";

// Do not let History API restrictions on local file previews stop the shop UI.
function safeReplaceState(url) {
  try {
    history.replaceState(null, "", url);
  } catch (error) {
    console.info("Address-bar update skipped in this preview environment.");
  }
}

const capes = [
  {
    id: "moonlight",
    name: "Moonlight Cape",
    textureStem: "moonlightcapetexture",
    elytraTextureStem: "moonlightcapetexture",
    price: 55,
    originalPrice: 85,
    bulkOffer: "Bulk purchases: $45 per cape.",
    stock: true,
    onSale: true,
    image: "moonlightcape.gg",
    showcaseImage: "moonlightcape.gg",
    productImage: "capes 3D/moonlightcape3D",
    detailImage: "moonlightcape.gg",
    fallbackImage: "media/moonlight-cape.png",
    sceneBackground: "moonvillage.png",
    description: "A moonlight-inspired design for your Minecraft cape collection.",
    label: ""
  },
  {
    id: "crafter",
    name: "Crafter Cape",
    textureStem: "craftercapetexture",
    price: 200,
    originalPrice: 250,
    bulkOffer: "Bulk purchases: $180 per cape.",
    stock: true,
    onSale: true,
    image: "media/crafter-cape.png",
    showcaseImage: "media/crafter-cape.png",
    productImage: "capes 3D/craftercape3D",
    sceneBackground: "disert.png",
    description: "A crafting-inspired design for Minecraft fans and cape collectors.",
    label: ""
  },
  {
    id: "experience",
    name: "Experience Cape",
    textureStem: "experiencecapetexture",
    price: 30,
    originalPrice: 50,
    stock: true,
    onSale: true,
    image: "media/experience-cape.png",
    showcaseImage: "media/experience-cape.png",
    productImage: "capes 3D/experiencecape3D",
    sceneBackground: "villageheader.png",
    description: "The Experience cape is available as a Minecraft cape code. Contact the Discord community for ordering details.",
    label: ""
  }
];

// Only the requested three capes appear in the shop, Home showcase, and recommendations.
const productOrder = ["moonlight", "crafter", "experience"];
const productCapes = productOrder
  .map(id => capes.find(cape => cape.id === id))
  .filter(Boolean);
const featuredCapes = productCapes.slice(); // Show all nine cape artworks in the homepage spotlight.

// Fill the large homepage showcase with all nine cape images. The filenames are
// kept exactly as supplied; path recovery checks the repository tree and common folders.
function renderMcShowcaseGallery() {
  const gallery = document.getElementById("mcShowcaseGallery");
  if (!gallery) return;
  gallery.innerHTML = featuredCapes.map((cape, index) => {
    const imagePath = cape.showcaseImage || cape.image;
    const filename = String(imagePath || "").split("/").pop();
    const shortName = String(cape.name).replace(/ Cape Code$/, "").replace(/ Cape$/, "");
    return `
      <button class="mc-showcase-cape-tile${index === 0 ? " active" : ""}"
        type="button" data-feature-index="${index}" aria-pressed="${index === 0 ? "true" : "false"}"
        aria-label="Show ${escapeHTML(cape.name)} details" title="${escapeHTML(cape.name)}"
        onclick="showFeatured(${index});restartFeaturedTimer();return false">
        <span class="mc-showcase-cape-art">
          <img src="${escapeHTML(imagePath)}" data-image-file="${escapeHTML(filename)}"
            data-original-src="${escapeHTML(imagePath)}" data-fallback-image="${escapeHTML(cape.fallbackImage || cape.image || imagePath)}"
            alt="${escapeHTML(cape.name)}" loading="eager" decoding="async"
            onerror="mcStoreShowcaseImageError(this)">
          <span class="mc-showcase-missing-label" aria-hidden="true">Image unavailable</span>
        </span>
        <span class="mc-showcase-cape-name">${escapeHTML(shortName)}</span>
      </button>`;
  }).join("");
}

document.getElementById("year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

let currentFilter = "all";
let featuredIndex = 0;
let featuredTimer = null;
// Each showcase change gets its own token so a slow image-recovery request for an older cape
// can never replace or hide the cape that is currently being shown.
let featuredImageRequestToken = 0;

function formatPrice(cape) {
  if (!cape.stock) return "Unavailable";
  if (typeof cape.price !== "number") return "Ask on Discord";
  return "$" + (Number.isInteger(cape.price) ? cape.price.toFixed(0) : cape.price.toFixed(2));
}

function escapeHTML(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    "&":"&amp;",
    "<":"&lt;",
    ">":"&gt;",
    '"':"&quot;",
    "'":"&#39;"
  })[character]);
}

/*
 * Resolve image assets even when the files live several folders below the repository root.
 * GitHub Pages does not expose folder listings, so the public GitHub tree API is used once,
 * only when a normal image URL fails. All capes share the same cached index.
 */
const mcStoreNestedAssetIndexApi = "https://api.github.com/repos/mc-store/MC_STORE";
let mcStoreNestedAssetIndexPromise = null;

function mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl() {
  try {
    const canonical = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]');
    return new URL(".", canonical && canonical.href ? canonical.href : window.location.href).href;
  } catch (_) {
    return window.location.href;
  }
}

function mcStoreNestedAssetUrl(repoPath) {
  const safePath = String(repoPath || "").split("/").map(part => encodeURIComponent(part)).join("/");
  return new URL(safePath, mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl()).href;
}

function mcStoreNestedAssetIndex() {
  if (!mcStoreNestedAssetIndexPromise) {
    mcStoreNestedAssetIndexPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const headers = { "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json" };
        const repoResponse = await fetch(mcStoreNestedAssetIndexApi, { headers, cache: "force-cache" });
        if (!repoResponse.ok) return null;
        const repo = await repoResponse.json();
        const branch = repo.default_branch || "main";
        const treeUrl = mcStoreNestedAssetIndexApi + "/git/trees/" + encodeURIComponent(branch) + "?recursive=1";
        const treeResponse = await fetch(treeUrl, { headers, cache: "force-cache" });
        if (!treeResponse.ok) return null;
        const treeData = await treeResponse.json();
        if (!Array.isArray(treeData.tree)) return null;

        const byName = new Map();
        for (const node of treeData.tree) {
          if (!node || node.type !== "blob" || !node.path) continue;
          const basename = node.path.split("/").pop().toLowerCase();
          if (!byName.has(basename)) byName.set(basename, []);
          byName.get(basename).push(node.path);
        }
        // Prefer shorter paths when the same named image appears more than once.
        for (const paths of byName.values()) {
          paths.sort((a, b) => a.split("/").length - b.split("/").length || a.localeCompare(b));
        }
        return { byName, paths: treeData.tree.filter(node => node && node.type === "blob").map(node => node.path) };
      } catch (_) {
        // A private repository, API rate limit, or offline browser falls back to normal paths.
        return null;
      }
    })();
  }
  return mcStoreNestedAssetIndexPromise;
}

function mcStoreAssetBasename(value) {
  let clean = String(value || "").split(/[?#]/)[0].replace(/\\/g, "/");
  clean = clean.split("/").pop() || "";
  try { clean = decodeURIComponent(clean); } catch (_) {}
  return clean;
}

function mcStoreAssetFilenameOptions(values) {
  const extensions = [".png", ".webp", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".avif", ".gif", ".bmp"];
  const options = [];
  for (const value of values || []) {
    const basename = mcStoreAssetBasename(value);
    if (!basename) continue;
    if (!options.includes(basename)) options.push(basename);
    // Names ending in .gg are project asset stems, not actual browser image extensions.
    // Try the literal name first, then common image extensions (e.g. moonlightcape.gg.png).
    if (!/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(basename) || /\.gg$/i.test(basename)) {
      for (const extension of extensions) {
        if (!options.includes(basename + extension)) options.push(basename + extension);
      }
    }
  }
  return options;
}

async function findMcStoreNestedAsset(values, excludedUrls = []) {
  const index = await mcStoreNestedAssetIndex();
  if (!index) return { indexAvailable: false, url: null };
  const excluded = new Set((excludedUrls || []).map(url => String(url || "").split("?")[0]));
  for (const filename of mcStoreAssetFilenameOptions(values)) {
    const matches = index.byName.get(filename.toLowerCase()) || [];
    for (const path of matches) {
      const url = mcStoreNestedAssetUrl(path);
      if (!excluded.has(url.split("?")[0])) return { indexAvailable: true, url, path };
    }
  }
  return { indexAvailable: true, url: null };
}

// Resolve cape artwork by filename, not by assuming a single folder. The known PNGs may be
// committed in the repository root, media/, images/, assets/, or a nested cape-art folder.
// If the GitHub tree lookup does not find a path, continue probing likely folders instead of
// hiding the image prematurely. If a dedicated product render is unavailable, use its artwork.
async function handleCapeCardImageError(img) {
  if (!img || img.dataset.mcHandlingImageError === "1") return;
  img.dataset.mcHandlingImageError = "1";

  let failed = [];
  try { failed = JSON.parse(img.dataset.mcFailedAssetUrls || "[]"); } catch (_) {}
  const currentUrl = String(img.currentSrc || img.src || "").split("?")[0];
  if (currentUrl && !failed.includes(currentUrl)) failed.push(currentUrl);
  img.dataset.mcFailedAssetUrls = JSON.stringify(failed);

  const sourceName = img.dataset.imageFile || img.dataset.originalSrc || img.src || "";
  const fallbackName = img.dataset.fallbackImage || "";
  const nameCandidates = [sourceName, fallbackName];

  // First check the repository's real file tree. That discovers the exact path even if
  // a user put the PNGs in a folder nested inside another folder (with case-sensitive names).
  if (img.dataset.mcRepoLookupDone !== "1") {
    img.dataset.mcRepoLookupDone = "1";
    const resolved = await findMcStoreNestedAsset(nameCandidates, failed);
    if (resolved.url) {
      img.dataset.mcHandlingImageError = "0";
      img.dataset.mcRepoResolvedPath = resolved.path;
      img.src = resolved.url;
      return;
    }
    if (resolved.indexAvailable) {
      // A successful GitHub tree lookup is not enough to conclude that the image is missing.
      // The tree may be stale, incomplete, or affected by API limits. Keep trying the direct
      // root/media/images paths below before hiding the artwork.
      img.dataset.mcRepoIndexChecked = "1";
    }
  }

  // Offline/API-unavailable fallback: check a short list of common root and nested folders
  // together, so the display isn't delayed by serial 404 attempts.
  const primary = mcStoreAssetBasename(sourceName).replace(/\.[^.]*$/, "");
  const fallback = mcStoreAssetBasename(fallbackName).replace(/\.[^.]*$/, "");
  const productFolders = ["capes 3D/", "Capes 3D/", "capes3D/", "capes-3D/", "3D/", "3d/"];
  const artworkFolders = [
    "", "media/", "Media/", "images/", "Images/", "assets/", "Assets/", "capes images/", "Capes Images/",
    "cape images/", "Cape Images/", "capes image/", "Capes Image/", "capes-images/", "Capes-Images/",
    "capes/", "Capes/", "media/capes/", "images/capes/", "assets/capes/", "media/images/", "assets/images/",
    "media/capes images/", "media/Capes Images/", "assets/capes images/", "assets/Capes Images/",
    "images/capes images/", "images/Capes Images/", "images/capes 3D/", "assets/capes 3D/", "public/images/", "static/images/"
  ];
  const prefer3d = /cape3d$/i.test(primary);
  const folders = prefer3d ? [...productFolders, ...artworkFolders] : [...artworkFolders, ...productFolders];
  const names = [...new Set([primary, fallback].filter(Boolean))];
  const extensions = [".png", ".PNG", ".webp", ".WEBP", ".jpg", ".JPG", ".jpeg", ".JPEG", ""];
  const candidates = [];
  for (const name of names) {
    for (const folder of folders) {
      for (const extension of extensions) {
        const candidate = folder + name + extension;
        try {
          const url = new URL(candidate, mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl()).href;
          if (!failed.includes(url) && !candidates.includes(url)) candidates.push(url);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
  }
  const probed = await Promise.all(candidates.slice(0, 120).map(url => new Promise(resolve => {
    const test = new Image();
    test.onload = () => resolve(url);
    test.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    test.src = url;
  })));
  const found = probed.find(Boolean);
  if (found) {
    img.dataset.mcHandlingImageError = "0";
    img.src = found;
    return;
  }

  img.hidden = true;
  img.removeAttribute("alt");
  img.dataset.mcHandlingImageError = "0";
}

// Reliable fallback for images shown in the new top showcase. If images are in a
// different folder, the GitHub repository tree can identify the exact committed path.
async function mcStoreShowcaseImageError(img) {
  if (!img || img.dataset.mcStoreShowcaseBusy === "1") return;
  img.dataset.mcStoreShowcaseBusy = "1";
  let failed = [];
  try { failed = JSON.parse(img.dataset.mcStoreShowcaseFailed || "[]"); } catch (_) {}
  const current = String(img.currentSrc || img.src || "").split("?")[0];
  if (current && !failed.includes(current)) failed.push(current);
  img.dataset.mcStoreShowcaseFailed = JSON.stringify(failed);

  const filename = mcStoreAssetBasename(img.dataset.imageFile || img.dataset.originalSrc || img.src);
  let found = null;
  try {
    const resolved = await findMcStoreNestedAsset([filename], failed);
    if (resolved && resolved.url) found = resolved.url;
  } catch (_) {}

  if (!found && filename) {
    const dot = filename.lastIndexOf(".");
    const stem = dot > 0 ? filename.slice(0, dot) : filename;
    const originalExt = dot > 0 ? filename.slice(dot) : ".png";
    const fileNames = [...new Set([filename, stem + ".png", stem + ".PNG", stem + ".webp", stem + ".WEBP", stem + ".jpg", stem + ".jpeg"])];
    const folders = ["media/", "", "Media/", "images/", "Images/", "assets/", "Assets/", "capes/", "Capes/", "capes images/", "Capes Images/", "public/images/", "static/images/", "capes 3D/"];
    const candidates = [];
    for (const folder of folders) {
      for (const name of fileNames) {
        try {
          const folderPath = folder.split("/").filter(Boolean).map(encodeURIComponent).join("/");
          const relative = (folderPath ? folderPath + "/" : "") + name.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/");
          const url = new URL(relative, mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl()).href;
          if (!failed.includes(url) && !candidates.includes(url)) candidates.push(url);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    const probes = await Promise.all(candidates.map(url => new Promise(resolve => {
      const test = new Image();
      test.onload = () => resolve(url);
      test.onerror = () => resolve(null);
      test.src = url;
    })));
    found = probes.find(Boolean) || null;
  }

  img.dataset.mcStoreShowcaseBusy = "0";
  if (found) {
    img.src = found;
    return;
  }
  // Avoid showing a browser's broken-image icon; the tile displays a clear fallback label.
  img.hidden = true;
  const art = img.closest(".mc-showcase-cape-art");
  if (art) art.classList.add("is-missing");
}

function capeTitleMarkup(cape, title = cape.name) {
  // Keep "Cape" (and any trailing wording such as "Code") black; colour only the cape name.
  const capeSuffix = title.indexOf(" Cape");
  const splitAt = capeSuffix >= 0 ? capeSuffix : title.length;
  const accent = title.slice(0, splitAt);
  const rest = title.slice(splitAt);
  return `<span class="cape-name-accent cape-name-accent--${cape.id}">${escapeHTML(accent)}</span><span class="cape-name-base">${escapeHTML(rest)}</span>`;
}

function capeCard(cape) {
  const price = formatPrice(cape);
  const isFeatured = cape.id === "moonlight";
  const tag = cape.onSale ? "ON SALE 🔥" : (cape.stock ? "IN STOCK" : "NOT IN STOCK");

  return `
    <article class="card ${isFeatured ? "featured-card" : ""}">
      <a href="#cape/${encodeURIComponent(cape.id)}"
         aria-label="View ${escapeHTML(cape.name)} details"
         onclick="openCape('${cape.id}');return false">
        <div class="card-art">
          ${cape.sceneBackground ? `<img class="card-scene-bg" src="${escapeHTML(cape.sceneBackground)}" data-original-src="${escapeHTML(cape.sceneBackground)}" data-image-file="${escapeHTML(cape.sceneBackground.split('/').pop())}" alt="" aria-hidden="true" loading="lazy" onerror="handleCapeCardImageError(this)">` : ""}
          <span class="card-tag ${cape.stock ? "" : "sold"} ${cape.onSale ? "sale-tag" : ""}">${tag}</span>
          ${cape.onSale && cape.stock ? `<span class="card-tag popular stock-tag">IN STOCK</span>` : (cape.label ? `<span class="card-tag popular">${escapeHTML(cape.label)}</span>` : "")}
          <img class="card-img"
               src="${escapeHTML(cape.productImage || cape.image)}"
               data-original-src="${escapeHTML(cape.productImage || cape.image)}"
               data-image-file="${escapeHTML((cape.productImage || cape.image).split('/').pop())}"
               data-fallback-image="${escapeHTML(cape.fallbackImage || cape.showcaseImage || cape.image)}"
               data-fallback-alt="${escapeHTML(cape.name)}"
               alt="${escapeHTML(cape.name)}"
               loading="lazy"
               onerror="handleCapeCardImageError(this)">
        </div>
      </a>

      <div class="card-body">
        <a href="#cape/${encodeURIComponent(cape.id)}"
           onclick="openCape('${cape.id}');return false">
          <h3 class="cape-name cape-name--${cape.id}">${capeTitleMarkup(cape)}</h3>
        </a>
        <p class="card-desc">${escapeHTML(cape.description)}${cape.bulkOffer ? `<br><strong class="card-bulk-offer">${escapeHTML(cape.bulkOffer)}</strong>` : ""}</p>
        <div class="card-bottom">
          <div class="card-price ${cape.stock ? "" : "unavailable"}">
            ${price}
            ${cape.onSale && typeof cape.originalPrice === "number" ? `<s class="card-price-original">${formatPrice({...cape, price:cape.originalPrice, onSale:false})}</s>` : ""}
            <small>${cape.onSale ? "On sale" : (typeof cape.price === "number" ? "Listed price" : (cape.stock ? "Price on Discord" : "Currently unavailable"))}</small>
          </div>
          <a class="view-arrow"
             href="#cape/${encodeURIComponent(cape.id)}"
             aria-label="View ${escapeHTML(cape.name)} details"
             title="View cape details"
             onclick="openCape('${cape.id}');return false">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  `;
}

function renderProducts() {
  const query = document.getElementById("searchInput").value.trim().toLowerCase();
  let list = productCapes.filter(cape => {
    const matchesQuery =
      cape.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      cape.description.toLowerCase().includes(query);

    const matchesFilter =
      currentFilter === "all" ||
      (currentFilter === "available" && cape.stock) ||
      (currentFilter === "onsale" && Boolean(cape.onSale)) ||
      (currentFilter === "unavailable" && !cape.stock);

    return matchesQuery && matchesFilter;
  });

  // Keep capes in the fixed productCapes catalog order; there is no manual sorting control.

  const homePage = document.getElementById("homePage");
  const detailsPage = document.getElementById("details");
  const isHomePreview = homePage && !homePage.classList.contains("shop-only") &&
    homePage.style.display !== "none" && detailsPage &&
    (detailsPage.style.display === "none" || getComputedStyle(detailsPage).display === "none");
  const visibleList = isHomePreview ? list.slice(0, productCapes.length) : list;
  document.getElementById("products").innerHTML = visibleList.map(capeCard).join("");
  document.getElementById("resultsLine").textContent = isHomePreview
    ? `Showing ${visibleList.length} featured capes`
    : `Showing ${list.length} of ${productCapes.length} capes`;
  document.getElementById("emptyState").hidden = visibleList.length !== 0;
}

document.getElementById("searchInput").addEventListener("input", renderProducts);

document.querySelectorAll("[data-filter]").forEach(button => {
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    currentFilter = button.dataset.filter;

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-filter]").forEach(item => {
      item.classList.toggle("active", item === button);
    });

    renderProducts();
  });
});

async function recoverFeaturedCapeImage(img, cape, requestToken) {
  if (!img || requestToken !== featuredImageRequestToken) return;

  let failed = [];
  try { failed = JSON.parse(img.dataset.mcFeaturedFailedUrls || "[]"); } catch (_) {}
  const currentUrl = String(img.currentSrc || img.src || "").split("?")[0];
  if (currentUrl && !failed.includes(currentUrl)) failed.push(currentUrl);
  img.dataset.mcFeaturedFailedUrls = JSON.stringify(failed);

  const filename = mcStoreAssetBasename(cape.showcaseImage || cape.image || "");
  let discoveredUrl = null;
  try {
    const resolved = await findMcStoreNestedAsset([filename], failed);
    if (resolved && resolved.url) discoveredUrl = resolved.url;
  } catch (_) {}
  if (requestToken !== featuredImageRequestToken) return;

  const dot = filename.lastIndexOf(".");
  const stem = dot > 0 ? filename.slice(0, dot) : filename;
  const names = [...new Set([
    filename, stem + ".png", stem + ".PNG", stem + ".webp", stem + ".WEBP",
    stem + ".jpg", stem + ".JPG", stem + ".jpeg", stem + ".JPEG"
  ].filter(Boolean))];
  const folders = [
    "media/", "", "Media/", "images/", "Images/", "assets/", "Assets/",
    "capes/", "Capes/", "capes images/", "Capes Images/", "cape images/",
    "Cape Images/", "media/capes/", "images/capes/", "assets/capes/",
    "public/images/", "static/images/", "capes 3D/"
  ];
  const candidates = [];
  if (discoveredUrl && !failed.includes(discoveredUrl.split("?")[0])) candidates.push(discoveredUrl);
  for (const folder of folders) {
    for (const name of names) {
      try {
        const folderPath = folder.split("/").filter(Boolean).map(encodeURIComponent).join("/");
        const encodedName = name.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/");
        const relative = (folderPath ? folderPath + "/" : "") + encodedName;
        const url = new URL(relative, mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl()).href;
        if (!failed.includes(url.split("?")[0]) && !candidates.includes(url)) candidates.push(url);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  const probes = await Promise.all(candidates.slice(0, 140).map(url => new Promise(resolve => {
    const test = new Image();
    test.onload = () => resolve(url);
    test.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    test.src = url;
  })));
  if (requestToken !== featuredImageRequestToken) return;

  const found = probes.find(Boolean);
  if (found) {
    img.hidden = false;
    img.removeAttribute("hidden");
    img.style.removeProperty("display");
    img.src = found;
    img.dataset.mcFeaturedResolvedUrl = found;
  } else {
    // It is hidden only for this cape. showFeatured() always unhides/reset state on the next swap.
    img.hidden = true;
  }
}

function showFeatured(index) {
  featuredIndex = (index + featuredCapes.length) % featuredCapes.length;
  const cape = featuredCapes[featuredIndex];
  const requestToken = ++featuredImageRequestToken;

  const featuredImage = document.getElementById("featuredImage");
  const nextShowcaseImage = cape.showcaseImage || cape.image;
  const nextShowcaseURL = new URL(nextShowcaseImage, document.baseURI).href;

  // IMPORTANT: a previous missing image must never leave the shared showcase <img> hidden.
  featuredImage.hidden = false;
  featuredImage.removeAttribute("hidden");
  featuredImage.style.removeProperty("display");
  featuredImage.dataset.mcFeaturedRequestToken = String(requestToken);
  featuredImage.dataset.mcFeaturedFailedUrls = "[]";
  featuredImage.dataset.mcFeaturedResolvedUrl = "";
  // Reset the product-card resolver state as the same <img> is reused for all nine capes.
  featuredImage.dataset.mcHandlingImageError = "0";
  featuredImage.dataset.mcRepoLookupDone = "0";
  featuredImage.dataset.mcFailedAssetUrls = "[]";
  featuredImage.alt = cape.name;
  featuredImage.dataset.imageFile = String(nextShowcaseImage).split("/").pop();
  featuredImage.dataset.originalSrc = nextShowcaseImage;
  featuredImage.dataset.fallbackImage = cape.image || "";
  featuredImage.onerror = function () {
    if (requestToken !== featuredImageRequestToken) return;
    recoverFeaturedCapeImage(this, cape, requestToken);
  };

  // The very first cape is shown immediately and upright on refresh; only later cape changes spin.
  const hasShownInitialCape = featuredImage.dataset.mcHasPaintedFirstCape === "1";
  featuredImage.classList.remove("cape-spin", "is-spinning", "spin-in", "mc-store-spin-now");
  featuredImage.dataset.capeSpinTarget = nextShowcaseURL;
  const currentShowcaseURL = new URL(featuredImage.currentSrc || featuredImage.src, document.baseURI).href;
  if (currentShowcaseURL !== nextShowcaseURL || !featuredImage.complete || featuredImage.naturalWidth === 0) {
    featuredImage.src = nextShowcaseImage;
  }
  featuredImage.dataset.mcHasPaintedFirstCape = "1";
  if (hasShownInitialCape) {
    void featuredImage.offsetWidth;
    featuredImage.classList.add("mc-store-spin-now");
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (requestToken === featuredImageRequestToken) featuredImage.classList.remove("mc-store-spin-now");
    }, 125);
  }

  const featuredName = document.getElementById("featuredName");
  featuredName.innerHTML = cape.id === "builder"
    ? '<span class="cape-name-base">The </span><span class="cape-name-accent cape-name-accent--builder">Builder</span><br><span class="cape-name-base">Cape Code</span>'
    : capeTitleMarkup(cape);
  featuredName.className = "cape-name cape-name--" + cape.id;
  document.getElementById("featuredDescription").textContent = cape.description;
  document.getElementById("featuredPrice").innerHTML =
    `${formatPrice(cape)}${cape.onSale && typeof cape.originalPrice === "number" ? `<s class="featured-original-price">${formatPrice({...cape, price:cape.originalPrice, onSale:false})}</s>` : ""}<small>${cape.onSale ? "On sale 🔥" : (typeof cape.price === "number" ? "Listed price" : (cape.stock ? "Price on Discord" : "Currently unavailable"))}</small>`;

  // Animate the featured cape details without exposing manual slide controls.
  const showcaseInfo = [
    featuredName,
    document.getElementById("featuredDescription"),
    document.getElementById("featuredPrice"),
    document.querySelector(".cape-showcase-copy .hero-actions")
  ].filter(Boolean);
  showcaseInfo.forEach((element, order) => {
    element.classList.remove("mc-showcase-info-enter");
    element.style.setProperty("--mc-showcase-delay", `${order * 35}ms`);
    void element.offsetWidth;
    element.classList.add("mc-showcase-info-enter");
  });

  document.getElementById("featuredView").onclick = () => openCape(cape.id);

  // Keep the hidden artwork preloader in sync; the visible cape advances automatically.
  document.querySelectorAll("#mcShowcaseGallery .mc-showcase-cape-tile").forEach((tile, i) => {
    const active = i === featuredIndex;
    tile.classList.toggle("active", active);
    tile.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
  });
}

function restartFeaturedTimer() {
  clearInterval(featuredTimer);
  // Automatically feature the next cape every five seconds on desktop and mobile.
  featuredTimer = setInterval(() => {
    showFeatured((featuredIndex + 1) % featuredCapes.length);
  }, 5000);
}

function renderRecommendations(currentCape) {
  let others = productCapes.filter(cape => cape.id !== currentCape.id);
  others.sort((a,b) => Number(b.stock) - Number(a.stock));
  document.getElementById("recommendedProducts").innerHTML =
    others.slice(0,4).map(capeCard).join("");
}

function showHome(sectionId = "home") {
  document.getElementById("homePage").style.display = "block";
  document.getElementById("homePage").classList.toggle("shop-only", sectionId === "shop");
  if (sectionId === "home") {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById("searchInput");
    const sortSelect = document.getElementById("sortSelect");
    if (searchInput) searchInput.value = "";
    if (sortSelect) sortSelect.value = "default";
    currentFilter = "all";
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-filter]").forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.filter === "all");
    });
  }
  document.getElementById("details").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("aboutPage").hidden = true;
  document.getElementById("endorsementsPage").hidden = true;
  document.getElementById("footerInfoPage").hidden = true;
  document.getElementById("not-found").style.display = "none";
  document.title = "CHEAPEST Cape Codes | Minecraft Cape Shop";

  safeReplaceState(window.location.pathname + window.location.search);

  document.querySelectorAll(".nav-link").forEach(link => link.classList.remove("active"));

  const navLink = document.querySelector(
    sectionId === "shop" ? 'a[href="#shop"]' :
    sectionId === "about" ? 'a[href="#about"]' :
    sectionId === "endorsements" ? 'a[href="#endorsements"]' :
    'a[href="#home"]'
  );
  if (navLink) navLink.classList.add("active");
  if (typeof renderProducts === "function") renderProducts();

  const target = sectionId === "home"
    ? document.getElementById("home")
    : (document.getElementById(sectionId) || document.getElementById("shop"));
  requestAnimationFrame(() => target.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"}));
}

  }, 90);
}

function openCape(id) {
  const cape = capes.find(item => item.id === id);

  document.getElementById("homePage").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("details").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("aboutPage").hidden = true;
  document.getElementById("endorsementsPage").hidden = true;
  document.getElementById("footerInfoPage").hidden = true;
  document.getElementById("homePage").classList.remove("shop-only");
  document.getElementById("not-found").style.display = "none";

  if (!cape) {
    document.getElementById("not-found").style.display = "block";
    safeReplaceState("#cape/" + encodeURIComponent(id));
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById("details").style.display = "block";
  document.title = cape.name + " | CHEAPEST Cape Codes";

  const price = formatPrice(cape);
  const availabilityText = cape.stock
    ? "This cape is currently listed as available. Contact our team on Discord to confirm availability and ask about ordering."
    : "This cape is currently listed as unavailable. Contact our team on Discord if you want to ask about future availability.";

  document.getElementById("detailContent").innerHTML = `
    <article class="detail-card">
      <div class="detail-art">
        <img src="${cape.image}" alt="${escapeHTML(cape.name)}"
             onerror="this.style.opacity='.25'">
      </div>
      <div class="detail-info">
        <h1 class="cape-name cape-name--${cape.id}">${escapeHTML(cape.name)}</h1>
        <span class="stock ${cape.stock ? "" : "sold"}">
          ${cape.stock ? "✓ IN STOCK" : "✕ NOT IN STOCK"}
        </span>
        <p>${escapeHTML(cape.description)}</p>
        <div class="detail-price">
          ${price}
          <small>${cape.stock ? "Displayed shop price" : "Price not currently listed"}</small>
        </div>
        <div class="detail-actions">
          <a class="btn" href="${DISCORD_URL}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
            ${cape.stock ? "ASK TO ORDER ↗" : "ASK ABOUT AVAILABILITY ↗"}
          </a>
          <button class="btn btn-outline" type="button" onclick="showHome('home')">
            Back to Home
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="detail-note">${availabilityText} Confirm the final price and details with the team before purchasing.</div>
      </div>
    </article>
  `;

  renderRecommendations(cape);
  safeReplaceState("#cape/" + encodeURIComponent(cape.id));
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});
}

function handleRoute() {
  const match = window.location.hash.match(/^#cape\/(.+)$/);

  if (match) {
    let id = match[1];
    try { id = decodeURIComponent(id); } catch (error) {}
    openCape(id);
  } else if (window.location.hash === "#shop") {
    showHome("shop");
  } else if (window.location.hash === "#about") {
    showAbout();
  } else if (window.location.hash === "#endorsements") {
    showEndorsements();
  } else if (window.location.hash === "#reviews") {
    showReviews();
  } else if (window.location.hash.startsWith("#info/")) {
    showFooterInfo(window.location.hash.slice("#info/".length));
  } else {
    showHome("home");
  }
}

window.addEventListener("hashchange", handleRoute);

/* Discord preview: live server details, with a reliable close/reopen state. */
const discordFloat = document.getElementById("discordFloat");
const discordFloatButton = document.getElementById("discordFloatButton");
const discordClose = document.getElementById("discordClose");
let discordDismissedByUser = false;

function closeDiscordPreview({dismiss = false} = {}) {
  discordFloat.classList.remove("open");
  if (dismiss) {
    discordDismissedByUser = true;
    discordFloat.classList.add("dismissed");
  }
  discordFloatButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
}

function reopenDiscordPreview() {
  discordDismissedByUser = false;
  discordFloat.classList.remove("dismissed");
}

discordFloatButton.addEventListener("click", event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  event.stopPropagation();
  reopenDiscordPreview();
  const isOpen = discordFloat.classList.toggle("open");
  discordFloatButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
});

// Stop the X click before it can be treated as a click elsewhere on the page.
discordClose.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
  event.stopPropagation();
});
discordClose.addEventListener("click", event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  event.stopPropagation();
  closeDiscordPreview({dismiss: true});
});

// Keep the X dismissal in effect after the card collapses under the pointer.
// Moving back to the Discord launcher (or clicking it) explicitly re-enables it.
discordFloat.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
  if (!discordDismissedByUser) {
    discordFloat.classList.remove("dismissed");
  }
});
discordFloatButton.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => {
  if (discordDismissedByUser) reopenDiscordPreview();
});
discordFloatButton.addEventListener("focus", () => {
  if (discordDismissedByUser) reopenDiscordPreview();
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
  if (event.key === "Escape" && (discordFloat.classList.contains("open") || discordFloat.matches(":hover"))) {
    event.preventDefault();
    closeDiscordPreview({dismiss: true});
  }
});

document.addEventListener("click", event => {
  if (!discordFloat.contains(event.target)) {
    closeDiscordPreview();
  }
});

async function refreshDiscordInfo() {
  const connection = document.getElementById("discordConnection");

  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/${DISCORD_INVITE_CODE}?with_counts=true`,
      {cache:"no-store"}
    );

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Discord preview unavailable");

    const data = await response.json();

    if (data.guild && data.guild.name) {
      document.getElementById("discordServerName").textContent = data.guild.name;
    }

    document.getElementById("discordMembers").textContent =
      Number.isFinite(data.approximate_member_count)
        ? data.approximate_member_count.toLocaleString()
        : "—";

    document.getElementById("discordOnline").textContent =
      Number.isFinite(data.approximate_presence_count)
        ? data.approximate_presence_count.toLocaleString()
        : "";

    if (data.guild && data.guild.description) {
      document.getElementById("discordDescription").textContent = data.guild.description;
    }

    // Use the real Discord server icon/banner when the invite API exposes them.
    if (data.guild && data.guild.icon) {
      const icon = document.querySelector(".discord-server-img");
      icon.src = `https://cdn.discordapp.com/icons/${data.guild.id}/${data.guild.icon}.png?size=128`;
      icon.style.display = "block";
    }

    connection.textContent = data.guild && Array.isArray(data.guild.features) && data.guild.features.includes("COMMUNITY")
      ? "Discord community"
      : "Discord server";
  } catch (error) {
    document.getElementById("discordMembers").textContent = "—";
    connection.textContent = "Live Discord details unavailable";
    console.info("Discord preview could not be loaded.", error);
  }
}

const fallbackOverlay = document.getElementById("authOverlay");

const fallbackMessage = document.getElementById("authMessage");

function setFallbackAuthMode(create) {
  fallbackCreatingAccount = create;
  fallbackTitle.textContent = create ? "Create Account" : "Sign In";
  fallbackSubtitle.textContent = create
    ? "Create your account, then open the verification link sent to your email before signing in."
    : "Sign in to your account.";
  fallbackSubmit.textContent = create ? "Create Account" : "Sign In";
  fallbackPassword.autocomplete = create ? "new-password" : "current-password";
  fallbackSwitch.textContent = create
    ? "Already have an account? Sign In"
    : "Don't have an account? Create Account";
  fallbackForgot.hidden = create;
  fallbackMessage.textContent = "";
  fallbackMessage.className = "auth-message";
}
function setFallbackAuthMessage(text, type = "error") {
  fallbackMessage.textContent = text;
  fallbackMessage.className = "auth-message " + type;
}

fallbackOpenBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (!window.__mcStoreAuthReady) setFallbackAuthMode(false);
  fallbackOverlay.classList.add("open");
  document.body.classList.add("auth-page-open");
});
fallbackCloseBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { fallbackOverlay.classList.remove("open"); document.body.classList.remove("auth-page-open"); });
fallbackOverlay.addEventListener("click", event => {
  if (event.target === fallbackOverlay) { fallbackOverlay.classList.remove("open"); document.body.classList.remove("auth-page-open"); }
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
  if (event.key === "Escape") { fallbackOverlay.classList.remove("open"); document.body.classList.remove("auth-page-open"); }
});
fallbackSwitch.addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (!window.__mcStoreAuthReady) setFallbackAuthMode(!fallbackCreatingAccount);
});
fallbackForm.addEventListener("submit", event => {
  if (window.__mcStoreAuthReady) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  setFallbackAuthMessage("Authentication could not connect. Open the hosted website or use a local web server (localhost/HTTPS), and check your internet connection.");
});
fallbackForgot.addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (window.__mcStoreAuthReady) return;
  if (!fallbackEmail.value.trim()) {
    setFallbackAuthMessage("Enter your email address first.");
    fallbackEmail.focus();
    return;
  }
  setFallbackAuthMessage("Password reset needs the Firebase authentication module. Open the hosted website and check your internet connection.");
});
</script>

  message.textContent = text;
  message.className = "auth-message " + type;
}

function setMode(create) {
  creatingAccount = create;
  title.textContent = create ? "Create Account" : "Sign In";
  subtitle.textContent = create
    ? "Create your account, then open the verification link sent to your email before signing in."
    : "Sign in to your account.";
  submit.textContent = create ? "Create Account" : "Sign In";
  password.autocomplete = create ? "new-password" : "current-password";
  switchBtn.textContent = create
    ? "Already have an account? Sign In"
    : "Don't have an account? Create Account";
  forgotBtn.hidden = create;
  showMessage("");
}

openBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  setMode(false);
  overlay.classList.add("open");
  document.body.classList.add("auth-page-open");
});

document.getElementById("authCloseBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  overlay.classList.remove("open"); document.body.classList.remove("auth-page-open");
});

overlay.addEventListener("click", event => {
  if (event.target === overlay) { overlay.classList.remove("open"); document.body.classList.remove("auth-page-open"); }
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
  if (event.key === "Escape") { overlay.classList.remove("open"); document.body.classList.remove("auth-page-open"); }
});

switchBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setMode(!creatingAccount));

form.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
  event.preventDefault();

  submit.disabled = true;
  submit.textContent = "Please wait...";
  showMessage("");

  try {
    if (creatingAccount) {
      const credential = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
        auth,
        email.value.trim(),
        password.value
      );

      try {
        await sendEmailVerification(credential.user);
      } catch (verificationError) {
        await signOut(auth);
        throw verificationError;
      }

      await signOut(auth);
      showMessage("Verification email sent. Open the link in your inbox or Spam/Junk folder, then return here and sign in.");
    } else {
      const credential = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(
        auth,
        email.value.trim(),
        password.value
      );

      await reload(credential.user);

      if (!credential.user.emailVerified) {
        await signOut(auth);
        showMessage("Your email is not verified yet. Open the verification link in your inbox or Spam/Junk folder, then try signing in again.", "error");
        return;
      }

      showMessage("Signed in successfully.");
      setTimeout(() => overlay.classList.remove("open"), 700);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    const errors = {
      "auth/email-already-in-use": "This email already has an account. Please sign in.",
      "auth/invalid-email": "Please enter a valid email address.",
      "auth/weak-password": "Choose a password with at least 6 characters.",
      "auth/invalid-credential": "Email or password is incorrect.",
      "auth/user-not-found": "No account was found for this email.",
      "auth/too-many-requests": "Too many attempts. Try again later.",
      "auth/network-request-failed": "Network error. Check your internet connection.",
      "auth/operation-not-allowed": "Enable Email/Password in Firebase Authentication.",
      "auth/unauthorized-domain": "Add your website domain to Firebase Authorized domains.",
      "auth/quota-exceeded": "The email sending limit has been reached. Try again later."
    };

    showMessage(
      errors[error.code] || "Something went wrong. Check Firebase settings and try again.",
      "error"
    );
  } finally {
    submit.disabled = false;
    submit.textContent = creatingAccount ? "Create Account" : "Sign In";
  }
});

forgotBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!email.value.trim()) {
    showMessage("Enter your email address first.", "error");
    email.focus();
    return;
  }

  try {
    await sendPasswordResetEmail(auth, email.value.trim());
    showMessage("If an account exists, a password reset email will be sent.");
  } catch (error) {
    showMessage(
      error.code === "auth/unauthorized-domain"
        ? "Add your website domain to Firebase Authorized domains."
        : "Could not send the reset email. Please try again.",
      "error"
    );
  }
});

signOutBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try {
    await signOut(auth);
  } catch (error) {
    showMessage("Could not sign out. Please try again.", "error");
  }
});

onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
  openBtn.hidden = !!user;
  signOutBtn.hidden = !user;
  userLabel.hidden = !user;
  userLabel.textContent = user ? user.email : "";

  if (user) { overlay.classList.remove("open"); document.body.classList.remove("auth-page-open"); }
});
</script>

<script>
/* Reveal content on scroll and automatically observe newly-rendered product cards. */
(() => {
  const selectors = [
    '.cape-showcase-copy', '#featured', '#shop .section-head', '#shop .shop-tools',
    '#shop .card', '.detail-card', '.recommendations', '#aboutPage .about-panel',
    '#endorsementsPage .about-panel', '.endorsement-card',
    'footer.mc-footer', '.mc-footer .mc-footer-grid', '.mc-footer .mc-footer-brand',
    '.mc-footer .mc-footer-column', '.mc-footer .mc-footer-bottom'
  ];
  const collect = root => {
    const found = [];
    for (const selector of selectors) {
      if (root.matches && root.matches(selector)) found.push(root);
      if (root.querySelectorAll) found.push(...root.querySelectorAll(selector));
    }
    return [...new Set(found)];
  };

  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  let observer;
  try {
    observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -20px 0px' });
    document.body.classList.add('mc-reveal-ready');
    collect(document).forEach(element => {
      element.classList.add('reveal-on-scroll');
      observer.observe(element);
    });
    const products = document.getElementById('products');
    if (products && 'MutationObserver' in window) {
      const mutations = new MutationObserver(records => {
        records.forEach(record => record.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
          if (node.nodeType === 1) collect(node).forEach(element => {
            element.classList.add('reveal-on-scroll');
            observer.observe(element);
          });
        }));
      });
      mutations.observe(products, { childList: true });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    document.body.classList.remove('mc-reveal-ready');
    console.info('Scroll reveal animations are unavailable in this browser.', error);
  }
})();
</script>

<style id="mc-store-cape-angled-3d-fix">
/* Nearly upright cape with a very subtle side-facing 3D angle. */
#featured .featured-image { perspective: 1100px; }
#featured .featured-image img {
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  backface-visibility: visible;
  filter: drop-shadow(10px 14px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.20));
  animation: mcCapeAngledFloat 3.4s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}
@keyframes mcCapeAngledFloat {
  0%,100% { transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(0) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) scale(1); }
  50% { transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(-6px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) scale(1.012); }
}
@keyframes mcCapeAngledSpin {
  0% { opacity:.4; transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(2px) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) rotateY(0deg) scale(.92); }
  25% { opacity:1; transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(0) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) rotateY(90deg) scale(.98); }
  50% { opacity:1; transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(-1px) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) rotateY(180deg) scale(1.02); }
  75% { opacity:1; transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(0) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) rotateY(270deg) scale(1.01); }
  100% { opacity:1; transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(0) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) rotateY(360deg) scale(1); }
}
#featured .featured-image img.cape-spin,
#featured .featured-image img.is-spinning,

}
</style>



<style id="mc-store-upright-cape-final-fix">

  background:rgba(3,18,31,.72); color:#eafaff; font-size:10px; font-weight:900;

#details .detail-actions.storefront-detail-actions {

}

#details .storefront-add {

}

#details .storefront-buy {

}
#details .storefront-feedback {
  min-height: 20px;

}
body.mc-product-view .discord-float { left: auto; right: 18px; }
@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  #details.container { width: min(92%, 780px); padding-top: 20px; }
  #details .detail-card.detail-card--storefront { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: 32px; }

    const button = document.getElementById("capeLoadPlayer");
    const enteredName = String(input && input.value || "").trim();
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,16}$/.test(enteredName)) {
      if (status) { status.textContent = "Enter a valid Java username (1–16 letters, numbers, or underscores)."; status.classList.add("error"); }
      input?.focus();
      return;
    }
    if (!mcStoreViewer) {
      if (status) { status.textContent = "The 3D preview is still loading. Try again in a moment."; status.classList.add("error"); }
      return;
    }
    const viewer = mcStoreViewer;
    if (button) button.disabled = true;
    if (status) { status.textContent = `Finding Minecraft profile for ${enteredName}…`; status.classList.remove("error", "success"); }
    try {
      const username = await resolveCanonicalMinecraftUsername(enteredName);
      await viewer.loadSkin(`https://minotar.net/skin/${encodeURIComponent(username)}`);
      if (viewer !== mcStoreViewer) return;
      mcStorePlayerUsername = username;
      mcStorePlayerSkinLoaded = true;
      try { localStorage.setItem("mc_store_skin_username", username); } catch (_) {}
      const headImage = document.getElementById("capePreviewHead");
      if (headImage) headImage.src = `https://minotar.net/helm/${encodeURIComponent(username)}/40.png`;
      if (status) { status.textContent = `Skin loaded for ${username}. Your selected cape is equipped.`; status.classList.remove("error"); status.classList.add("success"); }
      // Loading a skin normally opens PLAYER mode, but keep ELYTRA selected if that
      // was the active choice so the wings and their cape texture stay visible.
      setPreviewMode(mcStorePreviewMode === "elytra" ? "elytra" : "player");
      setProductSearchOpen(false);
    } catch (error) {
      if (viewer !== mcStoreViewer) return;
      if (status) { status.textContent = error && error.message === "No Minecraft Java profile was found for that username." ? error.message : "Could not load that skin. Check the Java username and your internet connection."; status.classList.remove("success"); status.classList.add("error"); }
      console.warn("Minecraft Java skin could not be loaded.", error);
    } finally {
      if (button && viewer === mcStoreViewer) button.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  function wirePreviewControls() {
    document.querySelectorAll("#details .preview-tab[data-preview-mode]").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => setPreviewMode(button.dataset.previewMode));
    });
    document.getElementById("capeMotionToggle")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (mcStorePreviewMode === "cape") return;
      // Setting animation to null freezes the model at its current walking pose.
      setProductWalking(!mcStoreIsWalking);
    });
    const userbar = document.getElementById("capePreviewUserbar");
    const identityToggle = document.getElementById("capePreviewIdentityToggle");
    identityToggle?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      setProductSearchOpen(!(userbar && userbar.classList.contains("username-open")));
    });
    document.getElementById("capeLoadPlayer")?.addEventListener("click", loadPreviewPlayerSkin);
    document.getElementById("capePlayerUsername")?.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); loadPreviewPlayerSkin(); }
      if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); setProductSearchOpen(false); }
    });
    if (mcStoreSearchOutsideHandler) document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", mcStoreSearchOutsideHandler);
    mcStoreSearchOutsideHandler = event => {
      const activeBar = document.getElementById("capePreviewUserbar");
      if (activeBar && activeBar.classList.contains("username-open") && !activeBar.contains(event.target)) {
        setProductSearchOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", mcStoreSearchOutsideHandler);
  }

  async function init3DPreview(cape) {
    const stage = document.getElementById("capePreviewStage");
    const canvas = document.getElementById("capeSkinViewer");
    if (!stage || !canvas) return;
    stage.classList.remove("fallback-cape-only");
    // Most products may show their artwork while the 3D viewer initializes.
    // Moonlight must never show moonlightcape.gg as a temporary still picture:
    // its preview should be the real 3D cape from the first frame.
    const previewFallback = document.getElementById("capePreviewFallback");
    if (previewFallback) {
      previewFallback.alt = cape.name;
      if (cape.id === "moonlight") {
        previewFallback.removeAttribute("src");
        previewFallback.hidden = true;
      } else {
        previewFallback.hidden = false;
        previewFallback.src = detailsImage(cape);
      }
    }
    stage.classList.add("preview-loading");

    // All capes, including Menace, now use the interactive 3D cape viewer.

    if (!window.skinview3d || typeof window.skinview3d.SkinViewer !== "function") {
      stage.classList.remove("preview-loading");
      stage.classList.add("fallback-cape-only");
      return;
    }
    try {
      closeCurrentViewer();
      const width = Math.max(320, stage.clientWidth || 780);
      const height = Math.max(320, stage.clientHeight || 560);
      mcStoreViewer = new window.skinview3d.SkinViewer({canvas, width, height, pixelRatio: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2), enableControls: true});
      // Disable orbit controls so dragging never moves the camera/background.
      // The custom pointer handler below rotates only the cape model around its own vertical axis.
      mcStoreViewer.controls.enabled = false;
      mcStoreViewer.controls.enablePan = false;
      mcStoreViewer.controls.enableRotate = false;
      mcStoreViewer.controls.enableZoom = false; // Wheel scrolling remains normal page scrolling.
      mcStoreViewer.controls.enableDamping = false;
      mcStoreViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.x = 0;
      mcStoreViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.z = 0;
      // Keep the 3D cape still by default. Visitors can rotate it manually by dragging.
      mcStoreViewer.autoRotate = false;
      mcStoreViewer.controls.autoRotate = false;
      mcStoreViewer.zoom = 1.55;
      mcStoreViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.y = Math.PI;
      // Rotate the cape mesh itself. A vertical swipe is left to page scrolling on phones.
      if (canvas.__mcCapeDragCleanup) {
        try { canvas.__mcCapeDragCleanup(); } catch (_) {}
      }
      {
        let pointerState = null;
        const hint = stage.querySelector(".cape-rotate-hint");
        const onPointerDown = event => {
          if (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button !== 0) return;
          pointerState = {
            startX: event.clientX, startY: event.clientY,
            lastX: event.clientX, lastY: event.clientY,
            pointerId: event.pointerId, turning: false, scrolling: false
          };
        };
        const onPointerMove = event => {
          if (!pointerState || pointerState.pointerId !== event.pointerId || pointerState.scrolling) return;
          const totalX = event.clientX - pointerState.startX;
          const totalY = event.clientY - pointerState.startY;
          if (!pointerState.turning) {
            if (Math.abs(totalX) < 4 && Math.abs(totalY) < 4) return;
            // In standalone CAPE mode, vertical drags remain page scrolling; Player/Elytra are freely draggable.
            if (mcStorePreviewMode === "cape" && Math.abs(totalY) > Math.abs(totalX) * 1.12) {
              pointerState.scrolling = true;
              return;
            }
            pointerState.turning = true;
            stage.classList.add("mc-user-rotated");
            if (hint) hint.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
          }
          const deltaX = event.clientX - pointerState.lastX;
          const deltaY = event.clientY - pointerState.lastY;
          pointerState.lastX = event.clientX;
          pointerState.lastY = event.clientY;
          if (mcStoreViewer && mcStoreViewer.playerWrapper) {
            const wrapper = mcStoreViewer.playerWrapper;
            if (mcStorePreviewMode === "cape") {
              // Rotate the hidden player wrapper around the cape mesh's world-space
              // center. Compensating the wrapper position prevents the cape from
              // orbiting/sliding across the preview while it turns through 360°.
              const capeCenterObject = mcStoreViewer.playerObject && mcStoreViewer.playerObject.cape && mcStoreViewer.playerObject.cape.cape;
              const Vector3 = wrapper.position && wrapper.position.constructor;
              if (capeCenterObject && typeof capeCenterObject.getWorldPosition === "function" && typeof Vector3 === "function") {
                wrapper.updateMatrixWorld(true);
                const centerBefore = new Vector3();
                capeCenterObject.getWorldPosition(centerBefore);
                wrapper.rotation.y += deltaX * 0.012;
                wrapper.updateMatrixWorld(true);
                const centerAfter = new Vector3();
                capeCenterObject.getWorldPosition(centerAfter);
                wrapper.position.x += centerBefore.x - centerAfter.x;
                wrapper.position.y += centerBefore.y - centerAfter.y;
                wrapper.position.z += centerBefore.z - centerAfter.z;
                wrapper.updateMatrixWorld(true);
              } else {
                // Safe fallback for an unexpected viewer/library version.
                wrapper.rotation.y += deltaX * 0.012;
              }
            } else {
              // PLAYER and ELYTRA stay freely draggable in both axes.
              wrapper.rotation.y += deltaX * 0.012;
              // Match the cursor: moving upward tilts the player upward, not downward.
              wrapper.rotation.x = Math.max(-0.65, Math.min(0.65, wrapper.rotation.x + deltaY * 0.009));
              wrapper.rotation.z = 0;
            }
          }
          if (event.cancelable) event.preventDefault();
        };
        const onPointerUp = event => {
          if (pointerState && pointerState.pointerId === event.pointerId) {
            pointerState = null;
            try { if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
          }
        };
        canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, { passive: true });
        canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: false });
        canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp, { passive: true });
        canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", onPointerUp, { passive: true });
        canvas.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", onPointerUp, { passive: true });
        canvas.__mcCapeDragCleanup = () => {
          canvas.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
          canvas.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
          canvas.removeEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
          canvas.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onPointerUp);
          canvas.removeEventListener("lostpointercapture", onPointerUp);
        };
      }
      // Start on the standalone cape; the Java skin is loaded when a username is entered.
      mcStoreViewer.animation = null;
      if (mcStoreViewer.playerObject && mcStoreViewer.playerObject.skin) {
        mcStoreViewer.playerObject.skin.visible = false;
        mcStoreViewer.playerObject.backEquipment = "cape";
      }
      // Apply the selected mode as soon as SkinViewer exists, so CAPE/ELYTRA meshes
      // are not waiting for the remote username/skin request to finish.
      setPreviewMode(mcStorePreviewMode);
      // Load the dedicated Minecraft texture for the actual 3D cape cloth.
      // Moonlight exclusively uses moonlightcapetexture for both the 3D cape and Elytra;
      // moonlightcape.gg is catalogue artwork only and must never be used as a model texture.
      const textureStems = cape.id === "moonlight"
        ? ["moonlightcapetexture"]
        : [...new Set([cape.textureStem, cape.elytraTextureStem].filter(Boolean))];
      let textureUrl = null;
      for (const stem of textureStems) {
        textureUrl = await findCapeTexture(stem);
        if (textureUrl) break;
      }
      if (!textureUrl) {
        console.warn(`CHEAPEST Cape Codes: Minecraft cape texture not found for ${cape.name}. Expected ${textureStems.join(" or ")}.`);
        // Do not substitute Moonlight's flat display image for its Minecraft texture.
        if (cape.id !== "moonlight") textureUrl = cape.image || cape.showcaseImage;
      }

      const viewerForSkin = mcStoreViewer;
      // Load Steve in parallel, but NEVER hold back the 3D cape or Elytra while a skin
      // service is slow. Steve is the default model; a searched username is optional.
      const defaultSkinPromise = viewerForSkin.loadSkin(`https://minotar.net/skin/${encodeURIComponent(mcStorePlayerUsername || "Steve")}`)
        .then(() => {
          if (viewerForSkin !== mcStoreViewer) return;
          mcStorePlayerSkinLoaded = true;
          setPreviewMode(mcStorePreviewMode);
        })
        .catch(error => {
          if (viewerForSkin !== mcStoreViewer) return;
          // Keep the player mesh eligible to render in PLAYER/ELYTRA even if the external
          // default-skin service fails; do not require the user to enter a username first.
          mcStorePlayerSkinLoaded = true;
          setPreviewMode(mcStorePreviewMode);
          console.warn("CHEAPEST Cape Codes: default Steve skin did not load; keeping the 3D preview available.", error);
        });

      let capeLoad;
      if (textureUrl) {
        capeLoad = mcStoreViewer.loadCape(textureUrl);
      } else {
        capeLoad = Promise.reject(new Error("3D cape texture was not found"));
      }
      // Only the cape texture controls when the 3D preview becomes visible. Do not wait
      // for the skin URL: that network request previously left Moonlight stuck on artwork.
      const capeResults = await Promise.allSettled([capeLoad]);
      if (viewerForSkin !== mcStoreViewer) return;
      syncCapeTextureToModels();
      const capeLoadFailed = capeResults[0].status === "rejected";
      if (capeLoadFailed && cape.id !== "moonlight") {
        stage.classList.add("fallback-cape-only");
      } else if (capeLoadFailed && cape.id === "moonlight") {
        // Leave the 3D canvas in place instead of ever showing the flat Moonlight artwork.
        stage.classList.add("moonlight-texture-missing");
      }
      // Clear the loading state immediately after the 3D cape finishes (or fails),
      // independently of Steve/player skin loading.
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (document.getElementById("capePreviewStage") === stage) {
          stage.classList.remove("preview-loading");
        }
      }));
      if (mcStoreViewer) {
        setPreviewMode(mcStorePreviewMode);
        updateProductMotionButton();
        const resize = () => {
          if (!mcStoreViewer || !document.getElementById("capeSkinViewer")) return;
          const activeStage = document.getElementById("capePreviewStage");
          if (!activeStage || !activeStage.clientWidth) return;
          mcStoreViewer.width = activeStage.clientWidth;
          mcStoreViewer.height = activeStage.clientHeight;
        };
        if (window.ResizeObserver) {
          const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize);
          observer.observe(stage);
          stage.__mcResizeObserver = observer;
        } else window.addEventListener("resize", resize, {passive:true});
        resize();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      stage.classList.remove("preview-loading");
      stage.classList.add("fallback-cape-only");
      closeCurrentViewer();
      console.warn("3D cape preview couldn't start; showing the existing cape image instead.", error);
    }
  }

  // The original router may have rendered a product before this inline library was parsed.
  const initialRoute = window.location.hash.match(/^#cape\/(.+)$/);
  if (initialRoute && typeof handleRoute === "function") handleRoute();
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
    if (!window.location.hash.startsWith("#cape/")) {
      document.body.classList.remove("mc-product-view");
      closeCurrentViewer();
    }
  });
})();
</script>








<style id="mc-store-latest-requested-tweaks">

.cape-name-accent--menace { color: #d92532 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #d92532 !important; }
.cape-name-accent--moonlight { color: #2d6b9d !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #2d6b9d !important; }
.cape-name-accent--purple-heart { color: #7145a5 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #7145a5 !important; }
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  #details .storefront-detail-actions { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important; }
}
/* Final user-requested polish: remove quantity and preview overlays, keep the cape model still. */
#details .storefront-qty,

.cape-name-accent--copper { color:#27834b !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#27834b !important; }
.cape-name-accent--crafter { color:#8a5a2b !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#8a5a2b !important; }
.cape-name-accent--experience { color:#7545b4 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#7545b4 !important; }
.cape-name-accent--home { color:#2f8664 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#2f8664 !important; }
.cape-name-accent--menace { color:#d92532 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#d92532 !important; }
.cape-name-accent--moonlight { color:#2d6b9d !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#2d6b9d !important; }

</style>


<style id="mc-store-desktop-cape-animation-fix">
/* Make the showcase spin visible on PCs, including systems that request reduced motion. */
@keyframes mcCapeSwapZoom {
  0% { opacity: .45; transform: scale(.84); }
  58% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.035); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}
@keyframes mcStoreCapePcSpin {
  0% { opacity: .45; transform: perspective(1000px) scale(.82) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(-2deg); }
  22% { opacity: 1; transform: perspective(1000px) scale(.98) rotateY(78deg) rotateZ(1deg); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: perspective(1000px) scale(1.045) rotateY(180deg) rotateZ(0deg); }
  78% { opacity: 1; transform: perspective(1000px) scale(1.02) rotateY(282deg) rotateZ(-1deg); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: perspective(1000px) scale(1) rotateY(360deg) rotateZ(0deg); }
}
#featured .featured-image.cape-zoom-switch {
  animation: mcCapeSwapZoom 1.08s cubic-bezier(.2,.72,.24,1) both !important;
}
#featured .featured-image.cape-zoom-switch img {
  animation: mcStoreCapePcSpin 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1) both !important;
  transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
  transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
  backface-visibility: visible !important;
}
/* Keep the gentle idle float active on the featured cape between rotations. */
#featured .featured-image img {
  animation: mcCapeUprightFloat 3.4s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}
</style>


<style id="mc-store-requested-transition-animations">
/* Keep the cape gently floating between changes; spin 360 degrees once whenever a new cape is selected. */
@keyframes mcStoreCapeChangeSpin {
  0% { transform: perspective(1000px) translateY(0) rotateY(0deg) scale(.96); }
  100% { transform: perspective(1000px) translateY(0) rotateY(360deg) scale(1); }
}
#featured .featured-image img {
  animation: mcCapeUprightFloat 3.4s ease-in-out infinite !important;
  transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
  transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
  backface-visibility: visible !important;
  will-change: transform;
}
#featured .featured-image.cape-zoom-switch img,
#featured .featured-image img.cape-spin,
#featured .featured-image img.is-spinning,
#featured .featured-image img.spin-in {
  animation: mcStoreCapeChangeSpin .1s linear 1 both !important;
  transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
  transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
  backface-visibility: visible !important;
  will-change: transform;
}
#featured .featured-image {
  perspective: 1000px !important;
  perspective-origin: 50% 50% !important;
}

/* Promo strip: duplicate groups allow a seamless continuous move to the RIGHT. */
@keyframes mcStorePromoScrollRight {
  from { transform: translate3d(-50%, 0, 0); }
  to   { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
}
.sale .sale-track {
  animation: mcStorePromoScrollRight 50s linear infinite !important;
  animation-play-state: running !important;
  will-change: transform;
}
.sale:hover .sale-track,
.sale:focus-within .sale-track {
  animation-play-state: running !important;
}

/* Discord preview: slide smoothly out from the square on hover, focus, or tap. */
#discordFloat .discord-popover {
  opacity: 0 !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  transform: translate3d(-20px, -50%, 0) scale(.97) !important;
  transform-origin: left center !important;
  transition:
    opacity .46s ease,
    transform .62s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1),
    visibility 0s linear .62s !important;
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):hover .discord-popover,
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):focus-within .discord-popover,
#discordFloat.open:not(.dismissed) .discord-popover {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  transform: translate3d(0, -50%, 0) scale(1) !important;
  transition:
    opacity .46s ease,
    transform .62s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1),
    visibility 0s linear 0s !important;
}
#discordFloat .discord-float-button {
  transition: transform .3s ease, box-shadow .35s ease, border-radius .35s ease !important;
}
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):hover .discord-float-button,
#discordFloat:not(.dismissed):focus-within .discord-float-button,
#discordFloat.open:not(.dismissed) .discord-float-button {
  transform: translateX(1px) !important;
}

/* Keep the selected-cape spin quick and single-shot on desktop and mobile. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #featured .featured-image img {
    animation: mcCapeUprightFloat 3.4s ease-in-out infinite !important;
  }
  #featured .featured-image.cape-zoom-switch img,
  #featured .featured-image img.cape-spin,
  #featured .featured-image img.is-spinning,
  #featured .featured-image img.spin-in {
    animation: mcStoreCapeChangeSpin .1s linear 1 both !important;
  }
  .sale .sale-track {
    animation-duration: 50s !important;
    animation-iteration-count: infinite !important;
  }
}
</style>



<style id="mc-store-pure-cape-spin-no-zoom">
/* Pure 360-degree turn on each cape change: no zoom, scale, fade, or frame animation. */
@keyframes mcStoreCapePureSpin {
  from { transform: perspective(1100px) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) rotateY(0deg); }
  to   { transform: perspective(1100px) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) rotateY(360deg); }
}
#featured .featured-image.cape-zoom-switch { animation: none !important; }
#featured .featured-image img {
  transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
  transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
  backface-visibility: visible !important;
  transition: none !important;
}
#featured .featured-image img.cape-spin {
  animation: mcStoreCapePureSpin .1s linear 1 both !important;
  transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
  transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
  backface-visibility: visible !important;
  will-change: transform;
}
/* Use the same brief spin on desktop and mobile, including reduced-motion setups. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #featured .featured-image img.cape-spin { animation: mcStoreCapePureSpin .1s linear 1 both !important; }
}
</style>



<style id="mc-store-fast-product-entry-animation">
/* Fast, clean entrance whenever a cape detail page opens: slide in only, no zoom. */
@keyframes mcCapeDetailPreviewEnter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(-16px, 0, 0); }

<style id="mc-store-user-final-navigation-shop-about-polish">

<style id="mc-store-final-home-six-capes-and-animations">
/* Navigation: remove the underline completely; use a soft pill transition instead. */
nav .nav-link,
nav .nav-link:hover,
nav .nav-link:focus-visible,
nav .nav-link.active {
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border-bottom: 0 !important;
  transition: color .32s ease, background .32s ease, border-color .32s ease,
    box-shadow .32s ease, transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) !important;
}
nav .nav-link::after { content: none !important; display: none !important; }
nav .nav-link:hover,
nav .nav-link:focus-visible {
  color: #087da6 !important;
  background: #e7f8fd !important;
  border-color: #bde9f3 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(7,141,189,.10) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}
nav .nav-link.active {
  color: #062432 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #062432 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#62dcff,#28b9ef) !important;
  border: 1px solid #238ab2 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #147da2 !important;
}
nav .nav-link[href="#home"].active { color:#062432 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#062432 !important; }

/* Home preview: display exactly six product cards, then a clear CTA to the full Shop. */
#homePage:not(.shop-only) #shop .shop-tools,
#homePage:not(.shop-only) #shop #resultsLine { display: none !important; }
#homePage:not(.shop-only) #shop #products > .card:nth-child(n+7) { display: none !important; }
#homePage:not(.shop-only) #homeExploreCta { display: flex !important; }
#homePage.shop-only #homeExploreCta { display: none !important; }
.home-explore-cta {
  display: none;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 42px auto 0;
  padding: 0 0 2px;
  animation: mcExploreEnter .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) both;
}
.home-explore-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 13px;
  min-height: 49px;
  padding: 0 30px;
  border: 1px solid #24231f;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #302e2a;
  color: #fffdfa !important;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .4px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #181714;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background .25s ease, transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
}
.home-explore-btn span { font-size: 24px; line-height: .7; transition: transform .25s ease; }
.home-explore-btn:hover,
.home-explore-btn:focus-visible {
  background: #1f78a0;
  color: #fff !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #164c63;
}
.home-explore-btn:hover span,
.home-explore-btn:focus-visible span { transform: translateX(4px); }
@keyframes mcExploreEnter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* Detail text gently enters whenever the auto-changing showcase presents a new cape. */
@keyframes mcShowcaseInfoEnter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); filter: blur(1px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); filter: blur(0); }
}
.mc-showcase-info-enter {
  animation: mcShowcaseInfoEnter .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) both !important;
  animation-delay: var(--mc-showcase-delay, 0ms) !important;
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

/* Soft content entrance when changing Home/Shop/section and when cards scroll into view. */
@keyframes mcSectionContentEnter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
#homePage:not(.shop-only) #home.hero,
#homePage.shop-only #shop,
#aboutPage:not([hidden]) .about-panel,
#endorsementsPage:not([hidden]) .endorsements-page {
  animation: mcSectionContentEnter .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) both;
}
#shop .card {
  transition: transform .28s ease, border-color .28s ease, box-shadow .28s ease !important;
}
#shop .card:hover,
#shop .card:focus-within {
  transform: translateY(-4px) !important;
}
#shop .card .card-body { transition: background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease; }
#shop .card .card-desc,
#shop .card .card-bottom {
  transition: opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
}
#shop .card:hover .card-desc,
#shop .card:focus-within .card-desc,
#shop .card:hover .card-bottom,
#shop .card:focus-within .card-bottom {
  animation: mcCardInfoEnter .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) both;
}
@keyframes mcCardInfoEnter {
  from { opacity: .55; transform: translateY(5px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@media (hover: none) {
  /* Touchscreens get the same soft arrival without requiring a mouse hover. */
  #shop .card .card-desc,
  #shop .card .card-bottom { animation: mcCardInfoEnter .42s ease both; }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .home-explore-cta { margin-top: 27px; }
  .home-explore-btn { min-height: 46px; padding-inline: 22px; font-size: 11px; }
  #homePage:not(.shop-only) #shop .products { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)) !important; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mc-showcase-info-enter,
  #homePage:not(.shop-only) #home.hero,
  #homePage.shop-only #shop,
  #aboutPage:not([hidden]) .about-panel,
  #endorsementsPage:not([hidden]) .endorsements-page,
  .home-explore-cta,
  #shop .card .card-desc,
  #shop .card .card-bottom { animation-duration: .01ms !important; }
}
</style>
