<script id="mc-store-final-nav-and-card-animation-fix">
(() => {
  const navLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('nav .nav-links .nav-link'));
  const navTimers = new WeakMap();

  function animateNavLabel(link, direction) {
    if (!link) return;
    let label = link.querySelector(':scope > .mc-nav-label');
    if (!label) {
      label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'mc-nav-label';
      while (link.firstChild) label.appendChild(link.firstChild);
      link.appendChild(label);
    }
    const previousTimer = navTimers.get(label);
    if (previousTimer) window.clearTimeout(previousTimer);
    label.classList.remove('mc-nav-enter', 'mc-nav-exit');
    void label.offsetWidth;
    label.classList.add(direction === 'exit' ? 'mc-nav-exit' : 'mc-nav-enter');
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      label.classList.remove('mc-nav-enter', 'mc-nav-exit');
      navTimers.delete(label);
    }, direction === 'exit' ? 260 : 380);
    navTimers.set(label, timer);
  }

  navLinks.forEach((link) => {
    // Preserve the link's existing text and navigation behavior, but animate the text itself.
    animateNavLabel(link, 'enter');
    link.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => animateNavLabel(link, 'enter'));
    link.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => animateNavLabel(link, 'exit'));
    link.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => animateNavLabel(link, 'enter'), { passive: true });
    link.addEventListener('focus', () => animateNavLabel(link, 'enter'));
    link.addEventListener('blur', () => animateNavLabel(link, 'exit'));
    link.addEventListener('click', () => animateNavLabel(link, 'enter'));
  });

  function playCardCopyAnimation(card, direction) {
    if (!card) return;
    if (card._mcCopyAnimationTimer) window.clearTimeout(card._mcCopyAnimationTimer);
    card.classList.remove('mc-card-text-enter', 'mc-card-text-exit');
    void card.offsetWidth;
    card.classList.add(direction === 'exit' ? 'mc-card-text-exit' : 'mc-card-text-enter');
    card._mcCopyAnimationTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      card.classList.remove('mc-card-text-enter', 'mc-card-text-exit');
      card._mcCopyAnimationTimer = null;
    }, direction === 'exit' ? 320 : 520);
  }

  const productsRoot = document.getElementById('products');
  if (!productsRoot) return;

  productsRoot.addEventListener('pointerover', (event) => {
    const card = event.target.closest('#products .card');
    if (!card) return;
    if (event.relatedTarget && card.contains(event.relatedTarget)) return;
    playCardCopyAnimation(card, 'enter');
  });

  productsRoot.addEventListener('pointerout', (event) => {
    const card = event.target.closest('#products .card');
    if (!card) return;
    if (event.relatedTarget && card.contains(event.relatedTarget)) return;
    playCardCopyAnimation(card, 'exit');
  });

  productsRoot.addEventListener('focusin', (event) => {
    const card = event.target.closest('#products .card');
    if (card) playCardCopyAnimation(card, 'enter');
  });

  productsRoot.addEventListener('focusout', (event) => {
    const card = event.target.closest('#products .card');
    if (!card || (event.relatedTarget && card.contains(event.relatedTarget))) return;
    playCardCopyAnimation(card, 'exit');
  });

  // Touch users receive the same animation on tap, before the product opens.
  productsRoot.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    const card = event.target.closest('#products .card');
    if (card) playCardCopyAnimation(card, 'enter');
  }, { passive: true });

  // Re-trigger the copy entrance as cards scroll into view, on both mobile and desktop.
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        const card = entry.target;
        if (!entry.isIntersecting || card.dataset.mcCopyObservedOnce === '1') return;
        card.dataset.mcCopyObservedOnce = '1';
        playCardCopyAnimation(card, 'enter');
        observer.unobserve(card);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.16 });

    const observeCards = (root) => {
      root.querySelectorAll('#products .card').forEach((card) => {
        if (card.dataset.mcCopyObserverAttached === '1') return;
        card.dataset.mcCopyObserverAttached = '1';
        observer.observe(card);
      });
    };
    observeCards(document);
    const mutationWatcher = new MutationObserver(() => observeCards(productsRoot));
    mutationWatcher.observe(productsRoot, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
})();
</script>

<script id="mc-store-cross-device-text-animation-fix-script">
(() => {
  const navLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('nav .nav-links .nav-link'));
  const navTimers = new WeakMap();
  const escapeHTML = (value) => String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (ch) => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  })[ch]);

  function prepareNavLink(link) {
    if (!link) return;
    let label = link.querySelector(':scope > .mc-nav-label');
    if (!label) {
      label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'mc-nav-label';
      while (link.firstChild) label.appendChild(link.firstChild);
      link.appendChild(label);
    }
    if (label.dataset.mcLettersReady === '1') return;
    const text = label.textContent || '';
    label.innerHTML = Array.from(text).map((character, index) =>
      `<span class="mc-nav-letter" aria-hidden="true" style="--mc-nav-letter-delay:${Math.min(index, 18) * 22}ms;--mc-nav-letter-leave-delay:${Math.min(index, 8) * 5}ms">${escapeHTML(character)}</span>`
    ).join('');
    label.dataset.mcLettersReady = '1';
    if (!link.hasAttribute('aria-label')) link.setAttribute('aria-label', text.trim());
  }

  function animateNavText(link, mode) {
    if (!link) return;
    prepareNavLink(link);
    const oldTimer = navTimers.get(link);
    if (oldTimer) clearTimeout(oldTimer);
    link.classList.remove('mc-nav-text-enter', 'mc-nav-text-leave');
    void link.offsetWidth;
    link.classList.add(mode === 'leave' ? 'mc-nav-text-leave' : 'mc-nav-text-enter');
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      link.classList.remove('mc-nav-text-enter', 'mc-nav-text-leave');
      navTimers.delete(link);
    }, mode === 'leave' ? 240 : 760);
    navTimers.set(link, timer);
  }

  navLinks.forEach((link, index) => {
    prepareNavLink(link);
    link.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => animateNavText(link, 'enter'));
    link.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => animateNavText(link, 'leave'));
    link.addEventListener('focus', () => animateNavText(link, 'enter'));
    link.addEventListener('blur', () => animateNavText(link, 'leave'));
    link.addEventListener('click', () => animateNavText(link, 'enter'));
    // On desktop and mobile, let the navigation arrive gently on initial page load too.
    setTimeout(() => animateNavText(link, 'enter'), 90 + index * 75);
  });

  // The site's normal carousel updates #featuredName on each cape change.
  // Observe that update, then animate the complete text group with Web Animations API.
  // This bypasses conflicting CSS/reduced-motion overrides and works on desktop + touch.
  const featuredName = document.getElementById('featuredName');
  const featuredDescription = document.getElementById('featuredDescription');
  if (featuredName && featuredDescription && typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
    let scheduled = false;
    let lastSignature = '';
    const infoSelectors = [
      '.cape-showcase-copy .pill',
      '#featuredName',
      '#featuredDescription',
      '#featuredPrice',
      '#featuredStock',
      '.cape-showcase-copy .hero-actions',
      '#featuredDots'
    ];

    function animateCapeInfo() {
      scheduled = false;
      const signature = [
        featuredName.textContent,
        featuredDescription.textContent,
        document.getElementById('featuredPrice')?.textContent,
        document.getElementById('featuredStock')?.textContent
      ].join('|');
      if (signature === lastSignature) return;
      lastSignature = signature;

      infoSelectors.forEach((selector, order) => {
        const element = document.querySelector(selector);
        if (!element || element.closest('#homePage')?.hidden) return;
        element.classList.remove('mc-showcase-info-enter');
        if (element._mcStoreCapeTextAnimation) {
          try { element._mcStoreCapeTextAnimation.cancel(); } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (typeof element.animate === 'function') {
          element._mcStoreCapeTextAnimation = element.animate([
            { opacity: .08, transform: 'translate3d(0, 20px, 0)', filter: 'blur(2px)' },
            { opacity: 1, transform: 'translate3d(0, -2px, 0)', filter: 'blur(0)' , offset: .7 },
            { opacity: 1, transform: 'translate3d(0, 0, 0)', filter: 'blur(0)' }
          ], {
            duration: 520,
            delay: order * 42,
            easing: 'cubic-bezier(.16,.8,.25,1)',
            fill: 'both'
          });
        } else {
          element.classList.add('mc-showcase-info-enter');
        }
      });
    }

    const scheduleCapeText = () => {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(animateCapeInfo);
    };
    const observer = new MutationObserver(scheduleCapeText);
    [featuredName, featuredDescription, document.getElementById('featuredPrice'), document.getElementById('featuredStock')]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .forEach((element) => observer.observe(element, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true }));

    // Animate the initially displayed cape as well, then re-run whenever the carousel advances.
    scheduleCapeText();
  }
})();
</script>

<script id="mc-store-final-desktop-mobile-motion-script">
(() => {
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const revealSelector = [
    '#homePage .hero-copy', '#homePage .featured', '#homePage .section-head',
    '#homePage .shop-tools', '#homePage .results-line', '#homePage .products > *',
    '#homePage .trust-item', '#homePage .discord-banner', '#homePage footer',
    '#aboutPage > *', '#endorsementsPage > *', '#footerInfoPage > *',
    '#details .detail-card', '#details .recommendations', '#not-found'
  ].join(',');
  const seen = new WeakSet();
  let observer = null;

  function revealVisiblePage() {
    const elements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(revealSelector)).filter(el => {
      if (el.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
      if (el.dataset.mcRevealReady === '1') return false;
      return true;
    });
    elements.forEach((el, index) => {
      el.dataset.mcRevealReady = '1';
      if (reduceMotion || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
        el.classList.add('mc-scroll-visible');
        return;
      }
      el.classList.add('mc-scroll-reveal');
      // A short stagger adds a rendered, progressive feel without delaying the page.
      el.style.setProperty('--mc-reveal-delay', `${Math.min(index % 6, 5) * 55}ms`);
      if (observer) observer.observe(el);
    });
    // When a SPA navigation unhides another page, make its elements eligible too.
    document.querySelectorAll(revealSelector).forEach(el => {
      if (el.dataset.mcRevealReady === '1' && !el.closest('[hidden]') && !el.classList.contains('mc-scroll-visible')) {
        if (reduceMotion || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) el.classList.add('mc-scroll-visible');
        else if (observer) observer.observe(el);
      }
    });
  }

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduceMotion) {
    observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        entry.target.classList.add('mc-scroll-visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        seen.add(entry.target);
      });
    }, { root: null, rootMargin: '0px 0px -7% 0px', threshold: 0.08 });
  }

  const start = () => {
    revealVisiblePage();
    // Navigation switches sections without a full reload, so re-check after clicks.
    document.querySelectorAll('nav .nav-links a, .back-btn, [data-page]').forEach(link => {
      if (link.dataset.mcRevealClickBound === '1') return;
      link.dataset.mcRevealClickBound = '1';
      link.addEventListener('click', () => setTimeout(revealVisiblePage, 80));
    });
    // Some sections are revealed by existing app logic; watch those visibility changes.
    const pageObserver = new MutationObserver(() => revealVisiblePage());
    ['homePage','aboutPage','endorsementsPage','footerInfoPage','details','not-found'].forEach(id => {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) pageObserver.observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden','style','class'] });
    });
  };
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start, { once: true });
  else start();
})();
</script>

}
@keyframes mcStoreCapeIdleFloat {

}
@keyframes mcStoreCapeFast360 {

  100% { opacity: 1; transform: perspective(1100px) translateY(-5px) rotateY(360deg) rotateZ(0deg) scale(1); }

</style>



<style id="mc-store-full-site-motion-v2">
  :root {
    --mc-motion-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1);
  }

  /* A soft moving light layer gives the whole store a little depth without blocking clicks. */
  body::after {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset: -18%;
    z-index: -1;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: .30;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 24%, rgba(45,190,255,.12), transparent 30%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 83% 37%, rgba(255,127,62,.08), transparent 28%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 48% 82%, rgba(62,125,255,.11), transparent 34%);
    filter: blur(24px);
    animation: mcAmbientDrift 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes mcAmbientDrift {
    from { transform: translate3d(-1.2%, -1%, 0) scale(1); }
    to { transform: translate3d(1.2%, 1%, 0) scale(1.055); }
  }

  /* Entrance animations are applied as sections/cards enter the viewport, on desktop and mobile. */
  .mc-motion-enter {
    opacity: 0;
    translate: 0 17px;
    scale: .987;
    filter: blur(1.5px);
    transition:
      opacity .55s var(--mc-motion-ease),
      translate .60s var(--mc-motion-ease),
      scale .60s var(--mc-motion-ease),
      filter .55s var(--mc-motion-ease);
    transition-delay: var(--mc-motion-delay, 0ms);
    will-change: opacity, translate;
  }
  .mc-motion-enter.mc-motion-ready {
    opacity: 1;
    translate: 0 0;
    scale: 1;
    filter: none;
  }

  /* Give the navigation and store actions a little responsive feedback. */
  nav {
    animation: mcNavDrop .62s var(--mc-motion-ease) both;
  }
  @keyframes mcNavDrop {
    from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 -10px; }
    to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; }
  }
  nav .nav-links .nav-link,
  nav .brand,
  .btn, .filter, .view-arrow, .back-btn,
  .storefront-buy, .dot, .discord-join {
    transition-timing-function: var(--mc-motion-ease) !important;
  }
  nav .nav-links .nav-link:hover,
  nav .nav-links .nav-link:focus-visible {
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  }
  .btn:active, .filter:active, .view-arrow:active,
  .storefront-buy:active, .discord-join:active {
    transform: scale(.975) !important;
  }

  /* Animated edge-lighting rather than extra zoom on the cape images. */
  #shop .card, #details .recommendations .card,
  .trust-item, .discord-banner, .detail-card {
    transition:
      border-color .28s ease,
      box-shadow .32s ease,
      background-color .28s ease;
  }
  #shop .card:hover, #details .recommendations .card:hover {
    border-color: rgba(51,198,255,.82) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.22), 0 0 25px rgba(36,169,255,.14) !important;
  }
  .trust-item:hover, .discord-banner:hover {
    border-color: rgba(88,205,255,.62) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 36px rgba(20,114,216,.13) !important;
  }
  .card-tag, .stock { transition: filter .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease; }
  .card:hover .card-tag, .card:hover .stock { filter: brightness(1.08); }

  /* Smoothly introduce the actual 3D cape canvas after the artwork fallback. */
  #details .storefront-preview {
    animation: mcPreviewStageIn .68s var(--mc-motion-ease) both;
    transform-origin: center;
  }
  #details .storefront-preview.preview-loading .cape-preview-fallback {
    animation: mcPreviewFallbackIn .35s ease-out both;
  }
  #details .storefront-preview:not(.preview-loading):not(.fallback-cape-only) #capeSkinViewer {
    animation: mcCanvasIn .45s var(--mc-motion-ease) both;
  }
  #details .cape-rotate-hint {
    animation: mcHintPulse 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes mcPreviewStageIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px) scale(.985); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  }
  @keyframes mcPreviewFallbackIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -47%) scale(.96); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
  }
  @keyframes mcCanvasIn {
    from { opacity: .15; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }
  @keyframes mcHintPulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: .76; }
    50% { opacity: 1; }
  }

  body.mc-open-cape-now #details .detail-card {
    animation: mcDetailCardIn .48s var(--mc-motion-ease) both;
  }
  @keyframes mcDetailCardIn {
    from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 15px; scale: .99; }
    to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; scale: 1; }
  }

  /* Keep touch interaction immediate and prevent accidental browser double-tap zoom on controls. */
  #featured .featured-image, #featuredImage { cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
  #featuredImage:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid #32bde8;
    outline-offset: 5px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
  #details #capeSkinViewer { touch-action: pan-y; }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    #featured .featured-image img { transition: filter .24s ease !important; }
    #featured .featured-image:hover img {
      filter: drop-shadow(9px 19px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.23)) brightness(1.035) !important;
    }
    .brand img { transition: filter .3s ease, transform .3s ease; }
    .brand:hover img { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 17px rgba(37,181,255,.31)); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  }

  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    body::after { opacity: .20; filter: blur(16px); }
    .mc-motion-enter { translate: 0 11px; filter: none; }
    nav { animation-duration: .45s; }
    #details .cape-rotate-hint { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .7px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    body::after, nav, #details .storefront-preview,
    #details .storefront-preview.preview-loading .cape-preview-fallback,
    #details .storefront-preview:not(.preview-loading):not(.fallback-cape-only) #capeSkinViewer,
    #details .cape-rotate-hint,
    body.mc-open-cape-now #details .detail-card {
      animation: none !important;
    }
    .mc-motion-enter, .mc-motion-enter.mc-motion-ready {
      opacity: 1 !important; translate: none !important; scale: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important; transition: none !important;
    }
  }
</style>

<script id="mc-store-full-site-motion-and-direct-3d-v2">
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const doc = document;
  const reduceMotion = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
  const targets = [
    ".section-head", ".shop-tools", ".results-line", "#homePage .card",
    ".trust-item", ".discord-banner", "#aboutPage > *", "#endorsementsPage > *",
    "#footerInfoPage > *", "#details .detail-card", "#details .recommendations",
    "#not-found", "footer .footer-inner", "#homePage .home-explore-cta"
  ].join(",");
  const registered = new WeakSet();
  let motionObserver = null;

  function setupMotion(root) {
    if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
    const candidates = [];
    if (root.matches && root.matches(targets)) candidates.push(root);
    candidates.push(...root.querySelectorAll(targets));
    let order = 0;
    candidates.forEach(el => {
      if (registered.has(el) || el.closest("[hidden]")) return;
      registered.add(el);
      el.classList.add("mc-motion-enter");
      el.style.setProperty("--mc-motion-delay", `${Math.min(order % 5, 4) * 42}ms`);
      order++;
      if (reduceMotion || !motionObserver) {
        el.classList.add("mc-motion-ready");
      } else {
        motionObserver.observe(el);
      }
    });
  }

  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduceMotion) {
    motionObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        entry.target.classList.add("mc-motion-ready");
        motionObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      });
    }, { root: null, rootMargin: "0px 0px -4% 0px", threshold: 0.04 });
  }

  // Every route that opens a cape goes straight to the interactive 3D preview.
  // Keep the existing catalogue / pricing / ordering logic and only add the entrance motion.
  if (typeof window.openCape === "function" && !window.openCape.__mcMotionWrapped) {
    const originalOpenCape = window.openCape;
    const wrappedOpenCape = function(id) {
      doc.body.classList.remove("mc-open-cape-now");
      void doc.body.offsetWidth;
      const result = originalOpenCape.apply(this, arguments);
      doc.body.classList.add("mc-open-cape-now");
      window.setTimeout(() => setupMotion(doc.getElementById("details") || doc), 20);
      return result;
    };
    wrappedOpenCape.__mcMotionWrapped = true;
    window.openCape = wrappedOpenCape;
  }

  // Clicking the large cape in the top showcase opens its corresponding 3D detail view.
  function bindFeaturedCape() {
    const image = doc.getElementById("featuredImage");
    if (!image || image.dataset.mcDirect3DBound === "1") return;
    image.dataset.mcDirect3DBound = "1";
    image.setAttribute("role", "button");
    image.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
    image.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open this cape in the interactive 3D preview");
    const openCurrentCape = () => {
      const button = doc.getElementById("featuredView");
      if (button) button.click();
    };
    image.addEventListener("click", openCurrentCape);
    image.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        openCurrentCape();
      }
    });
    const wrapper = image.closest(".featured-image");
    if (wrapper) wrapper.setAttribute("title", "Click to open the 3D cape preview");
    // Keep the accessibility label synchronized as the automatic spotlight changes capes.
    if ("MutationObserver" in window) {
      const labelObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        image.setAttribute("aria-label", `Open ${image.alt || "this cape"} in the interactive 3D preview`);
      });
      labelObserver.observe(image, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["alt"] });
    }
  }

  const start = () => {
    setupMotion(doc);
    bindFeaturedCape();
    const contentRoot = doc.getElementById("homePage") || doc.body;
    if ("MutationObserver" in window) {
      const dynamicObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        mutations.forEach(mutation => mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
          if (node.nodeType === 1) setupMotion(node);
        }));
      });
      dynamicObserver.observe(contentRoot, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      const detailRoot = doc.getElementById("details");
      if (detailRoot) dynamicObserver.observe(detailRoot, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
    doc.addEventListener("click", () => {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        setupMotion(doc.getElementById("aboutPage"));
        setupMotion(doc.getElementById("endorsementsPage"));
        setupMotion(doc.getElementById("footerInfoPage"));
        setupMotion(doc.getElementById("details"));
      }, 90);
    }, true);
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => window.setTimeout(() => setupMotion(doc), 50));
  };

  if (doc.readyState === "loading") doc.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", start, { once: true });
  else start();
})();
</script>



<style id="mc-store-final-reference-polish-2026">
  :root {

  /* Shop section: retain the same catalogue and prices but use larger charcoal typography. */

  /* Scroll-in animations: on the first visit reveal softly; on re-entry give a short replay without hiding content after scroll. */

  .mc-scroll-reveal.mc-scroll-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); filter: none; }
  .mc-scroll-replay { animation: mcScrollReenter .56s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) both; }
  @keyframes mcScrollReenter {

  @media (max-width: 900px) {

    #homePage > #home.hero { width: min(720px, 91%) !important; padding-top: 30px !important; padding-bottom: 35px !important; }

    #featured .featured-image img { width: min(100%, 430px) !important; max-height: 435px !important; }
    #details .detail-card.detail-card--storefront { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) !important; gap: 29px !important; }
    #details.container { width: min(760px,92%) !important; }

    #details .detail-info { padding: 0 3px !important; }

    .nav-actions { gap: 6px !important; }
    .currency-pill { display: none !important; }
    .account-icon { width: 34px !important; height: 34px !important; }
    #homePage > #home.hero { width: 91% !important; padding-top: 28px !important; padding-bottom: 27px !important; }
    .cape-showcase-copy h1 { font-size: clamp(37px, 10.5vw, 53px) !important; letter-spacing: -1.6px !important; margin-bottom: 14px !important; }
    .cape-showcase-copy > p { font-size: 14px !important; line-height: 1.78 !important; }
    #featuredPrice, .showcase-price { font-size: 31px !important; margin-top: 20px !important; }
    .cape-showcase-copy .hero-actions { margin-top: 18px !important; gap: 8px !important; }

    #featured.showcase-art { min-height: 280px !important; }

    #featured .featured-image img { width: min(100%, 335px) !important; max-height: 345px !important; }
    #shop { padding-top: 31px !important; }
    #shop .products-heading h2 { font-size: 31px !important; }
    #shop .products-heading p { font-size: 13px !important; }

    #shop .card h3, #details .recommendations .card h3 { font-size: 14px !important; }
    #shop .card-desc, #details .recommendations .card-desc { font-size: 11px !important; }
    #details.container { width: 92% !important; padding-top: 16px !important; }

    #details .storefront-preview { height: clamp(350px, 104vw, 450px) !important; min-height: 350px !important; border-radius: 14px !important; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #2d2a25 !important; }
    #details .cape-preview-fallback { width: min(85%, 350px) !important; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

    .mc-scroll-reveal { opacity: 1 !important; }

</style>

<script id="mc-store-stable-showcase-and-scroll-motion">
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const doc = document;
  const artCache = new Map();
  const artLoads = new Map();
  let activeShowcaseToken = 0;
  const imageFolders = [
    "capes 3D/", "Capes 3D/", "capes3D/", "capes-3D/", "3D/", "3d/",
    "media/", "", "Media/", "images/", "Images/", "assets/", "Assets/",
    "media/capes/", "images/capes/", "assets/capes/", "media/images/",
    "assets/images/", "capes/", "Capes/", "capes images/", "Capes Images/",
    "cape images/", "Cape Images/", "capes-images/", "public/images/", "static/images/"
  ];
  const extensions = [".png", ".PNG", ".webp", ".WEBP", ".jpg", ".JPG", ".jpeg", ".JPEG"];

  function baseUrl() {
    try {
      if (typeof mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl === "function") return mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl();
    } catch (_) {}
    return new URL(".", doc.baseURI).href;
  }
  function filenameOf(value) {
    const clean = String(value || "").split(/[?#]/)[0].replace(/\\/g, "/");
    return clean.split("/").pop() || "";
  }
  function imageUrl(path) {
    try { return new URL(String(path || "").replace(/^\.\//, ""), baseUrl()).href; }
    catch (_) { return ""; }
  }
  function probe(url) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (!url) return resolve(null);
      const test = new Image();
      let done = false;
      const finish = value => { if (done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(timer); test.onload = null; test.onerror = null; resolve(value); };
      const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(null), 6500);
      test.onload = () => finish(url);
      test.onerror = () => finish(null);
      test.src = url;
      if (test.complete && test.naturalWidth > 0) finish(url);
    });
  }
  function rawArtPath(cape) {
    return String(cape && (cape.showcaseImage || cape.image || cape.productImage) || "");
  }
  async function resolveArt(cape, force = false) {
    const filename = filenameOf(rawArtPath(cape));
    if (!filename) return null;
    const key = filename.toLowerCase();
    if (!force && artCache.has(key)) return artCache.get(key);
    if (!force && artLoads.has(key)) return artLoads.get(key);
    const task = (async () => {
      const original = rawArtPath(cape);
      const direct = [];
      const add = p => { if (p && !direct.includes(p)) direct.push(p); };
      add(original);
      ["media/", "", "images/", "assets/"].forEach(folder => add(folder + filename));
      // Start with the likely committed locations only; expand the search only if needed.
      // This keeps the nine-capecast preload light and prevents flicker during rotation.
      let results = await Promise.all(direct.map(p => probe(imageUrl(p))));
      let found = results.find(Boolean) || null;
      if (found) { artCache.set(key, found); return found; }

      // Locate the committed file using the GitHub repository tree (handles exact path/case changes).
      try {
        if (typeof findMcStoreNestedAsset === "function") {
          const indexed = await findMcStoreNestedAsset([filename], []);
          if (indexed && indexed.url) {
            found = await probe(indexed.url);
            if (found) { artCache.set(key, found); return found; }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      const dot = filename.lastIndexOf(".");
      const stem = dot > 0 ? filename.slice(0, dot) : filename;
      const names = new Set([filename]);
      if (dot > 0) {
        const ext = filename.slice(dot);
        names.add(stem + ext.toLowerCase());
        names.add(stem + ext.toUpperCase());
      } else {
        extensions.forEach(ext => names.add(stem + ext));
      }
      const broader = [];
      imageFolders.forEach(folder => names.forEach(name => broader.push(folder + name)));
      const uniqueUrls = [...new Set(broader.map(imageUrl).filter(Boolean))].filter(url => !direct.map(imageUrl).includes(url));
      results = await Promise.all(uniqueUrls.map(probe));
      found = results.find(Boolean) || null;
      if (found) artCache.set(key, found);
      return found;
    })();
    artLoads.set(key, task);
    const result = await task;
    artLoads.delete(key);
    return result;
  }

  function paintShowcaseText(cape) {
    const title = doc.getElementById("featuredName");
    const description = doc.getElementById("featuredDescription");
    const price = doc.getElementById("featuredPrice");
    const view = doc.getElementById("featuredView");
    if (!title || !description || !price || !view) return;
    const cleanName = String(cape.name || "Cape").replace(/\s+Cape Code$/i, "").replace(/\s+Cape$/i, "");
    const id = String(cape.id || "aurora").replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/gi, "");
    title.className = "cape-name showcase-title cape-name--" + id;
    title.innerHTML = '<span class="cape-name-base">The </span><span class="cape-name-accent cape-name-accent--' + id + '">' + escapeHTML(cleanName) + '</span><br><span class="cape-name-base">Cape Code</span>';
    description.textContent = cape.description || "Explore the cheapest Minecraft cape codes.";
    price.innerHTML = escapeHTML(formatPrice(cape)) + '<small>' + (cape.stock ? "Listed price" : "Currently unavailable") + '</small>';
    view.onclick = () => openCape(cape.id);
  }

  async function stableShowFeatured(index) {
    if (!Array.isArray(featuredCapes) || !featuredCapes.length) return;
    featuredIndex = ((Number(index) || 0) % featuredCapes.length + featuredCapes.length) % featuredCapes.length;
    const cape = featuredCapes[featuredIndex];
    const image = doc.getElementById("featuredImage");
    if (!image) return;
    const token = ++activeShowcaseToken;
    // Invalidate any older asynchronous recovery from the previous handler.
    try { if (typeof featuredImageRequestToken !== "undefined") featuredImageRequestToken++; } catch (_) {}
    const copy = [
      doc.getElementById("featuredName"), doc.getElementById("featuredDescription"),
      doc.getElementById("featuredPrice"), doc.querySelector(".cape-showcase-copy .hero-actions")
    ].filter(Boolean);
    copy.forEach(el => { el.classList.remove("mc-showcase-info-enter"); el.classList.add("mc-showcase-info-out"); });

    let resolved = await resolveArt(cape);
    if (!resolved && cape.fallbackImage) {
      const fallback = { image: cape.fallbackImage, showcaseImage: cape.fallbackImage, productImage: cape.fallbackImage };
      resolved = await resolveArt(fallback, true);
    }
    if (token !== activeShowcaseToken) return;
    // Never set a known-bad src or hide the shared image while an asset is being recovered.
    // If an asset can't be found yet, leave the last good cape visible and don't mismatch its text.
    if (!resolved) {
      copy.forEach(el => el.classList.remove("mc-showcase-info-out"));
      return;
    }

    // Show only one cape at a time: no duplicated outgoing image, fade, zoom, or cross-spin.
    const previousCapeId = image.dataset.mcVisualCapeId || image.dataset.mcActiveCapeId || "";
    const previousVisualSrc = image.dataset.mcVisualSrc ||
      ((image.complete && image.naturalWidth > 0) ? (image.currentSrc || image.src) : "");
    const isFirstStablePaint = image.dataset.mcStableFirstPaint !== "1";
    const shouldSpinIncoming = !isFirstStablePaint && Boolean(previousVisualSrc) && previousCapeId !== cape.id;
    image.dataset.mcStableFirstPaint = "1";
    const stage = image.closest(".featured-image") || image.parentElement;
    if (stage) stage.querySelectorAll(".mc-showcase-cape-outgoing").forEach(node => node.remove());

    image.hidden = false;
    image.removeAttribute("hidden");
    image.style.removeProperty("display");
    image.alt = cape.name;
    image.dataset.imageFile = filenameOf(rawArtPath(cape));
    image.dataset.originalSrc = resolved;
    image.dataset.fallbackImage = resolved;
    image.dataset.mcLastGoodSrc = resolved;
    image.dataset.mcActiveCapeId = cape.id;
    image.dataset.mcVisualSrc = resolved;
    image.dataset.mcVisualCapeId = cape.id;
    image.onerror = async () => {
      if (token !== activeShowcaseToken) return;
      const lastGood = image.dataset.mcLastGoodSrc || "";
      artCache.delete(filenameOf(rawArtPath(cape)).toLowerCase());
      const retry = await resolveArt(cape, true);
      if (token !== activeShowcaseToken) return;
      const safe = retry || lastGood;
      if (safe && image.src !== safe) image.src = safe;
    };

    image.classList.remove("mc-store-spin-now", "cape-spin", "is-spinning", "spin-in");
    if (image.src !== resolved) image.src = resolved;
    if (shouldSpinIncoming) {
      void image.offsetWidth;
      image.classList.add("mc-store-spin-now");
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (token === activeShowcaseToken) image.classList.remove("mc-store-spin-now");
      }, 140);
    }

    paintShowcaseText(cape);
    copy.forEach((el, order) => {
      el.classList.remove("mc-showcase-info-out", "mc-showcase-info-enter");
      el.style.setProperty("--mc-showcase-delay", `${order * 58}ms`);
      void el.offsetWidth;
      el.classList.add("mc-showcase-info-enter");
    });
  }

  // Keep the public functions used by existing buttons, but remove manual carousel controls.
  window.showFeatured = stableShowFeatured;
  window.restartFeaturedTimer = function () {
    if (typeof featuredTimer !== "undefined" && featuredTimer) clearInterval(featuredTimer);
    featuredTimer = setInterval(() => stableShowFeatured((featuredIndex + 1) % featuredCapes.length), 5000);
  };
  try { showFeatured = stableShowFeatured; } catch (_) {}
  try { restartFeaturedTimer = window.restartFeaturedTimer; } catch (_) {}

  // Product-card / preview image error handling: retry real repository paths without hiding the image prematurely.
  async function recoverAnyImage(img) {
    if (!img || img.dataset.mcStableRecovering === "1") return;
    img.dataset.mcStableRecovering = "1";
    const original = img.dataset.originalSrc || img.dataset.imageFile || img.src || "";
    const filename = filenameOf(img.dataset.imageFile || original);
    const pseudoCape = { image: original || filename, showcaseImage: original || filename, productImage: original || filename };
    let resolved = null;
    try { resolved = await resolveArt(pseudoCape, true); } catch (_) {}
    if (!resolved) {
      try {
        if (typeof findMcStoreNestedAsset === "function") {
          const indexed = await findMcStoreNestedAsset([filename], []);
          if (indexed && indexed.url) resolved = indexed.url;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (!resolved) {
      const fallbackPath = img.dataset.fallbackImage || "";
      if (fallbackPath && fallbackPath !== original && fallbackPath !== filename) {
        try {
          const fallbackCape = { image: fallbackPath, showcaseImage: fallbackPath, productImage: fallbackPath };
          resolved = await resolveArt(fallbackCape, true);
          if (!resolved) resolved = await probe(imageUrl(fallbackPath));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    img.dataset.mcStableRecovering = "0";
    if (resolved) {
      img.hidden = false;
      img.removeAttribute("hidden");
      img.style.removeProperty("display");
      img.dataset.mcLastGoodSrc = resolved;
      if (img.src !== resolved) img.src = resolved;
    }
  }
  window.handleCapeCardImageError = recoverAnyImage;
  window.mcStoreShowcaseImageError = recoverAnyImage;

  // On every page entry, pre-resolve artwork in the background so the three-second carousel swaps instantly.
  function initializeShowcase() {
    const gallery = doc.getElementById("mcShowcaseGallery");
    if (gallery) gallery.replaceChildren();
    if (Array.isArray(featuredCapes)) {
      featuredCapes.forEach(cape => { resolveArt(cape).catch(() => null); });
    }
    stableShowFeatured(0);
    window.restartFeaturedTimer();
  }

  // Scroll-in animation for new sections/cards, plus a subtle replay when they enter the viewport again.
  const revealSelector = [
    "#shop .products-heading", "#shop .shop-tools", "#shop .results-line", "#shop .card",
    "#shop .home-explore-cta", ".trust-item", ".discord-banner", "#aboutPage .about-panel",
    "#endorsementsPage .about-panel", "#footerInfoPage .about-panel", "#details .detail-card",
    "#details .recommendations", "#details .recommendations .card", "footer .footer-inner", "#not-found"
  ].join(",");
  const revealSeen = new WeakSet();
  const revealObserver = "IntersectionObserver" in window ? new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      const el = entry.target;
      if (el.closest("[hidden]") || getComputedStyle(el).display === "none") return;
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        if (revealSeen.has(el)) {
          el.classList.remove("mc-scroll-replay");
          void el.offsetWidth;
          el.classList.add("mc-scroll-replay");
          setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("mc-scroll-replay"), 620);
        } else {
          revealSeen.add(el);
          el.classList.add("mc-scroll-visible");
        }
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.06, rootMargin: "0px 0px -3% 0px" }) : null;

  function registerReveal(root) {
    if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
    const elements = [];
    if (root.matches && root.matches(revealSelector)) elements.push(root);
    elements.push(...root.querySelectorAll(revealSelector));
    elements.forEach((el, index) => {
      if (el.dataset.mcScrollReveal === "1" || el.closest("[hidden]")) return;
      el.dataset.mcScrollReveal = "1";
      el.classList.add("mc-scroll-reveal");
      el.style.setProperty("--mc-reveal-delay", `${Math.min(index % 4, 3) * 40}ms`);
      if (!revealObserver) el.classList.add("mc-scroll-visible");
      else revealObserver.observe(el);
    });
  }

  function start() {
    initializeShowcase();
    registerReveal(doc);
    if ("MutationObserver" in window) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        mutations.forEach(mutation => mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
          if (node.nodeType === 1) registerReveal(node);
        }));
      });
      observer.observe(doc.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
    doc.addEventListener("click", () => setTimeout(() => registerReveal(doc.getElementById("details")), 100), true);
  }
  if (doc.readyState === "loading") doc.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", start, { once: true });
  else start();
})();
</script>



<style id="mc-store-latest-cape-transition-and-static-nav">

<style id="mc-store-home-fitting-room">
  /* The Fitting Room belongs only to Home, beneath the Explore All Capes link. */
  #homeFittingRoom { padding-top: 55px !important; padding-bottom: 74px !important; }
  #homePage.shop-only #homeFittingRoom { display: none !important; }
  .home-fitting-heading { text-align: center; margin: 0 auto 43px; }
  .home-fitting-heading h2 {
    color: #282522 !important; font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 58px) !important;
    line-height: 1.07; letter-spacing: -2px; font-weight: 950; margin: 0 0 13px;
  }
  .home-fitting-heading p { color: #625d55 !important; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; }
  .home-fitting-layout {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.22fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 25px; align-items: center; width: 100%;
  }
  .home-fitting-preview-column, .home-fitting-info-column { min-width: 0; }
  .home-fitting-stage {
    position: relative; height: clamp(430px, 43vw, 530px); min-height: 430px;
    overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; border: 2px solid #292724; border-radius: 15px;
    background: #9d9578; box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 #292724;
  }
  .home-fitting-world {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 4% 38%, #f8e96b 0 7%, transparent 8%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, #626b91 0%, #ba795e 31%, #a19a7b 48%, #74715b 64%, #3e513c 100%);
  }
  .home-fitting-world::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 24% -7% 14%; opacity: .86; filter: blur(7px);
    background:
      linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 8%, #938b69 8% 17%, transparent 17% 23%, #746f59 23% 37%, transparent 37% 43%, #928767 43% 51%, transparent 51% 60%, #77715b 60% 74%, transparent 74% 80%, #9b5e3f 80% 92%, transparent 92%),
      linear-gradient(0deg, #443f31 0 13%, transparent 13% 31%, #77735b 31% 45%, transparent 45% 100%);
  }
  .home-fitting-world::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: -4%; right: -4%; bottom: -2%; height: 38%; opacity: .96; filter: blur(3px);
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 17%, #53673c 17% 41%, #604d34 41% 66%, #4b4935 66% 100%),
      repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 52px, #383a2d 53px 61px, transparent 62px 94px);

  #homeFitCanvas {

  }

  .home-fitting-userbar {
    position: absolute; z-index: 5; top: 12px; left: 12px; right: 12px;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 7px; align-items: center;
    max-width: 355px;
  }
  .home-fitting-head {

  #homeFitUsername {

  .home-fitting-cape-swatches {

  .home-fitting-swatch {
    position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0; height: 61px; padding: 2px; overflow: hidden;
    border: 2px solid #282622; border-radius: 7px; background: #eee7d8;

  .home-fitting-swatch:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
  .home-fitting-swatch.active {
    border-color: #19bdf5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #19bdf5, 1px 2px 0 #282622;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .home-fitting-swatch img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; }
  .home-fitting-swatch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #17bdf3; outline-offset: 3px; }
  .home-fitting-selected-card { padding: 23px 23px 20px; }
  .home-fitting-selected-card h3 {
    color: #22201d !important; margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: clamp(23px, 2.4vw, 34px);
    font-weight: 950; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -.7px;
  }
  .home-fitting-selected-card h3 .home-fitting-cape-accent { color: var(--home-cape-color, #168fb4); }
  .home-fitting-price-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px; }

  .home-fitting-stock {

  .home-fitting-stock.unavailable { color: #a82b2b; border-color: #e4b1a9; background: #fff0ed; }
  .home-fitting-description { color: #655f56 !important; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 9px 0 18px; }
  .home-fitting-buy {
    width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #1a272b; border-radius: 9px;

  .home-fitting-buy:disabled { color: #777067; background: #e6e0d5; border-color: #bfb6a7; box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 #bfb6a7; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
  .home-fitting-details {
    display: block; margin: 13px auto 0; padding: 3px 9px; border: 0; background: transparent;
    color: #625b51; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s;

  .home-fitting-details:hover { color: #078fc3; text-decoration: underline; }
  .home-fitting-order-status { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #625b51; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: center; }
  .home-fitting-order-status:empty { display: none; }
  @media (max-width: 950px) {
    #homeFittingRoom { padding-top: 45px !important; }
    .home-fitting-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
    .home-fitting-stage { height: clamp(430px, 72vw, 560px); }
    .home-fitting-info-column { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .9fr) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: stretch; gap: 17px; }
    .home-fitting-cape-picker { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 19px 15px; }
    .home-fitting-cape-swatches { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }

  @media (max-width: 620px) {

    .home-fitting-heading p { max-width: 340px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 12px; }
    .home-fitting-stage { height: min(125vw, 490px); min-height: 385px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 #292724; }

    .home-fitting-status { top: 57px; left: 10px; font-size: 8px; }
    .home-fitting-drag-hint { left: 9px; bottom: 56px; font-size: 7px; }
    .home-fitting-mode-switch { bottom: 10px; min-width: 164px; }
    .home-fitting-mode { min-height: 27px; font-size: 9px; }
    .home-fitting-info-column { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
    .home-fitting-cape-picker { padding: 18px 15px; }
    .home-fitting-cape-swatches { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .home-fitting-swatch, .home-fitting-mode, #homeFitLoadSkin, .home-fitting-buy { transition: none !important; }
