<script id="mc-store-home-fitting-room-behavior">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const fittingCapes = [
    { id: "moonlight",  name: "Moonlight Cape",       stem: "moonlightcapetexture",  thumb: "moonlightcape.gg",  art: "media/moonlight-cape.png",  color: "#8d9cff" },
    { id: "crafter",    name: "Crafter Cape",         stem: "craftercapetexture",    thumb: "craftercape.gg",    art: "media/crafter-cape.png",    color: "#8a5a2b" },
    { id: "experience", name: "Experience Cape", stem: "experiencecapetexture", thumb: "experiencecape.gg", art: "media/experience-cape.png", color: "#7545b4" }
  ];

  const stage = document.getElementById("homeFitStage");
  const canvas = document.getElementById("homeFitCanvas");
  const usernameInput = document.getElementById("homeFitUsername");
  const loadButton = document.getElementById("homeFitLoadSkin");
  const headImage = document.getElementById("homeFitHead");
  const status = document.getElementById("homeFitStatus");
  const swatches = document.getElementById("homeFitCapeSwatches");
  const title = document.getElementById("homeFitCapeTitle");
  const price = document.getElementById("homeFitCapePrice");
  const oldPrice = document.getElementById("homeFitCapeOldPrice");
  const stock = document.getElementById("homeFitCapeStock");
  const description = document.getElementById("homeFitCapeDescription");
  const buyButton = document.getElementById("homeFitBuyNow");
  const detailsButton = document.getElementById("homeFitViewDetails");
  const orderStatus = document.getElementById("homeFitOrderStatus");
  const homePage = document.getElementById("homePage");
  const userbar = document.getElementById("homeFitUserbar");
  const identityToggle = document.getElementById("homeFitIdentityToggle");
  const usernamePanel = document.getElementById("homeFitUsernamePanel");

  let selectedCapeId = "moonlight";
  let selectedMode = "player";
  let homeViewer = null;
  let viewerReady = false;
  let currentUsername = (() => { try { return localStorage.getItem("mc_store_skin_username") || "Steve"; } catch (_) { return "Steve"; } })();
  let isWalking = true;
  let textureRequestToken = 0;
  let resizeObserver = null;
  let latestCapeSelectionPromise = Promise.resolve();
  const namedAssetCache = new Map();
  const namedAssetRequests = new Map();
  const capeTextureCache = new Map();
  const capeTextureRequests = new Map();

  const textureFolders = [
    "", "media/", "images/", "assets/", "textures/", "Textures/", "texture/", "Texture/",
    "texture pack/", "Texture Pack/", "TEXTURE PACK/", "texture-pack/", "Texture-Pack/", "texture_pack/", "Texture_Pack/",
    "resource pack/", "Resource Pack/", "RESOURCE PACK/", "resource-pack/", "Resource-Pack/", "resource_pack/", "Resource_Pack/",
    "capes 3D/", "Capes 3D/", "capes 3d/", "Capes 3d/", "capes3D/", "capes-3D/", "3D/", "3d/",
    "Media/", "Images/", "Assets/", "TEXTURE PACK/", "Texture-Pack/", "Texture_Pack/",
    "textures pack/", "Textures Pack/", "textures-pack/", "Textures-Pack/", "textures_pack/",
    "capes texture pack/", "Capes Texture Pack/", "Cape Texture Pack/", "cape texture pack/", "CAPE TEXTURE PACK/",
    "capes textures/", "Capes Textures/", "cape textures/", "Cape Textures/", "capes texture/", "Capes Texture/", "cape texture/", "Cape Texture/",
    "media/textures/", "media/texture pack/", "assets/textures/", "media/capes 3D/", "assets/capes 3D/",
    "texture pack/capes/", "Texture Pack/capes/", "resource pack/capes/", "Resource Pack/capes/"
  ];
  const imageExtensions = ["", ".png", ".PNG", ".webp", ".WEBP", ".jpg", ".JPG", ".jpeg", ".JPEG"];
  const artFolders = [
    "", "media/", "Media/", "capes 3D/", "Capes 3D/", "capes3D/", "capes-3D/", "3D/", "3d/",
    "images/", "Images/", "assets/", "Assets/", "capes/", "Capes/", "capes images/", "Capes Images/",
    "cape images/", "Cape Images/", "media/capes/", "assets/capes/", "public/images/", "static/images/"
  ];

  function safeText(value) {
    return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"})[ch]);
  }
  function baseUrl() {
    try {
      return typeof mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl === "function"
        ? mcStoreNestedAssetBaseUrl()
        : new URL(".", document.baseURI).href;
    } catch (_) { return new URL(".", document.baseURI).href; }
  }
  function makeUrl(path) {
    try {
      if (typeof mcStoreNestedAssetUrl === "function" && path && !/^https?:/i.test(path)) return mcStoreNestedAssetUrl(path);
      return new URL(String(path || ""), baseUrl()).href;
    } catch (_) { return String(path || ""); }
  }
  function probeImage(url, timeoutMs = 1800) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (!url) return resolve(null);
      const image = new Image();
      let finished = false;
      const done = result => {
        if (finished) return;
        finished = true;
        clearTimeout(timer);
        image.onload = null;
        image.onerror = null;
        resolve(result);
      };
      const timer = setTimeout(() => done(null), timeoutMs);
      image.onload = () => done(url);
      image.onerror = () => done(null);
      image.src = url;
      if (image.complete && image.naturalWidth > 0) done(url);
    });
  }
  function catalogCape(capeId) {
    try { return Array.isArray(capes) ? capes.find(item => item.id === capeId) || null : null; }
    catch (_) { return null; }
  }
  function getCape(capeId) { return fittingCapes.find(item => item.id === capeId) || fittingCapes[0]; }
  function showStatus(message, state = "") {
    if (!status) return;
    status.textContent = message;
    status.classList.remove("error", "success");
    if (state) status.classList.add(state);
  }
  function setUsernameSearchOpen(open) {
    const expanded = Boolean(open);
    if (userbar) userbar.classList.toggle("username-open", expanded);
    if (identityToggle) identityToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", expanded ? "true" : "false");
    if (identityToggle) identityToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", expanded ? "Close Minecraft username search" : "Open Minecraft username search");
    if (usernamePanel) usernamePanel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", expanded ? "false" : "true");
    if (expanded && usernameInput) window.setTimeout(() => usernameInput.focus(), 30);
  }
  function formatMoney(value) {
    if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "Unavailable";
    return "$" + (Number.isInteger(value) ? value.toFixed(0) : value.toFixed(2));
  }

  async function resolveCanonicalMinecraftUsername(enteredName) {
    // Resolve case-insensitive name input to Minecraft's canonical capitalization.
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`https://api.mojang.com/users/profiles/minecraft/${encodeURIComponent(enteredName)}`, { cache: "no-store" });
      if (response.status === 204 || response.status === 404) {
        throw new Error("No Minecraft Java profile was found for that username.");
      }
      if (response.ok) {
        const profile = await response.json();
        if (profile && typeof profile.name === "string" && profile.name) return profile.name;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error && error.message === "No Minecraft Java profile was found for that username.") throw error;
      // Fall back to the skin image provider if the profile lookup endpoint is unavailable.
    }
    return enteredName;
  }

  function firstAvailableImage(urls, timeoutMs = 1800) {
    const candidates = [...new Set((urls || []).filter(Boolean))];
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (!candidates.length) return resolve(null);
      let done = false;
      let remaining = candidates.length;
      const images = [];
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => finish(null), timeoutMs);
      function finish(url) {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        images.forEach(image => { image.onload = null; image.onerror = null; });
        resolve(url || null);
      }
      for (const url of candidates) {
        if (done) break;
        const image = new Image();
        images.push(image);
        image.onload = () => finish(url);
        image.onerror = () => {
          remaining -= 1;
          if (remaining <= 0) finish(null);
        };
        image.src = url;
        if (image.complete && image.naturalWidth > 0) finish(url);
      }
    });
  }

  function firstResolvedAsset(tasks, timeoutMs = 2800) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (!tasks.length) return resolve(null);
      let settled = false;
      let remaining = tasks.length;
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => finish(null), timeoutMs);
      function finish(url) {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(url || null);
      }
      tasks.forEach(task => Promise.resolve(task).then(url => {
        if (url) return finish(url);
        remaining -= 1;
        if (!remaining) finish(null);
      }).catch(() => {
        remaining -= 1;
        if (!remaining) finish(null);
      }));
    });
  }

  function textureFilenameOptions(stem) {
    const stems = stem === "moonlightcapetexture"
      ? [stem, "MoonlightCapeTexture", "moonlightCapeTexture", "Moonlightcapetexture"]
      : [stem];
    return [...new Set(stems.flatMap(name => imageExtensions.map(extension => name + extension)))];
  }

  function candidateAssetUrls(filenames, folders) {
    const urls = [];
    for (const folder of folders || []) {
      for (const filename of filenames || []) {
        try {
          const url = makeUrl(folder + filename);
          if (!urls.includes(url)) urls.push(url);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    return urls;
  }

  async function resolveNamedAsset(filename, folders, extensions) {
    const cacheKey = `${filename}|${(folders || []).join(",")}|${(extensions || []).join(",")}`;
    if (namedAssetCache.has(cacheKey)) return namedAssetCache.get(cacheKey);
    if (namedAssetRequests.has(cacheKey)) return namedAssetRequests.get(cacheKey);

    const request = (async () => {
      const names = /\.gg$/i.test(filename)
        ? [filename, ...imageExtensions.filter(Boolean).map(ext => filename + ext)]
        : (/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(filename) ? [filename] : (extensions || []).map(ext => filename + ext));
      const indexedTask = (async () => {
        try {
          const indexed = await findMcStoreNestedAsset(names);
          return indexed && indexed.url ? indexed.url : null;
        } catch (_) { return null; }
      })();
      const primaryFolders = ["", "media/", "Media/", "capes 3D/", "Capes 3D/", "capes3D/", "images/", "assets/"];
      const primaryTask = firstAvailableImage(candidateAssetUrls(names, primaryFolders), 1900);
      let found = await firstResolvedAsset([indexedTask, primaryTask], 2900);
      if (!found) {
        const fallbackFolders = [
          "capes images/", "Capes Images/", "cape images/", "Cape Images/", "capes/", "Capes/",
          "media/capes/", "assets/capes/", "public/images/", "static/images/", "capes texture pack/",
          "Capes Texture Pack/", "texture pack/", "Texture Pack/", "resource pack/", "Resource Pack/"
        ];
        found = await firstAvailableImage(candidateAssetUrls(names, fallbackFolders), 1700);
      }
      if (found) namedAssetCache.set(cacheKey, found);
      return found;
    })();
    namedAssetRequests.set(cacheKey, request);
    try { return await request; }
    finally { namedAssetRequests.delete(cacheKey); }
  }

  async function resolveCapeTexture(cape) {
    const cacheKey = cape.id || cape.stem;
    if (capeTextureCache.has(cacheKey)) return capeTextureCache.get(cacheKey);
    if (capeTextureRequests.has(cacheKey)) return capeTextureRequests.get(cacheKey);

    const request = (async () => {
      const filenames = textureFilenameOptions(cape.stem);
      const directFilenames = imageExtensions.map(extension => cape.stem + extension);
      const indexedTask = (async () => {
        try {
          const indexed = await findMcStoreNestedAsset(filenames);
          return indexed && indexed.url ? indexed.url : null;
        } catch (_) { return null; }
      })();
      // Try likely paths immediately while the repository index is being fetched.
      const quickFolders = [
        "", "media/", "Media/", "textures/", "Textures/", "texture/", "Texture/",
        "capes 3D/", "Capes 3D/", "capes3D/", "texture pack/", "Texture Pack/",
        "resource pack/", "Resource Pack/", "assets/textures/"
      ];
      let found = await firstResolvedAsset([
        indexedTask,
        firstAvailableImage(candidateAssetUrls(directFilenames, quickFolders), 2100)
      ], 3000);
      if (!found) {
        // Try the remaining resource-pack folders only if the quick paths and repository
        // index miss, keeping the common case fast and avoiding hundreds of unnecessary probes.
        const quickSet = new Set(quickFolders);
        const fallbackFolders = textureFolders.filter(folder => !quickSet.has(folder));
        found = await firstAvailableImage(candidateAssetUrls(directFilenames, fallbackFolders), 2200);
        if (!found && cape.id === "moonlight") {
          // Last capitalization fallback is useful on a case-sensitive GitHub Pages host.
          const alternateNames = filenames.filter(name => !directFilenames.includes(name));
          found = await firstAvailableImage(candidateAssetUrls(alternateNames, quickFolders), 1800);
        }
      }
      if (found) capeTextureCache.set(cacheKey, found);
      return found;
    })();
    capeTextureRequests.set(cacheKey, request);
    try { return await request; }
    finally { capeTextureRequests.delete(cacheKey); }
  }

  async function prepareSwatchImages() {
    const images = swatches ? swatches.querySelectorAll("img[data-thumb-file]") : [];
    await Promise.all(Array.from(images).map(async image => {
      const filename = image.dataset.thumbFile;
      const found = await resolveNamedAsset(filename, artFolders, [""]);
      if (found) {
        image.dataset.homeThumbResolved = "1";
        image.dataset.homeThumbFallback = "0";
        image.src = found;
      } else {
        image.dataset.homeThumbFallback = "1";
        image.src = image.dataset.fallbackArt || "";
      }
    }));
  }

  function renderSwatches() {
    if (!swatches) return;
    swatches.innerHTML = fittingCapes.map(cape => `
      <button class="home-fitting-swatch${cape.id === selectedCapeId ? " active" : ""}" type="button"
        data-home-fit-cape="${safeText(cape.id)}" aria-pressed="${cape.id === selectedCapeId ? "true" : "false"}"
        title="${safeText(cape.name)}" aria-label="Equip ${safeText(cape.name)}">
        <img src="${safeText(cape.thumb)}" data-thumb-file="${safeText(cape.thumb)}"
          data-fallback-art="${safeText(cape.art)}" alt="${safeText(cape.name)}"
          loading="${cape.id === "moonlight" ? "eager" : "lazy"}" decoding="async">
      </button>`).join("");
    swatches.querySelectorAll(".home-fitting-swatch").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => requestCapeSelection(button.dataset.homeFitCape));
    });
    swatches.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(image => {
      image.addEventListener("error", () => {
        if (image.dataset.homeThumbFallback === "1") {
          if (typeof window.handleCapeCardImageError === "function") window.handleCapeCardImageError(image);
          return;
        }
        image.dataset.homeThumbFallback = "1";
        image.dataset.imageFile = image.dataset.fallbackArt || "";
        image.dataset.originalSrc = image.dataset.fallbackArt || "";
        image.src = image.dataset.fallbackArt || "";
      });
    });
    prepareSwatchImages();
  }

  function updateSelectedPanel(cape) {
    const item = catalogCape(cape.id);
    const itemName = item ? item.name : cape.name;
    const itemDescription = item ? [item.description, item.bulkOffer].filter(Boolean).join(" ") : "A cape from this collection.";
    const itemPrice = item && typeof item.price === "number" && item.stock ? item.price : null;
    const itemStock = Boolean(item && item.stock);
    if (title) {
      const baseName = itemName.replace(/\s+Cape Code$/i, "").replace(/\s+Cape$/i, "");
      const suffix = itemName.slice(baseName.length);
      title.innerHTML = `<span class="home-fitting-cape-accent">${safeText(baseName)}</span>${safeText(suffix)}`;
      title.style.setProperty("--home-cape-color", cape.color);
    }
    if (price) price.textContent = itemPrice === null ? "Ask on Discord" : formatMoney(itemPrice);
    if (oldPrice) {
      if (item && item.stock && typeof item.originalPrice === "number") {
        oldPrice.textContent = formatMoney(item.originalPrice);
        oldPrice.hidden = false;
      } else {
        oldPrice.textContent = "";
        oldPrice.hidden = true;
      }
    }
    if (stock) {
      stock.textContent = itemStock ? "In stock" : "Unavailable";
      stock.classList.toggle("unavailable", !itemStock);
    }
    if (description) description.textContent = itemDescription || "Preview this cape on your Minecraft skin.";
    if (buyButton) {
      buyButton.disabled = false;
      buyButton.textContent = "Buy now";
    }
    if (detailsButton) detailsButton.onclick = () => { if (typeof window.openCape === "function") window.openCape(cape.id); };
    if (swatches) {
      swatches.querySelectorAll(".home-fitting-swatch").forEach(button => {
        const active = button.dataset.homeFitCape === cape.id;
        button.classList.toggle("active", active);
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
      });
    }
  }

  function updateHomeMotionButton() {
    const button = document.getElementById("homeFitMotionToggle");
    if (!button) return;
    // Keep only the compact icon, matching the product preview control.
    button.textContent = isWalking ? "Ⅱ" : "▶";
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", isWalking ? "Pause walking" : "Resume walking");
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", isWalking ? "true" : "false");
    button.title = isWalking ? "Pause the player and keep the current pose" : "Resume the player walking animation";
  }

  function applyEquipmentMode() {
    updateHomeMotionButton();
    if (!homeViewer || !homeViewer.playerObject) return;
    const player = homeViewer.playerObject;
    player.skin.visible = true;
    player.backEquipment = selectedMode === "elytra" ? "elytra" : "cape";
    homeViewer.animation = isWalking && window.skinview3d && window.skinview3d.WalkingAnimation
      ? new window.skinview3d.WalkingAnimation() : null;
    if (stage) {
      stage.classList.toggle("mode-elytra", selectedMode === "elytra");
      stage.classList.toggle("mode-player", selectedMode === "player");
    }
    document.querySelectorAll(".home-fitting-mode[data-home-fit-mode]").forEach(button => {
      const active = button.dataset.homeFitMode === selectedMode;
      button.classList.toggle("active", active);
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    });
  }

  async function selectCape(capeId) {
    const cape = getCape(capeId);
    selectedCapeId = cape.id;
    if (orderStatus) orderStatus.textContent = "";
    updateSelectedPanel(cape);
    const token = ++textureRequestToken;
    if (!homeViewer || !viewerReady) return;
    showStatus(`Equipping ${cape.name}…`);
    try {
      const textureUrl = await resolveCapeTexture(cape);
      if (token !== textureRequestToken || !homeViewer) return;
      const fallbackUrl = makeUrl(cape.art);
      // A catalogue picture is not a Minecraft cape texture atlas. For Moonlight, only
      // load the dedicated moonlightcapetexture asset; keep the current model if it is missing.
      if (!textureUrl && cape.id === "moonlight") {
        throw new Error("moonlightcapetexture was not found in the repository texture folders");
      }
      await homeViewer.loadCape(textureUrl || fallbackUrl, { makeVisible: false });
      if (token !== textureRequestToken || !homeViewer) return;
      if (stage) stage.classList.remove("cape-texture-missing");
      applyEquipmentMode();
      showStatus(`${cape.name} equipped. Drag the player to turn around.`, "success");
    } catch (error) {
      if (token !== textureRequestToken) return;
      if (stage && cape.id === "moonlight") stage.classList.add("cape-texture-missing");
      console.warn("CHEAPEST Cape Codes Fitting Room could not load the cape texture", error);
      showStatus(`Could not load ${cape.name}'s texture. Check that ${cape.stem} is uploaded to the repository.`, "error");
    }
  }

  function requestCapeSelection(capeId) {
    latestCapeSelectionPromise = selectCape(capeId);
    return latestCapeSelectionPromise;
  }

  async function waitForLatestCapeSelection() {
    let current;
    do {
      current = latestCapeSelectionPromise;
      await current;
    } while (current !== latestCapeSelectionPromise);
  }

  async function loadUsernameSkin() {
    const input = document.getElementById("homeFitUsername");
    const enteredName = String(input && input.value || "").trim();
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,16}$/.test(enteredName)) {
      showStatus("Enter a valid Java username (1–16 letters, numbers, or underscores).", "error");
      input && input.focus();
      return;
    }
    let username = enteredName;
    if (loadButton) loadButton.disabled = true;
    try {
      username = await resolveCanonicalMinecraftUsername(enteredName);
    } catch (error) {
      showStatus(error && error.message ? error.message : "Could not find that Minecraft Java profile.", "error");
      if (loadButton) loadButton.disabled = false;
      return;
    }
    if (!homeViewer) {
      currentUsername = username;
      showStatus("Loading the 3D preview…");
      await ensureViewer();
      if (loadButton) loadButton.disabled = false;
      return;
    }
    showStatus(`Loading ${username}'s skin…`);
    try {
      await homeViewer.loadSkin(`https://minotar.net/skin/${encodeURIComponent(username)}`);
      currentUsername = username;
      try { localStorage.setItem("mc_store_skin_username", username); } catch (_) {}
      if (headImage) headImage.src = `https://minotar.net/helm/${encodeURIComponent(username)}/40.png`;
      if (homeViewer.playerObject && homeViewer.playerObject.skin) homeViewer.playerObject.skin.visible = true;
      applyEquipmentMode();
      showStatus(`Skin loaded for ${username}. Your selected cape is equipped.`, "success");
      setUsernameSearchOpen(false);
    } catch (error) {
      showStatus(`Could not load ${username}'s skin. Check the Java username and try again.`, "error");
      console.warn("CHEAPEST Cape Codes Fitting Room could not load the requested skin", error);
    } finally {
      if (loadButton) loadButton.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  function installDragTurn(viewer, canvasElement) {
    let pointer = null;
    const onDown = event => {
      if (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button !== 0) return;
      pointer = { id: event.pointerId, startX: event.clientX, startY: event.clientY, lastX: event.clientX, lastY: event.clientY, turning: false, scrolling: false };
    };
    const onMove = event => {
      if (!pointer || pointer.id !== event.pointerId || pointer.scrolling || !homeViewer) return;
      const dxTotal = event.clientX - pointer.startX;
      const dyTotal = event.clientY - pointer.startY;
      if (!pointer.turning) {
        if (Math.abs(dxTotal) < 4 && Math.abs(dyTotal) < 4) return;
        pointer.turning = true;
        stage.classList.add("is-user-turning");
        try { canvasElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
      }
      const dx = event.clientX - pointer.lastX;
      const dy = event.clientY - pointer.lastY;
      pointer.lastX = event.clientX;
      pointer.lastY = event.clientY;
      if (homeViewer && homeViewer.playerWrapper) {
        // The player/Elytra rotate in place: horizontal drag turns, vertical drag tilts the view.
        homeViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.y += dx * 0.012;
        // Keep vertical drag intuitive: moving the pointer up tilts the player upward,
        // moving it down tilts the player downward (rather than the reverse).
        homeViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.x = Math.max(-0.65, Math.min(0.65, homeViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.x + dy * 0.009));
        homeViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.z = 0;
      }
      if (event.cancelable) event.preventDefault();
    };
    const onUp = event => {
      if (pointer && pointer.id === event.pointerId) {
        pointer = null;
        stage.classList.remove("is-user-turning");
        try { if (canvasElement.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) canvasElement.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
      }
    };
    canvasElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown, { passive: true });
    canvasElement.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, { passive: false });
    canvasElement.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp, { passive: true });
    canvasElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp, { passive: true });
    canvasElement.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", onUp, { passive: true });
    canvasElement.__mcHomeFitDragCleanup = () => {
      canvasElement.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
      canvasElement.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      canvasElement.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      canvasElement.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
      canvasElement.removeEventListener("lostpointercapture", onUp);
    };
  }

  async function ensureViewer() {
    if (homeViewer || !stage || !canvas || !window.skinview3d || typeof window.skinview3d.SkinViewer !== "function") return;
    if (homePage && (homePage.style.display === "none" || homePage.classList.contains("shop-only"))) return;
    stage.classList.add("is-loading");
    try {
      homeViewer = new window.skinview3d.SkinViewer({
        canvas,
        width: Math.max(320, stage.clientWidth || 650),
        height: Math.max(360, stage.clientHeight || 500),
        pixelRatio: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2),
        enableControls: true,
        animation: new window.skinview3d.WalkingAnimation()
      });
      homeViewer.controls.enabled = false;
      homeViewer.controls.enablePan = false;
      homeViewer.controls.enableRotate = false;
      homeViewer.controls.enableZoom = false;
      homeViewer.controls.enableDamping = false;
      homeViewer.autoRotate = false;
      homeViewer.controls.autoRotate = false;
      homeViewer.zoom = 0.76;
      homeViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.x = 0;
      homeViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.z = 0;
      homeViewer.playerWrapper.rotation.y = Math.PI - 0.24;
      if (homeViewer.playerObject && homeViewer.playerObject.skin) homeViewer.playerObject.skin.visible = true;
      if (homeViewer.playerObject) homeViewer.playerObject.backEquipment = selectedMode === "elytra" ? "elytra" : "cape";
      installDragTurn(homeViewer, canvas);

      const viewerAtStart = homeViewer;
      viewerReady = true;
      applyEquipmentMode();

      if (!resizeObserver && "ResizeObserver" in window) {
        resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
          if (!homeViewer || !stage.clientWidth || !stage.clientHeight) return;
          homeViewer.width = stage.clientWidth;
          homeViewer.height = stage.clientHeight;
        });
        resizeObserver.observe(stage);
      }

      // Start the skin and cape loads in parallel. In particular, never make the Moonlight
      // model wait for a username/skin provider before its 3D cape or Elytra can appear.
      const skinPromise = viewerAtStart.loadSkin(`https://minotar.net/skin/${encodeURIComponent(currentUsername || "Steve")}`)
        .then(() => {
          if (viewerAtStart !== homeViewer) return;
          if (homeViewer.playerObject && homeViewer.playerObject.skin) homeViewer.playerObject.skin.visible = true;
          if (headImage) headImage.src = `https://minotar.net/helm/${encodeURIComponent(currentUsername || "Steve")}/40.png`;
          applyEquipmentMode();
          if (!stage.classList.contains("is-loading") && !stage.classList.contains("cape-texture-missing")) {
            showStatus(`${currentUsername || "Steve"} is ready. Drag to turn the player.`, "success");
          }
        })
        .catch(error => {
          if (viewerAtStart !== homeViewer) return;
          // A slow/unavailable skin host must not tear down the working 3D cape preview.
          console.warn("CHEAPEST Cape Codes Fitting Room could not load the default skin; keeping the 3D preview active.", error);
          applyEquipmentMode();
        });
      // Avoid an unhandled rejection in case a browser rejects the underlying texture request.
      skinPromise.catch(() => {});

      await requestCapeSelection(selectedCapeId);
      await waitForLatestCapeSelection();
      if (viewerAtStart !== homeViewer) return;
      stage.classList.remove("is-loading");
      if (!stage.classList.contains("cape-texture-missing")) {
        showStatus(`${currentUsername || "Steve"} is ready. Drag to turn the player.`, "success");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      stage.classList.remove("is-loading");
      if (canvas.__mcHomeFitDragCleanup) canvas.__mcHomeFitDragCleanup();
      if (homeViewer) { try { homeViewer.dispose(); } catch (_) {} }
      homeViewer = null;
      viewerReady = false;
      console.warn("CHEAPEST Cape Codes Fitting Room could not start the 3D viewer", error);
      showStatus("The 3D preview could not load. Check your connection and make sure WebGL is enabled.", "error");
    }
  }

  function disposeViewer() {
    textureRequestToken++;
    viewerReady = false;
    if (resizeObserver) { try { resizeObserver.disconnect(); } catch (_) {} resizeObserver = null; }
    if (canvas && canvas.__mcHomeFitDragCleanup) { try { canvas.__mcHomeFitDragCleanup(); } catch (_) {} }
    if (homeViewer) { try { homeViewer.dispose(); } catch (_) {} homeViewer = null; }
  }

  document.querySelectorAll(".home-fitting-mode[data-home-fit-mode]").forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selectedMode = button.dataset.homeFitMode === "elytra" ? "elytra" : "player";
      applyEquipmentMode();
      if (homeViewer) showStatus(selectedMode === "elytra" ? "Elytra mode selected." : "Player cape mode selected.", "success");
    });
  });
  const homeMotionButton = document.getElementById("homeFitMotionToggle");
  if (homeMotionButton) homeMotionButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    isWalking = !isWalking;
    applyEquipmentMode();
    showStatus(isWalking ? "Walking resumed." : "Walking paused. Current pose is held.", "success");
  });
  updateHomeMotionButton();
  if (identityToggle) identityToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
    setUsernameSearchOpen(!(userbar && userbar.classList.contains("username-open")));
  });
  if (loadButton) loadButton.addEventListener("click", loadUsernameSkin);
  if (usernameInput) usernameInput.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); loadUsernameSkin(); }
    if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); setUsernameSearchOpen(false); }
  });
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
    if (userbar && userbar.classList.contains("username-open") && !userbar.contains(event.target)) setUsernameSearchOpen(false);
  });
  if (buyButton) buyButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    window.open("https://discord.gg/PSCBpZbNWb", "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
  });

  renderSwatches();
  // Pre-resolve Moonlight's 3D texture while the Home page is idle, so its first click is fast.
  resolveCapeTexture(getCape("moonlight")).catch(() => {});
  updateSelectedPanel(getCape(selectedCapeId));
  if (usernameInput) usernameInput.value = currentUsername === "Steve" ? "" : currentUsername;
  const lifecycleObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
    const visible = homePage && homePage.style.display !== "none" && !homePage.classList.contains("shop-only") && stage && stage.offsetWidth > 0;
    if (visible) {
      if (!homeViewer) ensureViewer();
    } else if (homeViewer) {
      disposeViewer();
    }
  });
  if (homePage) lifecycleObserver.observe(homePage, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class", "style"] });
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const visible = homePage && homePage.style.display !== "none" && !homePage.classList.contains("shop-only") && stage && stage.offsetWidth > 0;
    if (visible) ensureViewer();
  });
})();
</script>


<style id="mc-store-fitting-room-search-and-redeem-final">
/* Fitting Room: the square skin head is the compact search button. */
.home-fitting-userbar {
  display: block !important;
  width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  right: auto !important;
  max-width: none !important;
}
.home-fitting-identity-toggle {
  display: block; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent;
  border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease, filter .16s ease;
}
.home-fitting-identity-toggle:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.06); }
.home-fitting-identity-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2dc5f5; outline-offset: 3px; }
.home-fitting-head {
  grid-row: auto !important; width: 44px !important; height: 44px !important; margin: 0;
  border: 2px solid #292724 !important; border-radius: 8px !important; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #292724 !important;
}
.home-fitting-search-panel {
  position: absolute; left: 53px; top: 0; display: block; width: clamp(200px, 35vw, 300px);
  padding: 5px; border: 1px solid #292724; border-radius: 10px; background: #fffdf7;
  box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 #292724; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(-8px); transition: opacity .18s ease, transform .18s ease, visibility .18s ease;
}
.home-fitting-userbar.username-open .home-fitting-search-panel {
  opacity: 1; visibility: visible; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateX(0);
}
.home-fitting-name-label { position: absolute !important; width: 1px !important; height: 1px !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: -1px !important; overflow: hidden !important; clip: rect(0,0,0,0) !important; white-space: nowrap !important; border: 0 !important; }
.home-fitting-search-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
#homeFitUsername { height: 34px !important; min-width: 0; padding: 0 9px !important; border-radius: 7px !important; font-size: 10px !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
#homeFitLoadSkin { height: 34px !important; border-radius: 7px !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
.home-fitting-stage::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 3; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(112deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.02) 39%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 47%, rgba(88,222,255,.22) 51%, rgba(255,255,255,.04) 58%, transparent 67%);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
}
.home-fitting-stage.home-fit-light-hit::after { animation: mcStoreLightReflection .62s ease-out; }
@keyframes mcStoreLightReflection {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-28%); }
  23% { opacity: .9; }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(28%); }
}

/* Product details: use the same 3D player-first fitting-room behavior. */
#details .product-preview-toolbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin: 15px auto 0;
}
#details .preview-tabs {
  display: flex !important; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 !important; padding: 4px !important;
  gap: 4px !important; border: 2px solid #2d2925 !important; border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: #fffdf7 !important; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #2d2925 !important;
}
#details .preview-tab { min-width: 64px !important; padding: 8px 11px !important; border: 0 !important; border-radius: 999px !important; background: transparent !important; color: #5d5750 !important; font-size: 10px !important; font-weight: 900 !important; letter-spacing: .6px !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
#details .preview-tab.active { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#80e0ff 0%,#16baf8 90%) !important; color: #062432 !important; }
#details .preview-motion-toggle {
  min-height: 34px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #2d2925; border-radius: 999px;
  background: #fffdf7; color: #282522; box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 #2d2925; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s, background .15s, color .15s;
}
#details .preview-motion-toggle:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #dff8ff; }
#details .preview-motion-toggle[aria-pressed="false"] { background: #282522; color: #fffdf7; }
#details .preview-motion-toggle:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }
#details .storefront-preview::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 4; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(112deg, transparent 27%, rgba(255,255,255,.03) 37%, rgba(255,255,255,.44) 45%, rgba(67,213,255,.24) 51%, rgba(255,255,255,.04) 58%, transparent 68%);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
}
#details .storefront-preview.cape-light-hit::after { animation: mcStoreLightReflection .62s ease-out; }

/* Reference-matched How to Redeem card, accordion FAQ and customer help section. */
.redeem-guide { margin: 56px auto 68px; color: #24211e; }
.redeem-section-heading { margin: 0 auto 22px; text-align: center; }
.redeem-section-heading h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #24211e; font-size: clamp(24px, 3.2vw, 31px); line-height: 1.18; letter-spacing: -.7px; font-weight: 900; }
.redeem-section-heading p { margin: 0; color: #746b60; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; }
.redeem-guide-card {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.03fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; align-items: center;
  padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #dfd2bd; border-radius: 12px; background: #fffdf8;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(55,43,24,.08);
}
.redeem-video-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; min-height: 170px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d1c4af; border-radius: 7px; background: #26211e; }
.redeem-video-wrap iframe { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }
.redeem-steps h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #25221e; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; }
.redeem-steps ol { display: grid; gap: 9px; padding: 0; margin: 0; list-style: none; }
.redeem-steps li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: start; }
.redeem-steps li > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 50%; background: #eae5db; color: #625b51; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; }
.redeem-steps li p { margin: 1px 0 0; color: #655d52; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.55; }
.redeem-steps a { color: #267fa5; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
.redeem-faq { margin-top: 36px; }
.redeem-faq-heading { margin-bottom: 23px; }
.redeem-faq-list { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.redeem-faq-item { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dfd2bd; border-radius: 10px; background: #fffdf8; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(55,43,24,.07); }
.redeem-faq-item summary { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 43px 13px 16px; color: #24211e; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 850; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; }
.redeem-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.redeem-most-common { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: #37332d; color: #fffdf8; font-size: 7px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 900; }
.redeem-chevron { position: absolute; right: 15px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-55%); color: #655d52; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; transition: transform .18s; }
.redeem-faq-item[open] .redeem-chevron { transform: translateY(-35%) rotate(180deg); }
.redeem-faq-item > p { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px 16px; color: #655d52; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.8; }
.redeem-customer-note { margin-top: 62px; text-align: center; }
.redeem-customer-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 15px; }
.redeem-customer-card { min-width: 0; padding: 21px 18px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #dfd2bd; border-radius: 9px; background: #fffdf8; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(55,43,24,.07); }
.redeem-customer-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 29px; height: 29px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #e5f8ff; color: #137fa9; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; }
.redeem-customer-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #27231f; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
.redeem-customer-card p { margin: 0; color: #655d52; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.7; }
.redeem-customer-card a { display: inline-block; margin-top: 11px; color: #226d8d; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 850; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.redeem-customer-card a:hover { color: #109fd0; }

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .redeem-guide-card { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: 18px; padding: 14px; }
  .redeem-video-wrap { min-height: 0; }
  .redeem-steps h3 { font-size: 13px; }
  .redeem-steps li p { font-size: 11px; }
  .redeem-faq-item summary { padding-left: 12px; font-size: 10px; }
  .redeem-customer-cards { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: 10px; }
  .redeem-customer-card { padding: 16px; }
}
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .home-fitting-search-panel { left: 49px; width: min(248px, calc(100vw - 82px)); }
  .home-fitting-identity-toggle, .home-fitting-head { width: 39px !important; height: 39px !important; }
  .home-fitting-userbar { width: 39px; min-height: 39px; }
  #details .product-preview-toolbar { gap: 8px; }
  #details .preview-tab { min-width: 54px !important; padding: 8px 8px !important; font-size: 9px !important; }
  #details .preview-motion-toggle { font-size: 9px; padding: 8px 10px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .home-fitting-search-panel, #details .preview-motion-toggle { transition: none !important; }
  .home-fitting-stage.home-fit-light-hit::after, #details .storefront-preview.cape-light-hit::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; }
}
</style>

<style id="mc-store-final-spin-fix-and-home-motion">
/* Keep the cape rigid: drag rotates the full 3D player wrapper, not the cape cloth mesh. */
#details .storefront-preview { touch-action: pan-y !important; }
/* Always show a clean 360-degree arrival and simultaneous spin-out on the Home showcase. */
@keyframes mcStoreFinalIncomingCapeSpin {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: rotateY(0deg); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: rotateY(360deg); }
}
@keyframes mcStoreFinalOutgoingCapeSpin {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) rotateY(0deg); }
  to   { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) rotateY(360deg); }
}
#featured .featured-image img.mc-store-spin-now:not(.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing) {
  animation: mcStoreFinalIncomingCapeSpin .1s linear 1 both !important;
  transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
  transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
  backface-visibility: visible !important;
}
#featured .featured-image img.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing {
  animation: mcStoreFinalOutgoingCapeSpin .1s linear 1 both !important;
  transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
  transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
}
.home-fitting-motion-toggle {
  position: absolute !important; z-index: 12 !important; top: 50% !important; right: 12px !important;
  transform: translateY(-50%) !important; width: auto !important; max-width: 106px !important;
  min-height: 36px !important; padding: 8px 10px !important; border: 1.5px solid #292724 !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important; background: #fffdf7 !important; color: #282522 !important;
  box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 #292724 !important; font-size: 10px !important; line-height: 1.25 !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important; cursor: pointer !important; white-space: normal !important;
}
.home-fitting-motion-toggle:hover { background: #dff8ff !important; }
.home-fitting-motion-toggle[aria-pressed="false"] { background: #282522 !important; color: #fffdf7 !important; }
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .home-fitting-motion-toggle { right: 8px !important; max-width: 84px !important; min-height: 32px !important; padding: 7px 8px !important; font-size: 9px !important; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #featured .featured-image img.mc-store-spin-now:not(.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing) { animation: mcStoreFinalIncomingCapeSpin .1s linear 1 both !important; }
  #featured .featured-image img.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing { animation: mcStoreFinalOutgoingCapeSpin .1s linear 1 both !important; }
}
</style>







<style id="mc-store-stability-no-glint-final">
/* Stability pass: never fade product artwork to blank during refresh, route changes, or fast cape selection. */
#featured .featured-image img,
#featured .featured-image img.mc-store-spin-now,
#featured .featured-image img.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing,
#shop .card img,
#details .recommendations .card img {
  backface-visibility: visible !important;
}
#featured .featured-image img:not(.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing) { opacity: 1 !important; }
.mc-showcase-info-out,
.mc-showcase-info-enter,
#details .storefront-preview,
#details .storefront-preview.preview-loading .cape-preview-fallback,
#details .storefront-preview:not(.preview-loading):not(.fallback-cape-only) #capeSkinViewer,
body.mc-open-cape-now #details .detail-card {
  animation: none !important;
  transition: none !important;
  filter: none !important;
}
.mc-showcase-info-out { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; filter: none !important; }
.mc-showcase-info-enter { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; filter: none !important; }
/* Keep the requested fast 360-degree cape change, but remove the reflective/glowing sweep. */
.home-fitting-stage::after,
#details .storefront-preview::after,
#details .storefront-preview.cape-light-hit::after,
.home-fitting-stage.home-fit-light-hit::after { display: none !important; animation: none !important; opacity: 0 !important; }
#details .cape-rotate-hint { animation: none !important; }
/* Avoid blanking the previous image while the next image resolves; keep existing art visible. */
#featured .featured-image img[hidden] { display: block !important; visibility: visible !important; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mc-showcase-info-out, .mc-showcase-info-enter { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
}
</style>

<script id="mc-store-no-glow-cleanup">
(() => {
  const clearGlint = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.home-fit-light-hit, .cape-light-hit').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('home-fit-light-hit', 'cape-light-hit');
    });
  };
  clearGlint();
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', clearGlint);
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', clearGlint);
})();
</script>


<style id="mc-store-final-player-controls-drag-fix">
/* CAPE / PLAYER / ELYTRA tabs remain available in the product viewer. */
#details .preview-tabs { display:flex !important; }
#details .product-preview-toolbar { display:flex !important; }
/* CAPE rotates around its center on the horizontal axis; the player can tilt in both axes. */
#details #capeSkinViewer { touch-action:pan-y !important; }
#details #capePreviewStage.mode-player #capeSkinViewer,
#details #capePreviewStage.mode-elytra #capeSkinViewer { touch-action:none !important; }
#homeFitCanvas { touch-action:none !important; }
/* Match the compact pause/play icon inside the cape preview: top-right, no words. */
.home-fitting-motion-toggle {
  top:10px !important; right:10px !important; left:auto !important; bottom:auto !important;
  transform:none !important; width:34px !important; min-width:34px !important; max-width:34px !important;
  height:34px !important; min-height:34px !important; padding:0 !important;
  display:grid !important; place-items:center !important; border-radius:9px !important;
  background:#342c28 !important; color:#fffdf7 !important; border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45) !important;
  box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25) !important; font-size:13px !important; line-height:1 !important;
  font-weight:900 !important; white-space:nowrap !important;
}
.home-fitting-motion-toggle:hover { background:#137ea4 !important; }
.home-fitting-motion-toggle[aria-pressed="false"] { background:#fffdf7 !important; color:#282522 !important; }
@media(max-width:620px) {
  .home-fitting-motion-toggle { top:8px !important; right:8px !important; width:32px !important; min-width:32px !important; max-width:32px !important; height:32px !important; min-height:32px !important; }
}
</style>


<style id="mc-store-make-shop-capes-bigger-final">
/* Only enlarge the cape renders in Shop / Our Products; keep card layout and all other images unchanged. */
#shop .card-art { overflow: hidden !important; }
#shop .card-img {
  width: 98% !important;
  height: 252px !important;
  max-height: calc(100% - 8px) !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
  object-position: center !important;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  #shop .card-img { width: 98% !important; height: 216px !important; }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  #shop .card-img { width: 98% !important; height: 180px !important; }
}
</style>



<style id="mc-store-bigger-shop-and-recommendation-capes">
/* Make the 3D cape artwork substantially larger in Our Products. */
#shop .card-art {
  height: clamp(230px, 21vw, 290px) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
#shop .card-img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  max-height: none !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
  object-position: center !important;
}

/* Also enlarge the cape artwork under “You might also like” on product pages. */
#details .recommendations .card-art {
  height: 230px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
#details .recommendations .card-img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 218px !important;
  max-height: none !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
  object-position: center !important;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  #details .recommendations .card-art { height: 205px !important; }
  #details .recommendations .card-img { height: 195px !important; }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  #shop .card-art { height: 205px !important; }
  #shop .card-img { width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; }
  #details .recommendations .card-art { height: 185px !important; }
  #details .recommendations .card-img { width: 100% !important; height: 178px !important; }
}
@media (max-width: 390px) {

  #details .recommendations .card-art { height: 175px !important; }
  #details .recommendations .card-img { height: 168px !important; }
}
</style>



<style id="mc-store-blurred-cape-scene-backgrounds">
/* Blurred Minecraft scenery behind each 3D cape in Our Products and You might also like. */
#shop .card-art,
#details .recommendations .card-art {
  position: relative !important;
  isolation: isolate !important;
  background-color: #07172a !important;
}
#shop .card-scene-bg,
#details .recommendations .card-scene-bg {
  position: absolute !important;
  z-index: 0 !important;
  inset: -10px !important;
  display: block !important;
  width: calc(100% + 20px) !important;
  height: calc(100% + 20px) !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
  object-position: center !important;
  opacity: .9 !important;
  filter: blur(7px) brightness(.62) saturate(1.05) !important;
  transform: scale(1.06) !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  user-select: none !important;
}
#shop .card-img,
#details .recommendations .card-img {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 1 !important;
}
#shop .card-tag,
#details .recommendations .card-tag {
  z-index: 2 !important;
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  #shop .card-scene-bg,
  #details .recommendations .card-scene-bg {
    filter: blur(6px) brightness(.62) saturate(1.05) !important;
  }
}
</style>


<style id="mc-store-product-preview-blurred-backgrounds-final">
/* Use each cape's matching Minecraft scenery behind CAPE, PLAYER, and ELYTRA preview modes. */
#details .cape-preview-scene.has-image {
  background: #07172a !important;
}
#details .cape-preview-scene.has-image::before,
#details .cape-preview-scene.has-image::after {
  display: none !important;
  content: none !important;
}
#details .cape-preview-scene.has-image .cape-preview-scene-image {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: -12px !important;
  display: block !important;
  width: calc(100% + 24px) !important;
  height: calc(100% + 24px) !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
  object-position: center !important;
  opacity: .96 !important;
  filter: blur(8px) brightness(.62) saturate(1.05) !important;
  transform: scale(1.06) !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  user-select: none !important;
}
#details #capePreviewStage.mode-cape .cape-preview-scene,
#details #capePreviewStage.mode-player .cape-preview-scene,
#details #capePreviewStage.mode-elytra .cape-preview-scene {
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  #details .cape-preview-scene.has-image .cape-preview-scene-image {
    filter: blur(6px) brightness(.62) saturate(1.05) !important;
  }
}
</style>


<style id="mc-store-home-showcase-clean-360-final">
  /* HOME showcase: keep the cape fixed in place; only rotate it once when a different cape arrives. */
  #featured .featured-image,
  #featured .featured-image.cape-zoom-switch {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
  }
  #featured .featured-image img:not(.mc-store-spin-now):not(.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing) {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    filter: drop-shadow(8px 16px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2)) !important;
  }
  @keyframes mcStoreHomeCapeRigid360Final {
    from { transform: perspective(1100px) rotateY(0deg); }
    to   { transform: perspective(1100px) rotateY(360deg); }
  }
  #featured .featured-image img.mc-store-spin-now:not(.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing) {
    animation: mcStoreHomeCapeRigid360Final .1s linear 1 both !important;
    transform-origin: 50% 50% !important;
    transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
    backface-visibility: visible !important;
    will-change: transform !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
  }
  /* Any old outgoing clone is suppressed; the next cape replaces the previous one in place. */
  #featured .featured-image img.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing { display: none !important; animation: none !important; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    #featured .featured-image,
    #featured .featured-image img:not(.mc-store-spin-now) { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    #featured .featured-image img.mc-store-spin-now:not(.mc-showcase-cape-outgoing) {
      animation: mcStoreHomeCapeRigid360Final .1s linear 1 both !important;
    }
  }
</style>

<style id="mc-store-refresh-stability-and-preview-upright-final">
  /* No flash, fade, zoom, or temporary shifted sizing when a product page is opened/refreshed. */
  #details .detail-card,
  #details .detail-card.mc-scroll-reveal,
  #details .detail-card.mc-scroll-visible,
  #details .detail-card.mc-scroll-replay,
  #details .storefront-preview,
  #details .storefront-preview .cape-preview-fallback,
  #details .storefront-preview #capeSkinViewer {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
  #details .detail-card.mc-scroll-reveal,
  #details .detail-card.mc-scroll-visible,
  #details .detail-card.mc-scroll-replay {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
  #details .storefront-preview {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
  }
  #details .storefront-preview.preview-loading #capeSkinViewer {
    visibility: hidden !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
  }
  #details .storefront-preview.preview-loading .cape-preview-fallback {
    display: block !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
  }
  #details .storefront-preview:not(.preview-loading) #capeSkinViewer {
    visibility: visible !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    #details .storefront-preview { min-height: 350px !important; }
  }
</style>



<style id="mc-store-moonlight-direct-3d-fix-final">
/* Moonlight uses the real 3D atlas only. Never show the flat catalogue artwork in the viewer. */
#details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first .cape-preview-fallback,
#details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first.preview-loading .cape-preview-fallback,
#details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first.fallback-cape-only .cape-preview-fallback {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}
/* Avoid the white/untextured cape frame: keep the canvas hidden until loadCape has finished. */
#details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first.preview-loading #capeSkinViewer,
#details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first.moonlight-texture-missing #capeSkinViewer {
  display: block !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
}
#details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first:not(.preview-loading):not(.moonlight-texture-missing) #capeSkinViewer {
  display: block !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}
#details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first.moonlight-texture-missing .cape-preview-fallback {
  display: none !important;
}
</style>

<style id="mc-store-moonlight-fitroom-loading-final">
/* Do not show SkinViewer's default white cape before the selected texture is ready. */
.home-fitting-stage.is-loading #homeFitCanvas,
.home-fitting-stage.cape-texture-missing #homeFitCanvas {
  visibility: hidden !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
}
.home-fitting-stage:not(.is-loading):not(.cape-texture-missing) #homeFitCanvas {
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}
</style>


<style id="mc-store-discord-buy-now-only">
  #details .storefront-detail-actions { display:grid !important; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) !important; gap:10px !important; }
  #details .storefront-detail-actions .storefront-buy {
    width:100%; min-height:52px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:14px 18px; border:1px solid #161b1c; border-radius:11px;
    background:linear-gradient(110deg,#6beeff,#3475ff); color:#071d27;
    font-size:15px; font-weight:900; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:3px 4px 0 #171d1e;
    transition:transform .18s ease,filter .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  #details .storefront-detail-actions .storefront-buy:hover { filter:brightness(1.06); transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:3px 6px 0 #171d1e; }
  .home-fitting-buy { text-decoration:none !important; }
  .home-fitting-buy:disabled { opacity:1 !important; cursor:pointer !important; }
</style>


<style id="mc-store-orange-brand-and-moonlight-3d-final">
  /* The complete CHEAPEST Cape Codes wordmark should be orange, not the old cyan gradient. */
  .brand .brand-fallback,
  .brand .brand-fallback .gradient,
  .mc-footer-logo-fallback {
    color: #ff8a2b !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #ff8a2b !important;
    background: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }
  /* A visible drag affordance on the 3D Moonlight preview on desktop and touch devices. */
  #details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first #capeSkinViewer {
    cursor: grab !important;
    touch-action: pan-y !important;
  }
  #details .storefront-preview.moonlight-3d-first #capeSkinViewer:active {
    cursor: grabbing !important;
  }
</style>

</body>

  .redeem-discord-help {

  .redeem-discord-help p { margin: 0 0 20px; color: #655d52; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.8; }
  .redeem-discord-help .btn { text-decoration: none; }

  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    .brand .brand-fallback { font-size: 13px !important; letter-spacing: -.5px !important; }
